chapters.title: Chapter 1851: The Four And Guang Zhiyi III
paragraphs: Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen were dumbfounded as soon as they saw the inside of the alchemy furnace.

At first, Zhang Fei used one flame to heat his furnace, but he used five different flames to refine the herbs, something no other alchemist could do. After all, almost all alchemists only possessed one type of flame, and it was rare for them to possess two or more, yet he possessed five types of flames and used them at the same time.
Long Yuxi turned to Guang Zhiyi. "How can he have so many types of flames?"
"Is five really that many?"
"Huh? You mean he still has some other flames?"

"The phoenix flame, the dark phoenix flame, the dragon flame, the vermilion flame, the golden crow flame, the icy cold flame, the soul flame, the blood flame, the sky flame, the earth flame, the moon flame, the sun flame, and the primordial flame."

The three people’s jaws fell open as soon as Guang Zhiyi mentioned all those flames, except for Mo Qingwen. They knew that the Primordial Flame was in Zhang Fei’s hand because Huo Ling was its flame spirit, but they just found out that he had so many other flames in his possession.

"Unbelievable!" Jiu Tou Sen himself possessed nine elements, but all of them were different from each other. However, he didn’t know yet that Zhang Fei not only focused on the fire element, but he also had many other elements.
Knowing more about Zhang Fei, Meng Huo felt that his decision to challenge him earlier was truly ridiculous. "Your husband is truly a freak, Zhiyi."

"Wait a minute!" Long Yuxi shouted. "Isn’t the Moon Flame the treasure of the Silver Moon Race and the Sun Flame the treasure of the Golden Sun Race? If I remember correctly, both flames disappeared with the destruction of those two clans."

"You’re not wrong about the two flames and the two races, Yuxi." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "Even though both races have long been destroyed, their two domains still exist, and my husband happened to find portals to enter both."
"Huh? Where are the two portals located?"
"The portal to the Silver Moon Race’s domain is in the Paradise Realm, and the portal to the Golden Sun Race’s domain is in this Ancient Realm."
Guang Zhiyi created two qi screens that displayed both locations.
"See? Both places still exist, and my husband got both flames there."
Long Yuxi nodded after seeing both pictures. "How did he get the rest of the heavenly flames?"
"He obtained the Soul Flame, the Blood Flame, the Sky Flame, and the Earth Flame in the Three Mortal Realms."
"What are the Three Mortal Realms?"
"The Three Mortal Realms are behind the path before the Paradise Realm."

Jiu Tou Sen and Meng Huo already knew that Zhang Fei came from the lower realm in the Three Mortal Realm, but Long Yuxi and Mo Qingwen didn’t know about it yet, forcing Guang Zhiyi to display their images and explain to them.
"All cultivators born in the Ancient Realm don’t know about the Three Mortal Realms, but all cultivators in the Paradise Realm know about them."
"You mean the Three Mortal Realms are the initial realms in this universe?"

"Wrong." Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "The first realm in the universe was the Primordial Realm, followed by the Ancient Realm, the Paradise Realm, and the Three Mortal Realms. Don’t ask me about how they were all created; I don’t have the answer. My husband was born on one of the planets in the lower realms, and I met him when he went to the Sky Jade Realm. At that time, his cultivation just broke through to the foundation level, and I’ve been following his progress ever since."

Long Yuxi didn’t expect that Guang Zhiyi had already met Zhang Fei since his cultivation had just broken through to the Foundation Realm, and his cultivation had already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm now, which meant they had been together for several years.
Meng Huo then asked. "Zhiyi, how long has he been a cultivator?"
"About thirteen years ago."
"What?" They screamed in shock.
"Did he really become a cultivator about thirteen years ago?"
"Doesn’t that mean he is a monster?"
"He’s the only cultivator who could reach his current level in such a short time."
"It took me several decades to reach the Quasi-Divine Realm, yet he only needed about thirteen years to reach the Celestial Emperor Realm."
Guang Zhiyi shrugged indifferently, and she had no intention of explaining to them all of Zhang Fei’s advantages. "To be my husband, he must be a special cultivator, or he won’t be worthy of me."
The three men’s lips twitched after hearing her smug remark. "What a show-off!"
"Haha," Guang Zhiyi softly laughed.

Long Yuxi hugged her hand. "Tell me your husband’s secrets, Zhiyi. I don’t believe he relied solely on talent to reach his current level, and I’m sure he has many secrets that have helped him immensely."
"You will know his secrets if you are willing to be his wife."

"Alright, I give up." Long Yuxi let go of Guang Zhiyi’s hand and raised both of her hands in surrender. "I’m curious about your husband’s secrets, but I don’t want to have that kind of relationship with any man, let alone a man with many wives like him."
Guang Zhiyi smirked before touching Long Yuxi’s forehead, and she shared her memories with Zhang Fei, especially when they had sex.
"Ahh! Gross!" Long Yuxi’s face turned red after seeing all those memories. "You really are a pervert, Zhiyi! Why did you share all those memories with me?"
Jiu Tou Sen, Mo Qingwen, and Meng Huo chose not to comment on that matter, but Long Yuxi’s strong reaction already gave them an idea of Zhang Fei’s prowess in that field.
Guang Zhiyi shrugged. "Have you ever thought about your Sky Dragon bloodline?"
"Hmm?" Long Yuxi turned serious after Guang Zhiyi mentioned her bloodline.

"Even though the Sky Dragon is not as powerful as the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon or the Calamity Dragon, it is still one of the strongest dragons to have ever existed in the universe." Long Yuxi nodded in agreement with Guang Zhiyi. "The Sky Dragon Bloodline within your body is the only remaining one in this universe, and it will disappear if you die, which also means the extinction of that race. Are you willing to let the Sky Dragon Race disappear forever from this universe?"

"No." Long Yuxi shook her head strongly. "Reviving the Sky Dragon Race is my ultimate dream, but it’s impossible because I’m not a true Sky Dragon, and I’m just a demihuman with its bloodline. Even so, I won’t let the Sky Dragon Bloodline disappear forever from this universe, and I will do whatever it takes to preserve it."

"Unfortunately, your wish to preserve the Sky Dragon Bloodline is impossible, Yuxi." Long Yuxi fell silent as she had long realized the problem, and the bloodline would continue to decline even if she passed it on to her children. "The only person who can help you preserve your bloodline is my husband. You probably won’t believe me now, but I’ll have him show you a few things later."
"What can he show me?"
"Have you ever heard of the Phoenix Devourer Beast?"
"The Phoenix Devourer Beast?" Long Yuxi and the three men were both confused by that.
"Hey, Zhiyi! Does the Phoenix Devourer Beast really exist? Why have I never heard of such a beast race?" Jiu Tou Sen asked.

"You may have never heard of the Phoenix Devourer Beast, but that doesn’t mean it doesn’t exist, right?" Guang Zhiyi displayed Zhang Lingxue’s image on the qi screen. "See? Her name is Zhang Lingxue, and she is one of my husband’s wives. She is my sister, and she got her phoenix bloodline from me. After that, my husband gave her the Ancient Devourer Beast Bloodline, and she turned into the one and only Phoenix Devourer Beast in this universe."
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi found it hard to believe, but the facts were before their eyes, making it difficult for them to deny it.

"Why did you reveal so many secrets about your husband and his wife, Zhiyi? Aren’t you afraid that other cultivators would target them if they found out about all that?" Meng Huo asked with a serious expression.

"Do you think I need to worry about that, Old Meng? After all, no cultivator in this Ancient Realm can fight me, right?" Black lines appeared on their faces because of Guang Zhiyi’s arrogant bragging. "Ever since my husband embarked on his path of cultivation, he has never kept many secrets, and all cultivators know about his multiple identities. You’ve fought with him before, so you should already have some understanding of him. If people attack him or any of his wives, he will show no mercy to them, and he will kill them all, including their relatives."
Meng Huo wanted to refute that, but he remembered the power of Zhang Fei’s killing intent, which surpassed his own. "How many living beings died at the hands of your husband?"
"You guess! Otherwise, his killing intent wouldn’t be that strong, right?"

Meng Huo nodded to Guang Zhiyi, and he realized that Zhang Fei had already killed countless beings. Compared to him, the young man was probably much more ruthless, and he didn’t hesitate to kill all his enemies.
*Boom*

All of them stared at Zhang Fei, who had just finished his alchemy. They were speechless since he could complete his alchemy so quickly, and they were even more astonished when he took out five superior-grade pills from the furnace.
Zhang Fei immediately put away his furnace and showed them the pills. "Do you guys still doubt my abilities as an alchemist?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1852: The Sky Dragon Corpse I
paragraphs: Long Yuxi snatched one of the pills and examined it. "What kind of pill is this?"
"The Phoenix Restoration Pill."
Long Yuxi looked at Zhang Fei. "What effect does this pill have?"
"Healing and qi restoration."
"A pill with double effect?"
"You still have some minor injuries, so you can try swallowing the pill."
"How did you know that I was still suffering from minor injuries? Are you also a physician?"
"I don’t need to be a physician to know those minor injuries in your body."

"Oh." Long Yuxi stretched out her hand and shot a bright white light into the air, leaving them speechless. "Hehe! My qi is still full, so I need to expend a little of it to prove the effect of your pill."

Zhang Fei massaged his nose while watching Long Yuxi’s face; he was sure that she was the representative of the demihuman race. Since the representatives of the five races had gathered by his side, he only needed to meet the representative of the demon race. However, he was unsure about entering the Lotus Limbo World with his current strength, and he feared that he wouldn’t be able to get out again if he couldn’t persuade the female demon.

Long Yuxi swallowed the pill, dissolved it, and spread it all over her body. After waiting a few minutes, she was surprised to feel the effects of the pill. "Hmm? My body is heating up from the inside, but I can feel that my injuries are slowly healing, and my qi is replenished."
"Do you believe me now?"
"Yes! I believe you!" Long Yuxi sat cross-legged at her spot and took out the other pills that Zhang Fei gave her before. "I will swallow these pills now."
Guang Zhiyi turned to the three men. "You guys should swallow those pills now, and you will get amazing effects from them."
Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen also sat in their spots, swallowing the same pills that Long Yuxi swallowed just now.

Zhang Fei put his arm around Guang Zhiyi’s shoulders. ’Yao’er, you’d better not reveal too many of my secrets in front of Meng Huo. He’s not as good as you think, and his heart is quite dirty. If he finds another chance, he’ll betray us immediately. If we didn’t need his strength to fight those creatures, I would have killed him long ago.’
’I know.’ Guan Zhiyi nodded. ’You don’t have to worry about Meng Huo; I will keep a close eye on him, and I will act immediately if he shows any signs of betrayal.’
Zhang Fei still wasn’t satisfied with that, and he shot something into Meng Huo’s body. This way, he could monitor him from afar, and he would act against him if he thought about betraying them.

Guang Zhiyi tilted her head to the side of his ear, glancing at Long Yuxi. ’She’s definitely the representative of the demihuman race, so you should act quickly and take her as your woman. After that, you just need to focus on your cultivation, and I will take you to the Lotus Limbo Worlds once you are ready to meet that female demon.’
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei rubbed his chin while looking at Long Yuxi. ’Her demihuman form is truly unusual.’
’Do you think I don’t know that you often used your two demihuman forms to have sex with some of them?’ Guang Zhiyi teased him.

Zhang Fei coughed before smiling awkwardly. He often had sex with several of his wives using his half-fox form or half-dragon form, especially with his beast wives like Zhang Chen. In fact, he also had sex with several of his wives, like Boitata and several others, using his two beast forms.
’How about we have sex using our beast forms, Yao’er?’

’Hmm?’ Guang Zhiyi gave him a sideways glare. ’Somehow, I feel that your brain is getting crooked now, husband. Are you really thinking of riding a beautiful phoenix like me using your fox or dragon form?’
’Hehehe!’ Zhang Fei laughed. ’Dragon and phoenix are a unique pair, okay? How about that? Are you interested?’
Guang Zhiyi rolled her eyes. ’Alright, we’ll try it later.’
Zhang Fei grinned after getting her approval, and he returned his gaze to Long Yuxi, considering the right approach. ’Should I use my lust demon abilities on her?’

’Why do you have to hold yourself back?’ Guang Zhiyi glared at him. ’You’re a lust demon, so you should behave like one. Back then, you never held yourself back, and you often used your lust demon abilities against those women, but you changed since you ascended to the Paradise Realm.’
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, but he didn’t take it seriously, and he continued to think of other methods.

Zhang Fei spreads his senses throughout the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley; he nodded in satisfaction with the progress of the domain’s reconstruction, and he would move his close acquaintances there after Liao Hanxue had obtained all the materials for the barrier.
"Are those creatures near this domain?"
"No," Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "They likely don’t know that you’re rebuilding this domain, so they haven’t approached it since it’s been abandoned for a long time."

Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief. "Mo Shentian will arrive at the Endless Domain in about five days, right? At that time, I won’t hold back anymore, and I will use my full strength to defeat him. After that, I will order him to pass on his strength to Mo Tianshen, and Mo Zhejun will watch over him for me."
"Aren’t you going to appoint Mo Zixiao as their next leader?"
"At first, I thought so, but it would be troublesome, so I changed my mind."
Guang Zhiyi nodded in understanding. "Mo Tianshen and Morgana can cultivate in the Myriad Abyss Domain, while Mo Shentian and Mo Zhejun will take care of the Celestial Demon Race for you."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei nodded. "After I defeat Mo Shentian, I’ll take them into seclusion, and I’ll face Qian Yan in the next ten years."
Guang Zhiyi remembered one thing. "Speaking of Qian Yan, he already knew that Ju Yuning and her three children were missing, and Qian Yu told him that you took them away."

"I had expected that, Qian Yu couldn’t refute his father. However, it wasn’t a big deal since Qian Yan’s middle eye couldn’t see through across realms, so he wouldn’t be able to find them." Zhang Fei flew away to other areas, especially the altar with the Dragon Phoenix Union Array.

Guang Zhiyi did not follow Zhang Fei; instead, she waited for the four people to finish swallowing those pills. She also thought of several others, including the core creature and the female demon in the Lotus Limbo World.

Guang Zhiyi sighed. ’His cultivation hasn’t reached the Three God Realm, and he still needs a long time to reach the Exalt Supreme Realm. When his cultivation reaches that stage, that day will determine my fate and the fate of this universe. I hope he won’t be sad if I’m no longer by his side; all his women need him.’

Sometime later, Long Yuxi opened her eyes. She jumped up and down after sensing the changes in her body. She had swallowed another alchemist’s basic pills in the past, but Zhang Fei’s pills were far more potent than that person’s, and the changes to her body were significant.

Long Yuxi was most satisfied with the Yin Purifying Pill and the True Dantian Pill because the first made her yin qi two times purer, and the second expanded her dantian, allowing her to store more qi. She flew into the air and tried using some of her techniques, and the results surprised her.

"Such godly pills, and he gives them away for free." Long Yuxi mumbled softly, and her expression was filled with excitement. "If I swallowed those pills a long time ago, I wouldn’t be afraid of those creatures."

"Wishful thinking." Long Yuxi looked at Guang Zhiyi. "Even though you’ve swallowed my husband’s pills, you’re still no match for those creatures. If their leader sends stronger creatures after you, they will succeed in capturing you, and one of them will control you."
Long Yuxi trembled at the thought of something like that happening to her. "Tch! You’re scaring me on purpose, Zhiyi!"

"I’m not scaring you, and that’s a fact." Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "Those creatures have several levels, and some of them are as powerful as those primordials, but their leader hasn’t sent them out yet."
"Why is that?"
"Testing the water."
"Hmm?"
"Currently, no cultivator in the Ancient Realm can match the primordials, including me."
"So, the leader of those creatures is deliberately looking down on us, huh?"
Guang Zhiyi raised an eyebrow. "Why would the leader look down on you if you’re not his opponent?"
"Humph!" Long Yuxi pouted, unable to refute her. "Are you leaving again?"
"Yes," Guang Zhiyi nodded. "This body isn’t my real body, and I use it to monitor this universe."

Long Yuxi scrutinized her, feeling that there was something unusual about her. "Why do you care so much about this universe? In the past, you didn’t care about this Ancient Realm that much, and you stole the Eternal Flame from its temple."
"I care about this universe for two reasons."
"What are your two reasons?"
"First, this universe is part of my life. Second, my husband lives in this universe."
"What do you mean by this universe being a part of you?" Guang Zhiyi did not intend to explain this to Long Yuxi, which irritated her. "Do you love your husband that much?"
Guang Zhiyi smiled. "I will do anything for him, even if I have to sacrifice myself."
"Tch! I didn’t realize that you were such a lovesick woman!" Long Yuxi mocked her. "In the past, you didn’t care about feelings, but now you’re the exact opposite of your past."

Guang Zhiyi tilted her head to the side of his ear, glancing at Long Yuxi. ’She’s definitely the representative of the demihuman race, so you should act quickly and take her as your woman.
After that, you just need to focus on your cultivation, and I will take you to the Lotus Limbo Worlds once you are ready to meet that female demon.’
’Hmm?’ Zhang Fei rubbed his chin while looking at Long Yuxi. ’Her demihuman form is truly unusual.’
’Do you think I don’t know that you often used your two demihuman forms to have sex with some of them?’ Guang Zhiyi teased him.
Zhang Fei coughed before smiling awkwardly.
He often had sex with several of his wives using his half-fox form or half-dragon form, especially with his beast wives like Zhang Chen.
In fact, he also had sex with several of his wives, like Boitata and several others, using his two beast forms.
’How about we have sex using our beast forms, Yao’er?’
’Hmm?’ Guang Zhiyi gave him a sideways glare. ’Somehow, I feel that your brain is getting crooked now, husband.
Are you really thinking of riding a beautiful phoenix like me using your fox or dragon form?’
’Hehehe!’ Zhang Fei laughed. ’Dragon and phoenix are a unique pair, okay?
How about that?
Are you interested?’
Guang Zhiyi rolled her eyes. ’Alright, we’ll try it later.’
Zhang Fei grinned after getting her approval, and he returned his gaze to Long Yuxi, considering the right approach. ’Should I use my lust demon abilities on her?’
’Why do you have to hold yourself back?’ Guang Zhiyi glared at him. ’You’re a lust demon, so you should behave like one.
Back then, you never held yourself back, and you often used your lust demon abilities against those women, but you changed since you ascended to the Paradise Realm.’
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, but he didn’t take it seriously, and he continued to think of other methods.

Zhang Fei spreads his senses throughout the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley; he nodded in satisfaction with the progress of the domain’s reconstruction, and he would move his close acquaintances there after Liao Hanxue had obtained all the materials for the barrier.
"Are those creatures near this domain?"
"No," Guang Zhiyi shook her head.
"They likely don’t know that you’re rebuilding this domain, so they haven’t approached it since it’s been abandoned for a long time."
Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief.
"Mo Shentian will arrive at the Endless Domain in about five days, right?
At that time, I won’t hold back anymore, and I will use my full strength to defeat him.
After that, I will order him to pass on his strength to Mo Tianshen, and Mo Zhejun will watch over him for me."
"Aren’t you going to appoint Mo Zixiao as their next leader?"
"At first, I thought so, but it would be troublesome, so I changed my mind."
Guang Zhiyi nodded in understanding.
"Mo Tianshen and Morgana can cultivate in the Myriad Abyss Domain, while Mo Shentian and Mo Zhejun will take care of the Celestial Demon Race for you."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei nodded.
"After I defeat Mo Shentian, I’ll take them into seclusion, and I’ll face Qian Yan in the next ten years."
Guang Zhiyi remembered one thing.
"Speaking of Qian Yan, he already knew that Ju Yuning and her three children were missing, and Qian Yu told him that you took them away."
"I had expected that, Qian Yu couldn’t refute his father.

However, it wasn’t a big deal since Qian Yan’s middle eye couldn’t see through across realms, so he wouldn’t be able to find them." Zhang Fei flew away to other areas, especially the altar with the Dragon Phoenix Union Array.
Guang Zhiyi did not follow Zhang Fei; instead, she waited for the four people to finish swallowing those pills.
She also thought of several others, including the core creature and the female demon in the Lotus Limbo World.
Guang Zhiyi sighed. ’His cultivation hasn’t reached the Three God Realm, and he still needs a long time to reach the Exalt Supreme Realm.
When his cultivation reaches that stage, that day will determine my fate and the fate of this universe.
I hope he won’t be sad if I’m no longer by his side; all his women need him.’
Sometime later, Long Yuxi opened her eyes.
She jumped up and down after sensing the changes in her body.
She had swallowed another alchemist’s basic pills in the past, but Zhang Fei’s pills were far more potent than that person’s, and the changes to her body were significant.

Long Yuxi was most satisfied with the Yin Purifying Pill and the True Dantian Pill because the first made her yin qi two times purer, and the second expanded her dantian, allowing her to store more qi.
She flew into the air and tried using some of her techniques, and the results surprised her.
"Such godly pills, and he gives them away for free." Long Yuxi mumbled softly, and her expression was filled with excitement.
"If I swallowed those pills a long time ago, I wouldn’t be afraid of those creatures."
"Wishful thinking." Long Yuxi looked at Guang Zhiyi.
"Even though you’ve swallowed my husband’s pills, you’re still no match for those creatures.
If their leader sends stronger creatures after you, they will succeed in capturing you, and one of them will control you."
Long Yuxi trembled at the thought of something like that happening to her.
"Tch!
You’re scaring me on purpose, Zhiyi!"
"I’m not scaring you, and that’s a fact." Guang Zhiyi shook her head.
"Those creatures have several levels, and some of them are as powerful as those primordials, but their leader hasn’t sent them out yet."
"Why is that?"
"Testing the water."
"Hmm?"
"Currently, no cultivator in the Ancient Realm can match the primordials, including me."
"So, the leader of those creatures is deliberately looking down on us, huh?"
Guang Zhiyi raised an eyebrow.
"Why would the leader look down on you if you’re not his opponent?"
"Humph!" Long Yuxi pouted, unable to refute her.
"Are you leaving again?"
"Yes," Guang Zhiyi nodded.
"This body isn’t my real body, and I use it to monitor this universe."
Long Yuxi scrutinized her, feeling that there was something unusual about her.
"Why do you care so much about this universe?
In the past, you didn’t care about this Ancient Realm that much, and you stole the Eternal Flame from its temple."
"I care about this universe for two reasons."
"What are your two reasons?"
"First, this universe is part of my life.
Second, my husband lives in this universe."
"What do you mean by this universe being a part of you?" Guang Zhiyi did not intend to explain this to Long Yuxi, which irritated her.
"Do you love your husband that much?"
Guang Zhiyi smiled.
"I will do anything for him, even if I have to sacrifice myself."
"Tch!
I didn’t realize that you were such a lovesick woman!" Long Yuxi mocked her.
"In the past, you didn’t care about feelings, but now you’re the exact opposite of your past."

chapters.title: Chapter 1853: The Sky Dragon Corpse II
paragraphs: When he returned, Zhang Fei saw that Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen had finished taking their pills.
"Zhang Fei, please send me back to my domain; there are some matters I need to handle there."
After Zhang Fei opened the gate, Mo Qingwen immediately disappeared inside. "Are you three going back to that domain?"

"No." Meng Huo summoned his flaming horse from his beast space. "Thank you for your pills, but I have some business in another domain. I must go there first, and I will return to the Myriad Abyss Domain after my business is finished."
Zhang Fei didn’t care much about Meng Huo, and he was too lazy to meet him. He already saw the dark side hidden in his heart, and he was not a suitable ally for him, but he had no other choice.
After all, the Nightmare Lord was the third strongest in the Ancient Realm, and not everyone could overcome his abilities like Zhang Fei, so he could still be relied upon for future battles.
When he looked at Jiu Tou Sen, Zhang Fei remembered one of his beast contracts, and he immediately summoned Jiu Shui out of his beast space.
"What the hell!" Jiu Tou Sen screamed in shock when he saw Jiu Shi. "Hey! Where did you meet your contract beast, Kid?"
"One of the planets in the Three Mortal Realms."
"Huh?" Jiu Tou Sen was stunned for a moment. "That’s impossible, right? My Nine-Headed Serpent Beast Race doesn’t exist in the Paradise Realm, let alone the Three Mortal Realms."

"Do I need to lie to you?" Zhang Fei created a qi screen, showing the place of his first meeting with Jiu Shui, which was the underwater city in the Nine Stars Realm. "That planet is located in the Three Mortal Realms, specifically in the Middle Realm."
"That’s weird." Jiu Shi hid behind Zhang Fei as soon as Jiu Tou Sen approached him. "Hey! I’m your ancestor, so you don’t need to be afraid of me."
Jiu Shui looked at Zhang Fei, who nodded at him. "He is the strongest beast in this Ancient Realm, and he has lived for too long, so he can be considered your ancestor."
"Haish! I didn’t expect a descendant of my beast race to be so timid!" Jiu Tou Sen transformed into his beast form, and his gigantic size was too intimidating for Jiu Shui.
However, Jiu Shui also envied Jiu Tou Sen because he only had four heads, and his ancestor’s beast form was already perfect with nine heads.
"Hey, Brat! You—"

"Old Jiu, your speaking style is too intimidating!" Zhang Fei shook his head. "Jiu Shui always stays inside my beast space, and he rarely communicates with other beasts, except for my other contract beasts."

Jiu Tou Sen sighed and returned to his human form. "How about I take him with me, Kid? There’s a domain in this Ancient Realm that’s suitable for my beast race, and he’ll evolve faster if he cultivates there."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei turned to Guang Zhiyi. "Is that domain better than my beast space?"

"Yes," Guang Zhiyi nodded. "The flow of time in your beast space is four times faster than in that domain, but it lacks a few things compared to there. If Jiu Shui cultivates there, he will evolve much faster."

"I see." Zhang Fei looked at Jiu Shui. "You should go with him to that domain, and he will guide you in your cultivation. When you have reached the nine heads, you can return to my side and fight alongside me."
Jiu Shui didn’t want to leave his master, but he knew that he was too weak to fight by his side, and Zhang Fei never summoned him out of the beast space because of his weakness.

After making up his mind, Jiu Shui agreed to go with Jiu Tou Sen. "Please wait for my return, Master. By then, I will be strong enough to fight by your side, and I will protect you from all your enemies."

"Haha," Zhang Fei rubbed his head. "No matter how strong you become, I will still be stronger than you. Even so, I am satisfied with your intention to fight alongside me, so I will be looking forward to your return, and you must not disappoint me."
Jiu Shui lowered his four heads. "I won’t disappoint you, Master."
"Alright, there’s no need to be this sentimental, and you should go with Old Jiu now." Zhang Fei looked at Jiu Tou Sen. "Protect him well, Old Jiu."
Jiu Tou San slammed his fist into his chest. "Leave it to me, Kid. I’ll protect him, and I’ll train him to become a powerful beast."
"Go."
After Jiu Tou Sen flew into the sky and returned to his beast form, Jiu Shui immediately jumped onto his back, and they quickly flew out of the domain. "Please wait for my return, Master!"
Zhang Fei waved his hand until they disappeared, and then he looked at Long Yuxi. "What are your plans after this? Are you going to enter another deep sleep?"

"Those creatures have started targeting me, so I can’t let my guard down by entering a deep sleep, or they’ll capture me." Long Yuxi glanced at Guang Zhiyi, who responded with a subtle smile. "For now, I will stay with you, and I will train again."

"Hmm?" Guang Zhiyi winked at Zhang Fei. "Since you’ve decided so, I’ll send you to my private training ground, but I forbid you from telling anyone else about it. That place is one of my secrets, and all my wives live there. If others find out about it, they will definitely hunt me down."
"I’m not someone with a big mouth, okay?" Long Yuxi pouted. "Quick! Send me to your private training ground, and I’ll start my training right away."
Long Yuxi rushed into the training space as soon as Zhang Fei opened the portal, and he closed it again soon after. "Are you going back to that place?"
"No," Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "Those creatures have invaded many domains, so I’ll be traveling around to monitor them, and I’ll inform you if anything changes."
After Guang Zhiyi disappeared, Zhang Fei entered the training space because he wanted to talk to Long Yuxi about her bloodline.

When he arrived inside, Zhang Fei saw Long Yuxi standing in a daze while watching Puyang Yeyu and the others who were practicing using the gravity feature. He explained to her about the gravity feature, which made her excited.
Long Yuxi wanted to rush to train with all the women, but Zhang Fei dragged her into the pavilion, which confused her.

Long Yuxi was shocked to find so many women in the pavilion, but their cultivation was too weak compared to hers. She had to admit that they were beautiful, but she didn’t feel jealous of them because she was a demihuman.

All the women also looked at Long Yuxi; they were curious about her identity and the reason Zhang Fei brought her to the pavilion. After all, there were no demihuman women among them, and their husband had once said that he wasn’t interested in women from that race.
Long Yuxi tilted her head to the side. "Why did you bring me here?"
"Let’s talk about your dragon bloodline."
"My dragon bloodline?" Long Yuxi raised an eyebrow.
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "The Sky Dragon Bloodline in your body is the only one left in this universe, so I was wondering if you could share it with me."
Long Yuxi frowned as she stole glances at all the women. "Are you thinking about giving my dragon bloodline to one of them?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei pointed to Zhao Ziqin. "Regardless of her cultivation level, I think she is a suitable choice to receive your dragon bloodline."
Zhao Ziqin was surprised by that, but she also wanted to obtain a beast bloodline, and she would become stronger to help Zhang Fei.

Long Yuxi looked at Zhao Ziqin, propped her chin with one hand, and observed her seriously. "The Sky Dragon is related to the wind and light elements, and I can sense that her wind element is quite strong. Besides, she’s mastered the wind elemental law, which is very beneficial to her. She is indeed suitable for receiving my dragon bloodline, but I can’t give her too much."
"How many drops can you give her?"
"Ten drops maximum, or I will suffer the backlash."
"I think ten drops is enough." Zhang Fei pointed at Shen Yu and Zhong Yan. "Can you sense their bloodlines?"
"Hmm?" Long Yuxi looked at the two women before becoming surprised. "Oh? One of them is a sea serpent with the rain dragon bloodline, and the other is a human with the thunder dragon bloodline."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded. "They obtained ten drops of both bloodlines in the past."
"I see." Long Yuxi looked at all the women one by one, but her gaze fell on Zhang Chen. "Huh? She is a light dragon, right?"
Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Chen. "She used to be a human, but I used a special method to turn her into a light dragon."

"How can you transform a human into a dragon?" Long Yuxi was genuinely curious about it. "Previously, Guang Zhiyi told me that you turned Zhang Lingxue into a Phoenix-Devourer Demon Beast, so I was curious about that."
"Zhang Lingxue and Zhang Chen are just two of them." Zhang Fei asked his other wives to come forward. "They used to be human too, but I turned them into beasts."

Long Yuxi took a deep breath and looked at Zhang Fei with a strange gaze. Turning one human woman into a beast was already beyond common sense, yet he turned so many human women into beasts. "Are you thinking of turning that one wife of yours into the Sky Dragon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1854: The Sky Dragon Corpse III
paragraphs: Zhang Fei thought for a moment before answering Long Yuxi, "I want to transform Zhao Ziqin into a dragon, but I can’t do that by using your sky dragon bloodline, and I need some body parts from the real sky dragon."
"Which body parts do you need?"

Zhang Fei told Long Yuxi all the parts he needed to turn Zhao Ziqin into a sky dragon. "The most important part is the dragon core and the origin bloodline, and she won’t be able to turn into a sky dragon without them."

"The origin bloodline and the dragon core." Long Yuxi muttered before taking both of them out of her storage ring. She held a bottle containing the sky dragon origin bloodline in her left hand and a white dragon core in her right hand.
"Holy shit!" Zhang Fei exclaimed. "They are the sky dragon’s origin bloodline and dragon core, right?"

"That’s right." Long Yuxi nodded. "My late great-grandfather obtained the origin bloodline and the dragon core from a sky dragon. Since he couldn’t use the dragon core, he kept it as a family treasure. He inherited the sky dragon bloodline from the dragon, and it was passed down from generation to generation, down to my generation."
Zhang Fei looked at her. "Unfortunately, you don’t have the sky dragon’s body parts, so these two items are useless."
"Who says I don’t have the sky dragon’s body parts?"
"Oh? Do you really have them?"
"I don’t have them now, but—" Long Yuxi waved her hand and created a qi screen, showing a ruined temple. "That’s the ruined Sky Dragon Temple, and there is a whole sky dragon’s corpse there."
Zhang Fei’s eyes lit up after seeing the sky dragon’s corpse encased in ice. "Who preserved that corpse?"

"My late great-grandfather, of course." Zhang Fei looked at Long Yuxi. "In the past, he was the best ice element user in my clan, and he preserved the sky dragon’s corpse in ice after it gave him the origin bloodline and dragon core."
"So, your late great-grandfather lived in the era before the past calamity?"

"No." Long Yuxi shook her head. "My late great-grandfather lived in the era after the calamity, and he was an explorer. He accidentally discovered the ruined temple, and he met a dying sky dragon there. After the dragon died, he preserved its corpse as a token of gratitude."
"Are you willing to give the sky dragon’s corpse to me? After all, the sky dragon is your family’s benefactor, right?"

Long Yuxi looked at Zhang Chen and the other female beasts. "Since you can turn female humans into female beasts, I will give the sky dragon’s corpse to you. This way, the sky dragon will exist once again in this universe, and it’s much better than having its corpse stored in the temple."
"How do we get to the ruined temple?"
"Let’s get out of here first."
Zhang Fei pulled Zhao Ziqin beside him before taking the two women out of the training space.
The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley
After taking out a white medallion, Long Yuxi immediately enveloped Zhang Fei and Zhao Ziqin with her aura. "This medallion will take us to the Sky Dragon Temple directly."
"Oh? Where did you get this medallion?"

"My late great-grandfather’s old friend was an artifact crafter, and he crafted this medallion for him in the past. He left it to us so we can go to the temple whenever we want to check the sky dragon’s corpse." Long Yuxi looked at them. "Are you ready? Our journey will be really fast, and it will probably make you both nauseous the first time."
"You don’t need to worry about that." Zhang Fei channeled his light element into Zhao Ziqin’s body to prevent her from experiencing nausea. "Let’s go now."
"Alright." As soon as Long Yuxi activated the medallion, a white light enveloped them, and they shot high into the sky.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Sky Dragon Island, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

"Ugh!" Even though Zhang Fei had already used his light element on her, Zhao Ziqin experienced extreme nausea as soon as they arrived at the place. "The effect was worse than when you took me away using your Nine Cloud Steps the first time, husband."

"Here." Zhang Fei put a pill in Zhao Ziqin’s mouth, and she immediately swallowed it. "Whoever created that medallion is truly extraordinary, Yuxi! I have two rank-ten artifact crafters by my side, but they can’t create such an artifact."

"Heh! That person was the greatest artifact crafter of his era, and no one can match him to this day." Long Yuxi pointed forward. "Look! The sky dragon’s corpse is stored there, so we have to go there now."
"Let’s go."
Although the entire area was in ruins, Zhang Fei was intrigued by the sight of it, and he came up with the idea of rebuilding it. "What do you think if we live here in the future, wife?"
"Huh?" Zhao Ziqin looked at him in surprise. "Didn’t you want to live in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley? Why did you suddenly get the idea to live here?"
Long Yuxi was also curious. "Do you really want to live on this Sky Dragon Island?"
"This island is not part of any domain, right?"

"That’s right." Long Yuxi nodded. "This Sky Dragon Island is similar to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and this island is separated from all other domains. As far as I remember, no cultivators in this Ancient Realm know of this place, so I can say it’s very safe."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Despite the ruin, I believe this place will be very comfortable for us to live in the future. This island is quite spacious, and we just need to rebuild everything according to our preferences. I just need to install a teleportation portal here, and I will connect it to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley so we can go back and forth between the two domains."
"Won’t that bring you trouble?"

Zhang Fei shook his head at Long Yuxi. "Did you forget that the people I will bring to the domain are my closest people? I’ve already selected them, and I believe they won’t bring me trouble. Even if they bring me trouble in the future, I just need to kill them."
"Why is your brain filled with killing people?"

"You’re wrong," Zhang Fei denied it. "I’m not a cold-blooded killer, but I will kill all the traitors. They are people from the Three Immortal Realms and the Paradise Realm, and they wouldn’t have been able to leave this realm without me. If they dare betray me after I’ve given them such a good opportunity, I will certainly never forgive them, and I will kill them instantly."
Long Yuxi nodded in understanding. "As long as they are not innocent people, and they commit such mistakes, they really deserve to die."
"By the way, do you have a family?"

"My family died long ago, and I’m the only one left of my clan." Zhang Fei and Zhao Ziqin looked at Long Yuxi in shock. "Alright, you don’t need to be curious about that matter, and they’ve been dead for a long time. Moreover, I’ve killed the people who killed them, and I sacrificed their blood on their graves."
"I see."
"By the way, how many people did you kill to make your killing intent surpass Old Meng’s?"

Zhang Fei scratched his head. "I don’t remember the number of my victims, but they were definitely more than Meng Huo’s. Not all of my victims were human, and they came from various races, especially the demon race."
"Oh." Long Yuxi nodded and quickened her pace.
Soon, they arrived at the deepest area of the ruined Sky Dragon Temple, where the frozen sky dragon corpse was located.

The sky dragon has a magnificent body that embodies the infinite sky itself. Its body is an extremely long and overwhelmingly muscular one, with perfect white scales that glitter like countless stars under the clear sky.

Its neck is long and thick, supporting a majestic dragon head adorned with a pair of towering horns that curve backwards. Two long whiskers hang from either side of its snout, accompanied by a neatly grown beard beneath its chin. A flowing mane of silky white hair extends from the crown of its head to the tip of its tail.

Its body is covered by countless overlapping white scales with faint silver edges, each scale smooth, dense, and naturally polished like flawless heavenly jade. Beneath its scales hides an incredibly powerful physique, with broad shoulders, a deep chest, and thick limbs that gradually taper into sharp five-clawed feet.

"This dragon is beautiful, husband." Zhao Ziqin looked at the frozen dragon corpse in awe. "I’ve often seen Grandma Chen’s light dragon form, and this dragon is no less beautiful than her dragon form."
Zhang Fei hugged her waist. "Do you want to be a sky dragon, wife?"

"Yes," Zhao Ziqin nodded without hesitation, staring in fascination at the dragon corpse in front of her. "By the way, why don’t you turn Sister Zhong Yan and Sister Shen Yu into true dragons like you turned Grandma Chen into a light dragon, husband?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I killed the rain dragon, so I couldn’t turn Shen Yu into a true dragon. Zhong Yan didn’t want to turn into a thunder dragon, and she was satisfied with being a human with a thunder dragon bloodline."
"Oh." Zhao Ziqin nodded in understanding.
Long Yuxi walked beside Zhang Fei. "Can you melt the ice? I don’t have the ice element, so I can’t do it."
*Swoosh*
Huo Ling suddenly emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "Husband, you can prepare everything, and I’ll take the dragon corpse out of this ice."

chapters.title: Chapter 1855: Zhao Ziqin - The Sky Dragon I
paragraphs: "Give me the Sky Dragon Origin Bloodline and Dragon Core."
Long Yuxi handed both to Zhang Fei. "Are you going to transform her into a dragon here?"

"We’ll return to my training space after Huo Ling melts the ice." Zhang Fei squeezed Zhao Ziqin’s hand gently. "Be patient! You’ll soon become the next celestial dragon, and you’ll become even stronger."

"Yes," Zhao Ziqin responded to Zhang Fei with a smile, and she was impatient to transform into the sky dragon. After all, there are no more sky dragons in their universe, and she will become the only sky dragon soon.
"Do you still need ten drops of my bloodline?" Long Yuxi asked.

Zhang Fei was actually interested in having the sky dragon bloodline, but he didn’t need to ask Long Yuxi. After Zhao Ziqin transforms into the new sky dragon, he can ask her to give him a few drops of her bloodline.
Zhang Fei shook his head at Long Yuxi. "Compared to your bloodline, I’m more interested in having you as my woman."
"Shameless!" Long Yuxi cursed while punching his arm. "We’ve only known each other for a day, and you don’t even know me yet, yet you dare say such things to me."
"Haha," Zhang Fei shrugged. "I’m a lust demon, so it’s natural that I’m shameless, right? In fact, I knew several of my wives for a day, and they became my wives that very day."

Zhao Ziqin smiled to herself after hearing that. In the past, she met Zhang Fei when he infiltrated the Zhao Clan as a little white fox, and he did lewd things to her at that time. She didn’t reject him; instead, she enjoyed their initial moments together.
If it weren’t for their intimate actions that day, Zhao Ziqin wouldn’t have dared to defy her parents and leave with Zhang Fei, and she would have already married Xuan Yu.
Apart from her, Zhao Ziqin knew that some of her sisters became their husband’s wives, even though they had only met for a day, such as Liu Hua, Tang Zhiyu, and several other women.
Long Yuxi massaged her forehead. "Lust demons are lustful and shameless!"
"Did Feng Yao tell you about the Lotus Limbo World?"
"Huh?" Long Yuxi looked at Zhang Fei in confusion. "The Lotus Limbo World? What kind of place is that?"
"You can think of the Lotus Limbo World as hell."
"Hell?" Long Yuxi was getting more and more confused.
To avoid further confusing Long Yuxi, Zhang Fei created a qi screen that displayed the Lotus Limbo World. "See? That place is like hell, right?"

"That place is truly terrifying!" Long Yuxi couldn’t help but feel a chill run down her spine when she saw those wandering souls inside the Lotus Limbo World. Her eyes widened when she saw the female demon guarding the place. "What kind of place is that? How did those souls get in there? Who is that female demon?"

Zhang Fei sighed. "The souls of dead evil cultivators will be sent to the Lotus Limbo World, where they will experience various kinds of terrible tortures. Meanwhile, the souls of virtuous cultivators who have died will be sent to the Lotus Luminous World, where they can enter the cycle of reincarnation or remain there."
"The Lotus Luminous World?"

"I’ve never seen the Lotus Luminous World, so I can’t show it to you. However, the two spirits of the lotus said that it was like a paradise for dead souls, which is the opposite of the Lotus Limbo World."
"Lotus? Which lotus?"

"The Giant Yin-Yang Lotus." Zhang Fei waved his hand, changing the image on the qi screen to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain. "That’s the lotus! It maintains the balance between Yin and Yang in this universe, and this universe will perish if it dies."

Long Yuxi stared at the qi screen in a daze, which made her look like a frog in a well. She had lived for so long, but she never knew about the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus, the Lotus Luminous World, or the Lotus Limbo World. Yet, Zhang Fei, who was much younger, knew about those three places.
"Did Guang—Feng Yao tell you about those three places?"

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head. "I learned about the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus from one of my wives because her ancestors had seen it, and I managed to find the entrance by accident. When I found the lotus, it was in a weak state, so I often brought all my women to cultivate there, allowing the lotus to absorb our yin and yang qi. Would you like to go to that domain and see the lotus?"
Long Yuxi thought for a moment before nodding to him. "Let’s finish things here first, and you can take me to that domain afterward."
"Alright." Zhang Fei looked at her thoughtfully.
Long Yuxi raised an eyebrow, sensing his strange gaze. "Why are you looking at me like that?"
"It seems my guess was correct; you are the representative of the demihuman race."
"Huh? What do you mean by that?"
Zhang Fei sighed. "This universe seems fine to everyone, but in reality, it’s not doing well. It’s in a critical condition, and the appearance of those shadowy creatures is proof of that."
"Are you saying that those shadowy creatures are trying to destroy this universe?" Long Yuxi’s tone became deep and serious.
"That’s right." Zhang Fei changed the image on the qi screen again. "See that creature? That thing is the core creature, and it controls countless shadowy creatures."

"Shit!" Long Yuxi felt like all the scales on her body were standing up after watching the core creature destroy the Changxuan Domain. "I’ve never met another living creature as powerful as that creature before."
"Even Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi were frightened when they saw them."
"Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi are both primordial beasts, right?" Zhang Fei nodded to Long Yuxi. "If they’re both afraid of those creatures, then how are we supposed to defeat them?"
"The only way to defeat them is to gather representatives from all six races, and they will help me defeat the core creature."
"Six races?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei displayed images of four women on the qi screen. "They are my wives, and you have met them before. Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race; Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race; Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race, and Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race. Feng Yao said that the female demon in the Lotus Limbo World is the representative of the demon race, and you are the representative of the demihuman race."

Long Yuxi fell silent after Zhang Fei said all that; her brain was having difficulty processing all the information he conveyed just now. Moreover, the demihuman race has countless races in it, but he said that she is the representative of his race.
Furthermore, four of the six women were Zhang Fei’s wives, which made her think that he also wanted to take her as his wife.
Long Yuxi looked at him with an irritated look; even her next question was filled with anger. "Are you telling me all this because you want me to be your wife?"

"Hey! I’m telling you all this because this universe is in danger, and it will be destroyed if those creatures manage to take over everything." Zhang Fei shook his head with a serious look. "If I want some women from the demihuman race as my wives, I can find many of them in the Heavenly Mistveil Domain. The one who said that you are the representative of the demihuman race is not me but Feng Yao."

Zhao Ziqin tried to mediate between them. "Senior Long, you might not believe me, but many women from the demihuman race are lining up to be his wives, and one of them is the Princess of the Heavenly Mistveil Domain. If he wants a few wives from that race, he only needs to choose a few women, and they will throw themselves into his arms."
"Why are you so proud of your husband having so many wives?" Long Yuxi’s tone turned irritated.

"Hehe," Zhao Ziqin giggled. "Even though my husband has so many wives, he’s always fair to us and treats us equally. Besides, he’s a lust demon and a dragon, and we’re always overwhelmed with his prowess in bed, so we have no problem with him having more wives."
"Damn it! You are as shameless as your husband!" Long Yuxi cursed loudly.
Zhao Ziqin smiled and teased her. "Do you want to watch my husband’s prowess in bed, Senior Long?"
"Shameless!" Despite her anger, Long Yuxi was actually curious about it because Zhang Fei had over one hundred wives. "Is the lotus strong now?"

Zhang Fei nodded. "The lotus has gotten quite strong after we helped it over the past few years, but it will weaken again if those creatures become more aggressive. If you don’t believe me, you can ask the two spirits later."
"Alright, I’ll ask them later." Long Yuxi looked at the ice. "The ice has almost completely melted."
"To prevent the corpse from burning, Huo Ling was forced to carefully melt the ice; otherwise, it would have completely melted long ago."

A few minutes later, the ice encasing the sky dragon’s corpse had completely melted. "Bring this corpse into your training space, husband. You can take some of its body parts that you need to transform Zhao Ziqin into a sky dragon, and you should keep the rest."
"Let’s go."
Once they arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Fei took some body parts from the Sky Dragon’s corpse, and he also took out the science capsule.
After she removed her dress, Zhao Ziqin hurriedly entered the capsule, and Zhang Fei inserted all the body parts into the ten holes. ’Start the process, Mei.’
[Yes, Master.]

Besides, he’s a lust demon and a dragon, and we’re always overwhelmed with his prowess in bed, so we have no problem with him having more wives."
"Damn it!
You are as shameless as your husband!" Long Yuxi cursed loudly.
Zhao Ziqin smiled and teased her.
"Do you want to watch my husband’s prowess in bed, Senior Long?"
"Shameless!" Despite her anger, Long Yuxi was actually curious about it because Zhang Fei had over one hundred wives.
"Is the lotus strong now?"
Zhang Fei nodded.
"The lotus has gotten quite strong after we helped it over the past few years, but it will weaken again if those creatures become more aggressive.
If you don’t believe me, you can ask the two spirits later."
"Alright, I’ll ask them later." Long Yuxi looked at the ice.
"The ice has almost completely melted."
"To prevent the corpse from burning, Huo Ling was forced to carefully melt the ice; otherwise, it would have completely melted long ago."
A few minutes later, the ice encasing the sky dragon’s corpse had completely melted.
"Bring this corpse into your training space, husband.
You can take some of its body parts that you need to transform Zhao Ziqin into a sky dragon, and you should keep the rest."
"Let’s go."
Once they arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Fei took some body parts from the Sky Dragon’s corpse, and he also took out the science capsule.
After she removed her dress, Zhao Ziqin hurriedly entered the capsule, and Zhang Fei inserted all the body parts into the ten holes. ’Start the process, Mei.’
[Yes, Master.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1856: Zhao Ziqin - The Sky Dragon II
paragraphs: "Hey! Where did you get such an artifact? Can this artifact really turn your wife into the sky dragon?" Long Yuxi pointed at the science capsule; she had never seen such an artifact in her life.

Zhang Fei glanced at her. "I got this artifact from a friend, and I transformed several of my wives into female beasts using it. You may still have doubts about it, but you will know the result once the process is complete."
"Oh." Long Yuxi looked at the women. "Which of them did you just mention as the representatives of the four races?"
Zhang Fei called Luo Yunxiao, Jia Yuyan, Tianshi Shengjie, and Xu Ling’er before them, introducing them to Long Yuxi.

Long Yuxi watched the four women carefully, but she felt that Jia Yuyan and Xu Ling’er were too weak. As for Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengji, their cultivation was already close to breaking through to the Celestial Venerable Realm, and they should be able to break through to that stage earlier than Zhang Fei.
"Ling’er’s cultivation is the lowest among them because she started cultivating a few days after me, and she’s the youngest among all my wives."
Without Zhang Fei saying it, Long Yuxi could see that Xu Ling’er was indeed very young. However, her cultivation had already reached the Celestial King Realm, which was simply unbelievable.
"Jia Yuyan’s cultivation should have been on par with Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie, but the former fairy king sent her to the Three Mortal Realms, which hampered her development."
Luo Yunxiao hugged his arm and asked, "Is Senior Long the representative of the demihuman race, Husband?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "According to Feng Yao, Long Yuxi is the representative of the demihuman race, so I brought her here to train at the training ground."
"There are so many demihuman races in the Paradise Realm, but they can’t compare to Senior Long, including Long Huoyan and his two daughters," Tianshi Shengjie said.
"I agree with you." Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement with her. "Senior Long’s aura is much stronger and more intense than the three of them."
Xu Ling’er smiled faintly, walked beside Long Yuxi, and hugged her arm. "Senior Long, can you turn into a human?"

"Huh?" Long Yuxi turned to her in confusion. "I have a special transformation technique, so it’s not difficult for me to transform into a human. However, I rarely use it, and I’m more comfortable in my demihuman form."

Long Yuxi activated her transformation technique, and a bright white light enveloped her body for a few minutes before disappearing again. Her appearance didn’t change much compared to before, but her dragon head turned into a human head, and all her dragon scales disappeared completely.

Luo Yunxiao nudged Zhang Fei’s arm. ’Her human form is a peerless beauty, husband. She hasn’t taken your two beauty pills yet, but she’s already this beautiful. I want her to be our sister, so you should move fast to get her.’

Tianshi Shengjie and Jia Yuyan looked at Luo Yunxiao; they could guess her intentions from her glance at Long Yuxi. They didn’t question her, and instead, they supported Zhang Fei if he wanted to take the female dragon demihuman as his new wife.

After all, their husband had over a hundred wives, and Long Yuxi was the woman chosen as the representative of the demihuman race to assist him. Besides, her cultivation was already so high, and her beauty was not inferior to theirs, so they hoped she would join them.
Xu Ling’er’s eyes sparkled. "Senior Long, your demihuman form is already beautiful, but your human form is even more beautiful."

"Haha," Long Yuxi laughed. "You’re wrong, little girl. I don’t have a human form, and I can only transform into one using a transformation technique. As for this figure, she was an old friend of mine from the human race, but she died long ago due to wrong cultivation."
"Wrong cultivation?"

Long Yuxi turned sad remembering that. "My old friend found a technique left behind by the ancients, but she didn’t realize that the technique was deliberately written in reverse. As a result, her cultivation became chaotic, and her foundation collapsed, which led to her death. At that time, I was still in seclusion, and she was already dead when I found her. She was my best friend, and I often use her form to remember her."
"Such a sad story," Xu Ling’er muttered softly. "Since she died so long ago, she should have been reincarnated by now, and she’s probably living a much better life."
Long Yuxi nodded slightly. "If she has been reincarnated, I hope she will live a better life, and I hope she will not repeat her past mistakes."
"Speaking of reincarnation, I suddenly remembered two people." Jia Yuyan turned to Zhang Fei. "Do you remember Tian Kongquan and Yan Huo, Husband?"

Zhang Fei naturally remembered those two people. Tian Kongquan was the ancestor of the Tian Clan, and he was one of the founders of the Sovereign Heaven Realm. As for Yan Huo, he was the one who protected the Sky Flame.

At that time, Tian Kongquan told Zhang Fei that he must break free from the shackles of the universe to become the strongest and defy the heavens. However, the old man was unaware that the shackles had been destroyed long ago, along with his death and resurrection, which were caused by Xuanyuan Yue.
A few months ago, Zhang Fei learned from Feng Yao that the shackles of the universe binding him had been destroyed, making him the only living creature in their universe who was no longer shackled.

Zhang Fei felt a sense of melancholy when he recalled his conversation with Tian Kongquan at that time. "I remember that old man told Senior Yan Huo that they would meet again in the future, and they would start their new adventure together. More than thirteen years have passed since then, and Senior Yan has probably reincarnated by now. That old man reincarnated long before him, but I don’t know where he lives, and I don’t know if they’ve reunited yet."
"Why don’t you ask Sister Yao? She should have a way to find their reincarnations, and you can bring them together."
Zhang Fei shook his head at Jia Yuyan. "Even if that old man has been reincarnated, he doesn’t necessarily have his past memories, so I won’t interfere in his life."
"Tian Kongquan?" Zhang Fei and the others turned to Long Yuxi. "Do you really know that person?"
"Do you know someone named Tian Kongquan, Senior Long?" Jia Yuyan asked in surprise.
"I do know someone named Tian Kongquan, but I don’t know if he’s the same person you’re referring to. After all, your acquaintance is long dead, right?"

"Yes," Jia Yuyan nodded at her. "He was one of the founders of the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and he died long ago. Several years ago, my husband and I met his soul remnant, and he said that he should have been reincarnated, but he didn’t tell us the location of his reincarnation."
"A person who knows that he has been reincarnated is definitely not an ordinary person." Long Yuxi mumbled to herself.

Jia Yuyan explained to her. "In the past, he could foresee the future, but his lifespan would decrease every time he used the ability. He told Senior Yan Huo that they would meet again in the future, so I’m curious about the outcome."
"I see." Long Yuxi created a qi screen and displayed a picture of a middle-aged man there. "He is my acquaintance, Tian Kongquan."
Jia Yuyan and Zhang Fei looked at the qi screen, but the figure of the middle-aged man was different from the Tian Kongquan they met in the Sovereign Heaven Realm many years ago.
"Perhaps they only share the same name, but they are two different people." Jia Yuyan said disappointedly.
Unlike her, Zhang Fei felt that the middle-aged man was the same Tian Kongquan, even though their faces and appearances were different. "Which domain does he live in?"
"The Qingyuan Domain, but it is very far from the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and we need at least three months to get there." Long Yuxi answered him.

"Three months, huh?" Zhang Fei shook his head slightly; he wanted to see Tian Kongquan, but he didn’t want to waste so much time just traveling to that domain. "I’ll ask Feng Yao to check on that person to see if he’s the same person."

"Hey! Can you take me to your beast space?" Zhang Fei looked at Long Yuxi in confusion. "I’m a demihuman, and I have a beast bloodline in me, remember? Even though I’m not a pure beast, I should be able to enter your beast space."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I’ve never brought a demihuman in there before, but I think we can try now. Moreover, Zhou Ziqin still needs a lot of time to transform into the sky dragon, so we can only wait for her to finish."
"Let’s go then."
"Wow! Your beast space is so beautiful!" Long Yuxi exclaimed in surprise. "Hmm? I sense something different in here, but I can’t pinpoint it."

As he led Long Yuxi, Zhang Fei explained to her a little about his beast space. "The flow of time in this place is several times faster than outside, and this place also has a restorative effect on all the beasts living within, allowing them to recover from their injuries more quickly."

’How many secrets does he actually have? No wonder he became so powerful at such a young age; he has too many advantages that no other cultivator possesses.’ Long Yuxi walked beside Zhang Fei, occasionally stealing glances at him. She also paid attention to the beasts cultivating in his space. ’They’re so serious about their cultivation, but this place does benefit them.’
"Oh? You brought her here, husband."

chapters.title: Chapter 1857: Zhao Ziqin - The Sky Dragon III
paragraphs: "The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon." Long Yuxi immediately recognized Long Wuzhao’s identity, and then she looked at Feng Yao. "How could he be here?"
Feng Yao pointed at Zhang Fei. "Since this place is my husband’s beast space, he brought Long Wuzhao here because the two primordial beasts were targeting him."

Long Yuxi didn’t expect that the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon would hide in the Calamity Demon Dragon’s beast space, which was simply absurd, considering that the two were old enemies. However, she remembered that Zhang Fei’s main identities were human, lust demon, and ten-tailed heavenly fox.
"Who is this woman, Empress Huo? What is her bloodline?" Ling Wuzhao asked, scanning Long Yuxi.
Feng Yao explained to him. "Her name is Long Xiyi, the holder of the last Sky Dragon Bloodline in this universe, and she is also the fourth strongest cultivator in the Ancient Realm."
Since he had obtained the memories of his predecessors, Long Wuzhao knew that the Sky Dragon Race and many other dragon races had already become extinct in the Ancient Realm, which he regretted.
"Why are you looking at me like that, Emperor Long?"
"Can you bring back the Sky Dragon Race, Zhang Fei?"
"In process."
"In process?"

"Yeah," Zhang Fei pointed at Long Yuxi. "She has the Sky Dragon’s origin bloodline, dragon core, and corpse. I used these three to transform one of my wives into the next Sky Dragon, and the process will be completed in a few hours."

Long Wuzhao remembered that Zhang Fei had turned Zhang Chen into a light dragon, and he had also turned several of his other wives into pure female beasts. "I’m relieved to hear that, and the Sky Dragon Race will exist again in this universe. Why don’t you look for the other extinct dragons? Empress Huo should be able to help you find them, right?"
"Are there still intact dragon corpses in this universe?"
Feng Yao nodded slightly. "Besides the Sky Dragon, there are two other intact dragon corpses."
"Which dragon races are they?"
"The Darkness Dragon and the Yin Dragon." Zhang Fei was more interested in the yin dragon than the darkness dragon. "Their corpses, origin bloodlines, and dragon cores are still intact."
"Where can I find their corpses?"

"The Yin Dragon corpse is in the Frozen Yin Domain, but you have to go deeper into that domain. As long as Huo Ling is with you, you can reach that place without any disturbance from those yin demons." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and planned to look for it. "As for the darkness dragon, you can’t go to that place for now."
"Why?"
"The darkness dragon corpse is in the Lotus Limbo World, and you are not ready to face that demoness."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "How did the darkness dragon corpse end up in that place? Was it because of you?"

"More or less," Feng Yao admitted his guess. "For now, you should go to the Frozen Yin Domain to retrieve the Yin Dragon corpse, and Yue Xuelian is the most suitable candidate to be the next Yin Dragon."
"Yue Xuelian or Yue Ningxue?"
"Both women are suitable, but I recommend Yue Xuelian more. Her feelings for you are more sincere than Yue Ningxue’s, so she is the most suitable choice."
Zhang Fei agreed with Feng Yao. After all, Yue Xuelian chose to be with him based on her own choice, whereas Yue Ningxue chose to be with him because of the benefits he promised her.
Feng Yao looked at Long Yuxi. "His main opponent is much stronger than us, so you should train in his training space to improve yourself for now, and you will help him in his future battle."
"I will definitely train hard."
After chatting with Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao for some time, Zhang Fei took Long Yuxi out of his beast space and returned to the pavilion.

Upon arriving at the pavilion, Long Yuxi didn’t immediately head to the training ground. She chose to wait for Zhao Ziqin’s transformation into the Sky Dragon while chatting with all of Zhang Fei’s wives.

"Xuelian." Yue Xuelian turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately explained to her about the Yin Dragon. "You and Yue Ningxue are the most suitable for it, but I prefer you to be the next Yin Dragon rather than her."
Since she was also there, Yue Ningxue couldn’t help but be jealous of Yue Xuelian. However, she was aware of their difference in status, and the latter was more sincere towards Zhang Fei.
Yue Xuelian briefly glanced at Yue Ningxue before nodding to Zhang Fei. "Since you have arranged it like that, I will follow your decision, husband."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei looked at the science capsule. "After Zhao Ziqin is finished, I will take Huo Ling to the Yin Frozen Domain to retrieve the Yin Dragon corpse."
"Can you take me to the Yin Frozen Domain?"
"Alright, I’ll take you with us later."
’Why haven’t you taken Yue Ningxue as your woman yet, husband?’
Zhang Fei glanced at Yue Ningxue before answering Yue Xuelian. ’Her pride is still high, so I will wait for her to completely submit to me.’

Yue Xuelian was quite familiar with Yue Ningxue’s character, and the latter had been at the top for a long time, so it was natural that her pride was still high. However, her pride had begun to crumble, though not entirely, and it was only a matter of time before it completely crumbled.
Zhang Fei approached Long Yuxi, who continued to observe the science capsule impatiently. He sat beside her and asked, "Why are you so impatient?"

"The Sky Dragon is my race’s benefactor, and I managed to reach this stage because I inherited its bloodline, so I can’t wait for its return." Long Yuxi tilted her head to the side. "Since you can turn human females into beast females, why don’t you turn all your wives into female beasts?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "Some of them want to become female beasts, but some of them reject the idea. They are my wives, but I don’t want to control them, and they can make their own decisions about their lives."
"No wonder they’re willing to share you with so many of them." Long Yuxi muttered, looking at all the women.
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed. "Are you willing to be one of them?"

"Dream on!" Long Yuxi snorted. "Even though you are strong, and I am not your opponent, I still have my principles. If you want me to be your woman, you must work hard to win my heart, but it won’t be easy. If you dare use your lust demon abilities on me, I will immediately commit suicide."
Zhang Fei scratched his head as he thought about using his lust demon abilities on Long Yuxi, and her words forced him to abandon his intention. "Hey, do you think Meng Huo will betray us?"

"Meng Huo’s mindset is difficult to predict, and his behavior often changes for no apparent reason." Long Yuxi paused. "Do you know the reason there are only four of the past ten strongest cultivators left?"
"Did Meng Huo kill them?"
"He killed two of them, and the rest died of natural causes."
"Why did he kill them?"

"Ambition, prestige, and selfishness." Zhang Fei frowned. "Those people challenged Meng Huo for his position, and he killed them. Since their deaths, several new cultivators have entered the ranks, but their strength is far inferior to ours."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "All cultivators have their own ambitions, including me. However, many of them have excessive ambitions, but not all of them succeed in achieving their ambitions, and they ultimately die because of their own ambitions."

"That’s right." Long Yuxi sighed. "In the past, the strength of the top ten cultivators was almost equal, with Guang Zhiyi being the strongest among us. Everything changed after she died and the Eternal Flame disappeared, which ended with the death of the other five."
"So, you mean Feng Yao was in control of the situation at that time?"

"That’s right." Long Yuxi nodded to him. "After Guan Zhiyi died, the situation in the Ancient Realm slowly changed, and the number of cultivators who died continued to increase every year. So, what is your ambition?"

"My ambition is not grandiose." Zhang Fei looked at all his wives with a smile. "I want to live freely without restraints, and I will enjoy my life with all my wives. Once I become the strongest, I will impregnate them, and I will focus my time on making them happy."
"Is that your only ambition?"

"What else?" Zhang Fei shrugged. "In this universe, nothing matters to me except all my wives. I cultivate to become strong, not for myself, but I do everything for them. When I succeed in reaching the peak of cultivation, we will withdraw from the world of cultivation and enjoy our time together."

"I see." Long Yuxi fell silent after hearing that. "As long as you are the strongest, you can definitely make that happen. Unlike you, I don’t dare to dream like that because I am aware of my limitations, and I will never be the strongest in this universe."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei and Long Yuxi chatted about many other things for several hours until the science capsule stopped operating, which meant Zhao Ziqin’s transformation was complete.
Zhang Fei immediately opened the capsule’s lid, woke Zhao Ziqin, and helped him out. "How do you feel, wife?"
Long Yuxi and Zhang Fei’s other wives were also curious about Zhao Ziqing’s changes, especially her Sky Dragon form.

Zhao Ziqin looked at them with a smile before jumping away from them, and she immediately transformed into her dragon form. Her dragon form wasn’t much different from the Sky Dragon’s corpse on Sky Dragon Island, but her body was slightly smaller and slimmer. "What do you guys think of my changes?"
