Since he had obtained the memories of his predecessors, Long Wuzhao knew that the Sky Dragon Race and many other dragon races had already become extinct in the Ancient Realm, which he regretted.
"Why are you looking at me like that, Emperor Long?"
"Can you bring back the Sky Dragon Race, Zhang Fei?"
"In process."
"In process?"
"Yeah," Zhang Fei pointed at Long Yuxi.
"She has the Sky Dragon’s origin bloodline, dragon core, and corpse.
I used these three to transform one of my wives into the next Sky Dragon, and the process will be completed in a few hours."
Long Wuzhao remembered that Zhang Fei had turned Zhang Chen into a light dragon, and he had also turned several of his other wives into pure female beasts.
"I’m relieved to hear that, and the Sky Dragon Race will exist again in this universe.
Why don’t you look for the other extinct dragons?
Empress Huo should be able to help you find them, right?"
"Are there still intact dragon corpses in this universe?"
Feng Yao nodded slightly.
"Besides the Sky Dragon, there are two other intact dragon corpses."
"Which dragon races are they?"
"The Darkness Dragon and the Yin Dragon." Zhang Fei was more interested in the yin dragon than the darkness dragon.
"Their corpses, origin bloodlines, and dragon cores are still intact."
"Where can I find their corpses?"
"The Yin Dragon corpse is in the Frozen Yin Domain, but you have to go deeper into that domain.
As long as Huo Ling is with you, you can reach that place without any disturbance from those yin demons." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and planned to look for it.
"As for the darkness dragon, you can’t go to that place for now."
"Why?"
"The darkness dragon corpse is in the Lotus Limbo World, and you are not ready to face that demoness."
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow.
"How did the darkness dragon corpse end up in that place?
Was it because of you?"
"More or less," Feng Yao admitted his guess.
"For now, you should go to the Frozen Yin Domain to retrieve the Yin Dragon corpse, and Yue Xuelian is the most suitable candidate to be the next Yin Dragon."
"Yue Xuelian or Yue Ningxue?"
"Both women are suitable, but I recommend Yue Xuelian more.
Her feelings for you are more sincere than Yue Ningxue’s, so she is the most suitable choice."
Zhang Fei agreed with Feng Yao.
After all, Yue Xuelian chose to be with him based on her own choice, whereas Yue Ningxue chose to be with him because of the benefits he promised her.
Feng Yao looked at Long Yuxi.
"His main opponent is much stronger than us, so you should train in his training space to improve yourself for now, and you will help him in his future battle."
"I will definitely train hard."
After chatting with Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao for some time, Zhang Fei took Long Yuxi out of his beast space and returned to the pavilion.
Upon arriving at the pavilion, Long Yuxi didn’t immediately head to the training ground.
She chose to wait for Zhao Ziqin’s transformation into the Sky Dragon while chatting with all of Zhang Fei’s wives.
"Xuelian." Yue Xuelian turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately explained to her about the Yin Dragon.
"You and Yue Ningxue are the most suitable for it, but I prefer you to be the next Yin Dragon rather than her."
Since she was also there, Yue Ningxue couldn’t help but be jealous of Yue Xuelian.
However, she was aware of their difference in status, and the latter was more sincere towards Zhang Fei.
Yue Xuelian briefly glanced at Yue Ningxue before nodding to Zhang Fei.
"Since you have arranged it like that, I will follow your decision, husband."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei looked at the science capsule.
"After Zhao Ziqin is finished, I will take Huo Ling to the Yin Frozen Domain to retrieve the Yin Dragon corpse."
"Can you take me to the Yin Frozen Domain?"
"Alright, I’ll take you with us later."
’Why haven’t you taken Yue Ningxue as your woman yet, husband?’
Zhang Fei glanced at Yue Ningxue before answering Yue Xuelian. ’Her pride is still high, so I will wait for her to completely submit to me.’
Yue Xuelian was quite familiar with Yue Ningxue’s character, and the latter had been at the top for a long time, so it was natural that her pride was still high.
However, her pride had begun to crumble, though not entirely, and it was only a matter of time before it completely crumbled.
Zhang Fei approached Long Yuxi, who continued to observe the science capsule impatiently.
He sat beside her and asked, "Why are you so impatient?"
"The Sky Dragon is my race’s benefactor, and I managed to reach this stage because I inherited its bloodline, so I can’t wait for its return." Long Yuxi tilted her head to the side.
"Since you can turn human females into beast females, why don’t you turn all your wives into female beasts?"
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"Some of them want to become female beasts, but some of them reject the idea.
They are my wives, but I don’t want to control them, and they can make their own decisions about their lives."
"No wonder they’re willing to share you with so many of them." Long Yuxi muttered, looking at all the women.
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"Are you willing to be one of them?"
"Dream on!" Long Yuxi snorted.
"Even though you are strong, and I am not your opponent, I still have my principles.
If you want me to be your woman, you must work hard to win my heart, but it won’t be easy.
If you dare use your lust demon abilities on me, I will immediately commit suicide."
Zhang Fei scratched his head as he thought about using his lust demon abilities on Long Yuxi, and her words forced him to abandon his intention.
"Hey, do you think Meng Huo will betray us?"
"Meng Huo’s mindset is difficult to predict, and his behavior often changes for no apparent reason." Long Yuxi paused.
"Do you know the reason there are only four of the past ten strongest cultivators left?"
"Did Meng Huo kill them?"
"He killed two of them, and the rest died of natural causes."
"Why did he kill them?"
"Ambition, prestige, and selfishness." Zhang Fei frowned.
"Those people challenged Meng Huo for his position, and he killed them.
Since their deaths, several new cultivators have entered the ranks, but their strength is far inferior to ours."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"All cultivators have their own ambitions, including me.
However, many of them have excessive ambitions, but not all of them succeed in achieving their ambitions, and they ultimately die because of their own ambitions."
"That’s right." Long Yuxi sighed.
"In the past, the strength of the top ten cultivators was almost equal, with Guang Zhiyi being the strongest among us.
Everything changed after she died and the Eternal Flame disappeared, which ended with the death of the other five."
"So, you mean Feng Yao was in control of the situation at that time?"
"That’s right." Long Yuxi nodded to him.
"After Guan Zhiyi died, the situation in the Ancient Realm slowly changed, and the number of cultivators who died continued to increase every year.
So, what is your ambition?"
"My ambition is not grandiose." Zhang Fei looked at all his wives with a smile.
"I want to live freely without restraints, and I will enjoy my life with all my wives.
Once I become the strongest, I will impregnate them, and I will focus my time on making them happy."
"Is that your only ambition?"
"What else?" Zhang Fei shrugged.
"In this universe, nothing matters to me except all my wives.
I cultivate to become strong, not for myself, but I do everything for them.
When I succeed in reaching the peak of cultivation, we will withdraw from the world of cultivation and enjoy our time together."
"I see." Long Yuxi fell silent after hearing that.
"As long as you are the strongest, you can definitely make that happen.
Unlike you, I don’t dare to dream like that because I am aware of my limitations, and I will never be the strongest in this universe."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei and Long Yuxi chatted about many other things for several hours until the science capsule stopped operating, which meant Zhao Ziqin’s transformation was complete.
Zhang Fei immediately opened the capsule’s lid, woke Zhao Ziqin, and helped him out.
"How do you feel, wife?"
Long Yuxi and Zhang Fei’s other wives were also curious about Zhao Ziqing’s changes, especially her Sky Dragon form.
Zhao Ziqin looked at them with a smile before jumping away from them, and she immediately transformed into her dragon form.
Her dragon form wasn’t much different from the Sky Dragon’s corpse on Sky Dragon Island, but her body was slightly smaller and slimmer.
"What do you guys think of my changes?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1858: Frozen Underground Cave I
paragraphs: Long Yuxi looked at Zhao Ziqin’s dragon form with deep emotion; her dream of bringing the Sky Dragon Race back to the universe had finally come true.

Moreover, Zhao Ziqin was Zhang Fei’s wife, and Long Yuxi believed the Sky Dragon Race would fill the skies of their universe again in the future. ’Ancestor, you can rest in peace now; your promise to our benefactor has been fulfilled. In the future, this woman will give birth to many children for her husband. Even if their future offspring are not pure Sky Dragons, they will be born as half-dragons.’

"Wow!" Wu Lianzhi exclaimed with sparkling eyes. "There are six true dragons in our family now! Grandma Chen is a Light Dragon, Big Six Ru Xue is a Celestial Demon Dragon, Big Sis Tianshi Shengjie is a Celestial Dragon, Big Sis Long Shenxia is a Flame Dragon, Big Sis Shi Wu is an Azure Dragon, and Big Sis Zhao Ziqin is a Sky Dragon!"
Xu Ling’er nodded in agreement. "Big Brother Fei also has Long Jishan as his contract beast, and he is a Thunder Dragon."

"Did you both forget about her?" Chu Qing pointed at Boitata. "Big Sis Boitata is a dragon-serpent, remember? Meanwhile, Zhang Lin is an Abyssal Leviathan Dragon. Even though they are not pure dragons, they are still dragons."
All the women agreed with Chu Qing, but they felt that Tianshi Shengjie’s Celestial Dragon form was the best among them, and her dragon form was simply too huge.

"After this, Yue Xuelian will also become a dragon." They turned to Zhang Fei, and their ears perked up. "Feng Yao told me that there’s still a complete Yin Dragon’s corpse in the Frozen Yin Domain, and I plan to go there to retrieve the corpse. After I get it, I will turn her into a Yin Dragon."
"Is there another complete dragon corpse, husband?" Chu Xing asked with hope in her eyes.
Zhang Fei pinched her nose. "There is another dragon corpse, but it doesn’t suit you, Xing’er. You are a light element possessor, and the dragon is a darkness dragon."
"Sigh!" Chu Xing dropped her shoulders in disappointment. "I don’t want to transform into a darkness dragon, but I want to transform into another dragon."

Zhang Fei looked at Tianshi Shengjie, who was the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race. "There are many types of dragons in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, so you can take her there to choose one that suits her. Since she is a light element possessor, the light dragon should be most suitable for her."
"No," Chu Xing rejected the idea. "Grandma Chen is a light dragon, so I don’t want to transform into one, and I want another dragon race."

"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed, seeing her pouted lips. "Why don’t you go with Tianshi Shengjie to that domain? That way, you can choose the type of dragon that catches your eye, and I will help you become a dragon."
"Forget it." Chu Xing shook her head. "I don’t want to transform into a dragon anymore, and I will be a human forever."
Zhang Fei sighed and opened a gate. "All of you must enter the gate now, and we will talk again there."

A while later, they had arrived at the Sky Dragon Island, including Long Yuxi. All the women immediately split up to check the areas of the island, and they discovered that it was a floating island, which was much larger than the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
Long Yuxi turned to Zhang Fei. "How can you do that?"
"I can open the gates to all the places I’ve been before, so you don’t need to be surprised about this."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei went to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley to pick up Jing Shenlin, Sabina, Lu Wangyi, Ju Jushen, and several other natural race leaders.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei had returned to the Sky Dragon Island with all those people, and he explained to them about his plans to rebuild the island.

They weren’t surprised to hear that Zhang Fei wanted to bring all his wives to live on the Sky Dragon Island. After all, he would be moving many people from various races to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the future, so it wasn’t a suitable place for them to live.

Zhang Fei pointed towards the Sky Dragon Temple. "One of my wives is a Sky Dragon, so I want you guys to rebuild the temple. I myself don’t have an idea of what the temple looked like in the past, so—"

"I have an image of the temple before it was as destroyed as it is now." Long Yuxi touched Zhang Fei’s forehead and shared the image with him. "It’s the image passed down by my late great-grandfather, and the temple was still quite intact back then, so you can use it as a reference for rebuilding the temple. Even if they can’t rebuild it exactly the same, at least it won’t be too different."
After looking at the past image of the Sky Dragon Temple, Zhang Fei shared it with several natural race leaders, especially Ju Jushen, Ju Xing, Gravir, and a few others.
As for the other natural races, they would take care of the areas around Sky Dragon Island, such as vegetation and other things.

Zhang Fei asked them to inspect the entire area of Sky Dragon Island first, and he also explained to them the details of the construction plan, especially for the residential area and some other things.
After all, Zhang Fei had over a hundred wives, and he wanted each of them to have their personal houses, which they would share with their children in the future.

As for his main residence, Zhang Fei wanted to build a house that was quite spacious, and he would use it for his family gatherings. Since his training space had too many features that could not be replicated, the pavilion in it was irreplaceable for dual cultivation.

Long Yuxi silently listened to Zhang Fei instruct the leaders of the natural races, and she secretly liked his plans for the Sky Dragon Island. In fact, she was tempted to live on the island with them in the future, so her life would be free from disturbances, and she could live a much more peaceful life than in the past.

After Zhang Fei finished giving his instructions, Ju Jushen and the other leaders of the natural races immediately spread out to several different areas to begin planning the construction of the island.

However, they couldn’t immediately start rebuilding the island because the construction at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley was still far from complete, so they had to focus on completing the work there first.
"Are you and all your wives going to stay on this island forever, Zhang Fei?"
"No," Zhang Fei shook his head. "I will take them to another place in the future, but we will stay on this island until it is liveable."
"Where is that place?"
"My soul world."
"Huh?" Long Yuxi was shocked to hear that. "What do you mean by your soul world?"

Zhang Fei touched Long Yuxi’s forehead to confirm her soul strength. "Your soul cultivation level has reached the perfection stage of the divine soul level like mine, but unfortunately, your soul space is limited in the soul sea like all my wives."
"Hmm? Is there another form above the soul sea?"
"The soul world."
"What? How—"
In Zhang Fei’s soul world, Long Yuxi was dumbfounded as she looked at the surrounding area. "This? Is this your soul world?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded. "The first level is basic soul form, the second level is the soul mark, the third level is the soul sea, the fourth level is the soul world, and the fifth level is the soul universe."
"Soul world and soul universe," Long Yuxi muttered in shock. "How did you form your soul world? Can you teach me?"

Zhang Fei shared the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art with Long Yuxi. "All of my wives have mastered that technique for a long time, and many of them have reached the perfection stage of the divine soul level, but unfortunately, they always fail to form their soul world."
"Does that mean there are no other soul cultivators who can form the soul world besides you?" Long Yuxi asked with a dejected tone.

"I don’t know." Zhang Fei took out the white lotus from within his soul. "All my wives have the black lotus within their souls, and it helps them strengthen their soul power. Their soul level is equal to yours, but their soul power is much higher than yours thanks to the black lotus within their souls. Even so, they never succeeded in forming their soul worlds, which makes me feel strange."
Long Yuxi looked at the white lotus seriously. "How can I form a black lotus in my soul like all your wives?"

"You can’t form the black lotus," Zhang Fei shared the Lotus Ascension Art with Long Yuxi. "To create Yin and Yang lotuses, you need a partner, but it requires unwavering hearts and absolute trust in your partner. As long as you don’t have a partner, you won’t be able to form the black lotus within your soul."
"I see." Long Yuxi nodded in understanding, and she began to think about Zhang Fei’s previous offer to become his woman. "Let’s go back."

Once they returned to Sky Dragon Island, Zhang Fei waited for the natural races to finish checking everything. After that, he sent them back to the Yin-Yang Immortal Domain, and he sent all of his wives back to the training space, except for Yue Xuelian.
"I will join you two in going to the Frozen Yin Domain, Zhang Fei." Long Yuxi said.
"Alright." Zhang Fei directly took the two women into that domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1859: Frozen Underground Cave II
paragraphs: The Frozen Yin Domain.

As soon as they arrived, Zhang Fei activated several of his domains, including the fire domain, the sword domain, and several others. He also used the soul link to borrow Feng Yao’s strength; his own strength instantly soared to the God King Realm.

Even though she had seen all of Zhang Fei’s domains when she fought with Meng Huo in the Myriad Abyss Domain, Long Yuxi was still marveled when she saw everything. What made her most jealous of him was his ability to borrow Feng Yao’s strength, which no other cultivator could do.

Yue Xuelian’s cultivation had already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, but the situation in the domain was still terrifying for her. Even with her ice element and ice elemental laws, she could still feel the terrifying chill emanating from those female Yin demons.
Zhang Fei held Yue Xuelian’s hand to calm her down. "These yin demons are powerful, but they won’t be able to harm you as long as I’m by your side."
"I know." Yue Xuelian smiled sweetly. "So, where is the location of the Yin Dragon’s corpse?"
*Swoosh*

Huo Ling emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. She stretched her right hand forward and shot a ball of flame toward the north, clearing all the cold mist that obscured their line of sight. "There is a frozen lake ahead, and the Yin Dragon’s corpse is buried in the underground cave. To enter the underground cave, we have to enter the lake first, and we will find the entrance right at the bottom."
"Frozen underground cave, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered as he nodded in understanding. "The Yin Dragon has a strong ice element, so it’s natural that its corpse is buried in there."
Huo Ling turned to him. "I think you should bring Zhang Yue, Feng Jinqiu, Feng Xueying, Feng Shizhu, and Feng Bingying to this domain, husband."
"Why?"

"Although my flame can melt the ice, the lake will immediately freeze again. You and Yue Xuelian have the ice elements, but you guys are not enough to stop the freezing, and we need their help to control the freezing."
"I will bring them to this domain after we arrive at the lake." Zhang Fei took the three women to the frozen river using the Nine Cloud Steps.

As soon as they arrived at the frozen lake, Long Yuxi looked at Zhang Fei like she was looking at a freak. Although the distance between their starting location and the frozen lake wasn’t that far, it was impossible for them to arrive in the blink of an eye, but he managed to do that.
"I can move fifteen thousand miles in one step using my movement technique." Zhang Fei opened the gate, but he didn’t go in and waited for his clone to pick up the two female ice phoenixes.
"You’re a freak!" Long Yuxi shook her head after commenting. "Since the past, no cultivator has been able to move that far in one step, and you are the first."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "There’s always the first person in everything, right?"
"Where did you get your movement technique?"
"I got it from the same person who gave me the science capsule."
"Who exactly is that person?"
"Her name is Xuanyuan Yue."

Long Yuxi remembered that the Xuanyuan Clan once existed in the Ancient Realm, but all of them disappeared along with the disappearance of the Eternal Flame. However, she had never heard that a member of that clan possessed such a godly movement technique that allowed one to move such a distance in a single step.

Zhang Fei had no intention of explaining to Long Yuxi that Xuanyuan Yue wasn’t a cultivator from their universe, but rather, she came from another universe to seek a solution to free her father. After all, the female dragon demihuman was not yet willing to become his woman, so he refrained from sharing too many of his secrets with her.
After Feng Shizhu and Feng Bingying arrived at the domain, Zhang Fei took Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu out of the training space.

Long Yuxi couldn’t help shaking her head after seeing the five female ice phoenixes. She had already seen Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, and Feng Jinqiu in Zhang Fei’s training space. However, she didn’t expect him to know two other female ice phoenixes, and they seemed loyal to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1860: Yin Dragon Corpse And Soul I
paragraphs: Yue Xuelian almost stumbled after Huo Ling said that. "Isn’t that bad?"
"What’s so bad about it?" Huo Ling shrugged. "Have you forgotten how lustful our husband is? Remember when you and Yue Qianrou served him the first time?"
Yue Xuelian’s frosty cheeks reddened, recalling her first experience with Zhang Fei, as well as all the nights after that. Her first experience was both satisfying and exhausting.
Even though her cultivation was much higher than his, and she was assisted by her sister to serve him, she fell into complete exhaustion after having sex with him for so long.

During brief short seclusion, she and many of her sisters served him in shifts, but they ended up so exhausted that many of them couldn’t get out of bed for several days. Fortunately, the flow of time in the training space was faster than in the outside world, so they could rest without interruption.

Yue Xuelian sighed. "You’re right, Sister Ling. After all, I’m an ordinary woman, and my physique isn’t as strong as Boitata’s or those of the other female beasts, so I always end up exhausted whenever we engage in dual cultivation."
"Hehe," Huo Ling embraced her. "Even a Celestial Dragon like Tianshi Shengjie was exhausted from his onslaught, remember?"
"Yeah."

"The Yin Dragon is not only one of the most lustful dragons, but it is a living being that has the best and most abundant Yin Qi." Yue Xuelian turned to Huo Ling in surprise. "When you transform into the Yin Dragon later, you will definitely understand what I mean."

Zhang Fei listened to their conversation with a faint smirk on his face, imagining Yue Xuelian transforming into the Yin Dragon. He was looking forward to it, and he planned to dual-cultivate with her as soon as she completed her transformation.
Zhang Yue’s lips curled up when she noticed Zhang Fei’s expression, but she herself liked Yue Xuelian because of her poise and elegance, and she was grateful that she was one of his wives.

Long Yuxi glanced at Zhang Fei, and she raised an eyebrow as she noticed his lewd smirk. ’This man! Is there only sex in his brain? Judging from his lewd smirk, he must be thinking about having sex with Yue Xuelian.’

Since they had never lived in Zhang Fei’s training space, Feng Shizhu and Feng Bingying naturally knew nothing about his sex life. However, they could guess that his prowess in bed far surpassed that of any man; otherwise, he wouldn’t have had over a hundred wives, and all of them were extremely loyal to him.
Unlike their two ancestors, Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu had lived in Zhang Fei’s training space since they were still living in the Three Mortal Realms, and several decades had passed since then.

During this time, Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu were forced to watch Zhang Fei have sex with all his wives every day, as they often had sex in the garden of the pavilion. They even ignored the presence of the two female phoenixes and several other women, such as Tang Ying, Jing Qiuyue, Tang Ying, and several others.

Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu had long thought about surrendering themselves to Zhang Fei, especially the latter. However, they kept holding themselves back, and they waited for him to make a move against them.

Even Jing Qiuyue, Meng Qi, Meng Guanqiu, and Xian Xian also shared the same desire for the two female phoenixes. Among all the women living in the pavilion, only Tang Ying didn’t harbor such desires for Zhang Fei because she herself was a lust demon.
After they had walked for quite some time, they finally arrived at the end of the frozen underground cave, where they saw the Yin Dragon’s corpse lying lifeless.

The Yin Dragon is born from the purest yin qi, possessing flesh that appears flawless yet contains the hardness of eternal frost. Even though it has been dead for a long time, faint snowflakes and icy-blue mist naturally gather around the corpse.

It has a long, slender, and graceful body with smooth, flowing curves, rather than a stocky shape. Its head is elegant and slightly narrow, adorned with a pair of long, crystal-like horns that curve backward.

Its neck is long and flexible, creating a streamlined body that appears elegant and powerful. Soft, icy-blue hair grows down the back of its head and neck like flowing silk, while its bright, icy-blue eyes have thin, vertical pupils, giving it a calm, cold, and majestic appearance.
A row of small, crystal-like spines stretches from the back of its neck to the tip of its tail.
Its scales are smooth, thin, and tightly packed, resembling polished ice crystals with a pale white, icy blue sheen. A thin layer of frost forms across the skin beneath the scales.
It has four strong yet slender limbs with sharp, curved ice claws. Its tail is long, flexible, and ends with a broad, crystal-shaped fin that resembles a frozen snowflake.
"Beautiful!" Yue Xuelian and the four ice phoenixes were fascinated by the Yin Dragon’s corpse.
Even Long Yuxi, who was a dragon demihuman, was captivated by the beauty of the Yin Dragon.
Zhang Yue acted naturally, unlike them, as many of Zhang Fei’s wives were female beasts, some of whom possessed beautiful beast forms.

"Hehe," Huo Ling laughed and teased Yue Xuelian. "Beautiful, isn’t it? Are you looking forward to becoming the next Yin Dragon? The Yin Dragon Race has long been extinct, and you will be the one and only Yin Dragon in this universe."
Yue Xuelian subconsciously nodded, with her eyes never leaving the Yin Dragon’s corpse. "It’s a shame that such a beautiful dragon race had to become extinct."
"The past disaster was too terrifying, and it affected all races, so the extinction of the Yin Dragon Race was inevitable." Huo Ling sighed.
Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian and held her hand. "Soon, I will—"
*Swoosh*
Zhang Fei and the others looked at the soul of the Yin Dragon that suddenly appeared in front of them.
*Roar*
The soul of the Yin Dragon released a loud, intimidating dragon roar, which caused the frozen underground cave to shake violently.
"Ugh!" Zhang Yue, Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, Feng Shizhu, and Feng Bingying collapsed on the icy floor due to the dragon roar.
Even Long Yuxi, who possessed the Sky Dragon Bloodline, was forced to kneel on one knee.
Even though Yue Xuelian could stand straight, her body trembled with fear due to the presence of the Yin Dragon’s soul.
Zhang Fei hurriedly activated his light domain to help them recover; he also enveloped them with his aura so that they were no longer suppressed by the Yin Dragon’s soul’s powerful aura.

Huo Ling wanted to move, but Zhang Fei stopped her. She looked at the Yin Dragon’s soul with a disdainful smirk on her face. "A dead dragon who doesn’t know the height of the sky and the depth of the ocean."
The Yin Dragon’s soul heard Huo Ling’s words and released another dragon roar towards her.
*Roar*

"Oh, shut up!" Huo Ling picked her ear. "Your meager soul power is nothing to me, so stop showing off, or I’ll incinerate your soul! Besides, you’ve angered my husband, so you should prepare to face his wrath."
The Yin Dragon’s soul turned its gaze to Zhang Fei, who was supporting Yue Xuelian with a look of anger.
The Yin Dragon’s soul wanted to unleash another dragon roar, but Zhang Fei moved faster than it, and his dragon roar echoed throughout the frozen underground cave a moment later.
*Roar*

The Yin Dragon’s soul trembled in fear because of Zhang Fei’s dragon roar that came from his Calamity Demon Dragon Bloodline. However, his dragon roar didn’t affect Yue Xuelian or the other women, and he focused it on the Yin Dragon’s soul.

Soon, Zhang Fei transformed to his half-dragon form, followed by the appearance of the figure of the Calamity Demon Dragon behind him, which caused the pupils of the Yin Dragon’s soul to shrink and tremble.

Zhang Fei looked at the Yin Dragon’s soul with narrowed eyes; he released his killing intent and enveloped it, giving it a tremendous chill. "A dead dragon like you dares to be arrogant in front of a living Calamity Demon Dragon like me, huh?"
Hearing the Calamity Demon Dragon from Zhang Fei’s mouth, the Yin Dragon’s soul curled up on the ice floor. It lowered its dragon head, as it dared not look at him.
Zhang Yue, Long Yuxi, Feng Xueying, Feng Jinqiu, Feng Shizhu, and Feng Bingying could breathe a sigh of relief as the Yin Dragon’s soul stopped intimidating them.
Zhang Fei coldly stared at the Yin Dragon’s soul. "If I didn’t need you, I would have annihilated your soul, and your dragon race would have been extinct forever."
"Please stop it, husband." Yue Xuelian called out softly; she felt sorry for the Yin Dragon’s soul. "This dragon has been dead for a long time, and it probably just wants to guard its corpse."
However, Zhang Fei did not retract his killing intent or dragon aura, but he no longer enveloped the Yin Dragon’s soul with either. "Look at me."
The Yin Dragon’s soul timidly raised its head, but it still didn’t dare to look at Zhang Fei directly.
"Tch! Such a timid dragon!" Yue Xuelian pulled Zhang Fei’s hand, asking him to stop scaring the pitiful Yin Dragon’s soul. "Why are you like this?"
Yue Xuelian shook her head slightly. "I know you’re angry, but you don’t have to act like this."
"Alright, I won’t scare this timid dragon anymore." Zhang Fei patted Yue Xuelian’s head. "Hey, dead dragon! Do you want your dragon race to exist in this universe once again?"
The Yin Dragon’s soul finally looked at Zhang Fei. "How... how are you going to revive my dragon race? I... I am the last of my race, and my soul will disappear from this universe soon."

Tang Zhiyao asked him, "What’s wrong, husband?"
"Did something happen?" Gongsun Zhilan also asked.
Hua Qianmei felt that Zhang Fei [5]’s expression was a little strange.
"Do you need our help, Zhang Fei?"
"The five enemies should have arrived at the Endless Domain, so I need to go there to deal with them." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate leading to that domain.
"Do you three want to come with me?"
"Let’s go!" The three female gods were bored with hunting those mindless demons, so they immediately disappeared through the gate, making Zhang Fei [5] laugh at their antics.
"Hmm?" The three female demon gods were a little surprised when they arrived at the Endless Domain because it was filled with natural formations, and their senses couldn’t reach other areas.
"The formations in this domain are quite powerful, huh?"
"All the formations in this domain are truly strange."
"Our senses have a long range, but we can’t penetrate all of these formations."
"All the formations in this domain are not created by living beings." The three female demon gods turned to Zhang Fei [5].
"They were created naturally, and they are truly useful for protecting this domain.
That’s why non-combatant demon races choose to live in this domain, and all the formations here keep them safe."
"Such as?"
"The lust demon race, the witch demon race, and several other demon races."
The three female demon gods were quite surprised to hear about the witch demon race.
"Are there really witch demons in this domain?"
"They live in that direction." Zhang Fei [5] pointed towards the witch demon race’s residence, but they couldn’t check that place.
"I’ve sent my friends to persuade them to move to your domain, but they chose to stay in this domain.
Their numbers are small, and they aren’t very strong, so they’re afraid of dying there."
"How did you find out their location?"
Zhang Fei [5] enveloped the three female demon gods with his aura, and he took them away to the various residences of all the demon races living in the domain using his Nine Cloud Steps.
Hua Qianmei, Tang Zhiyao, and Gongsun Zhilan felt dizzy after Zhang Fei [5] brought them to the secret mountain.
Even though they were powerful demon gods, his speed was too fast and beyond their capabilities, which made them nauseous.
Hua Qianmei took a deep breath.
"Your movement technique is simply unbelievable!"
"That’s right." Gongsun Zhilan nodded in agreement.
"How can you move that fast?"
Unlike them, Tang Zhiyao already knew about Zhang Fei [5]’s training space and the features in his training ground, so she was no longer surprised by his mind-blowing speed.
Zhang Fei [5] shrugged.
"In fact, I can move very fast just by relying on my speed, and I can also move thousands of miles in one step using my movement technique."
"Nothing about you is normal." Hua Qianmei massaged the bridge of her nose.
Gongsun Zhilan nodded in agreement with Hua Qianmei as she stared at Zhang Fei. ’Is there any other man who can match him in this universe?’
*Swoosh*
The three female demon gods looked at the male demon who had just arrived.
"Who is he, husband?"
"His name is Wu Mian, and he is one of the demon gods of this Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei [5] looked at him.
"Are they almost arriving at this domain, Old Wu?"
Wu Mian glanced at the three female demon gods before nodding to him.
"The five of them will be here soon, kid.
Are you thinking of enslaving them?"
"Mo Zixiao needs their help to take care of the Celestial Demon Race, so I will enslave them and hand them over to him." Zhang Fei [5] paused.
"As for Mo Shentian, I will take him to the Myriad Abyss Domain first, and I will send him back after Mo Tianshen inherits his strength and becomes the next Celestial Demon God."
Wu Mian nodded in understanding.
"Since eight of the ten demon races are on your side, and you will be moving us to the Ancient Realm in the future, then only two demon races remain in this realm."
"The Celestial Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race."

chapters.title: Chapter 1866: Defeat Celestial Demon Guardians II
paragraphs: After waiting for some time, those Celestial Demon Guardians entered the Endless Domain. They swiftly stopped when Zhang Fei [5], Wu Mian, and the three female demon gods blocked their path.

Wu Mian and the three female demon gods wanted to move against the Celestial Demon Guardians, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped them and moved himself. He still had many other things to do, so he didn’t want to waste too much time with them.

Compared to the Asura Demon Guardians, they were far weaker, and it didn’t take Zhang Fei [5] long to defeat them. With his current speed and strength, not even the Nightmare Lord Meng Huo could defeat him, let alone those Celestial Demon Guardians.
[Quest: Defeat Celestial Demon Guardians.]
[Quest rank: Hard.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
After defeating them, Zhang Fei replicated their souls, merged them with his own, and implanted his demon slave mark into each of their souls.

Then Zhang Fei [5] sent them back to the Celestial Demon Domain and ordered Mo Zhejun to take care of the leadership of the Celestial Demon Race. "This way, I just have to wait for Mo Shentian to arrive in this domain, and I will defeat him at that time."
"Why do I feel like you’re in such a hurry to take over the Celestial Demon Race?"

Zhang Fei [5] turned to Wu Mian. "They’re no longer my opponents, and my new enemies are much stronger than them. Therefore, I won’t waste time with them, and I will take over that demon race as soon as possible. After I defeat Mo Shentian, I’ll enter seclusion, and I probably won’t come out until my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm."
"That will take a long time."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Regardless of whether I reach that stage or not, I will return to this realm in ten years, and I will fight Qian Yan at that time."
Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "The most terrifying thing about Qian Yan is not his physical strength but the ability of all the eyes in his body, especially his middle eye."

"You are mistaken, Old Wu." Zhang Fei [5] created a QI screen displaying his battle against Qian Yan during the Soul Challenge in the Tower of Eternity. "The demon beast god’s physical strength is high, and it surpasses Shang Zhanluo’s strength, strengthened by his awakening technique."
Wu Mian himself had never seen Qian Yan fight using his strength, and he tended to give in to the other demon gods, especially Mo Shentian.

Zhang Fei [5] continued. "If Qian Yan uses all his strength and abilities when he fights, he will become the strongest demon god not only in this realm but also in the Ancient Realm. Besides him, I still have two other opponents I must defeat in this realm, but my strength is still insufficient to defeat them."
"Who are the two people you mean?"
"One of them is the Ghost Emperor of the Jiangshen Domain."
"Damn!" Wu Mian cursed. "Do you also have problems with that thing? No demon god wants to deal with that thing, including Mo Shentian and Qian Yan."
"No," Zhang Fei [5] denied. "I’ve seen the Ghost Emperor when I stalked Tian Qiye into his domain several years ago, but I didn’t have any problems with him."
"Then?"
"Have you ever heard of the Spirit Willow Tree?"

Wu Mian was taken aback. "As far as I know, the Spirit Willow Tree was the lifeblood of the Jiangshen Domain, yet it perished long ago due to a calamity from the past. Nearly all the domain’s inhabitants perished in that disaster, and the domain transformed into a realm of ghosts because there was no one to guide their souls to the afterlife—which ultimately gave birth to the Ghost Emperor."
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded at him. "The Spirit Willow Tree is back, but it’s very weak now."
"Huh?" Wu Mian was shocked. "Did you just say that the Spirit Willow Tree has returned, Kid? But how did that happen?"

"Many years ago, I accidentally obtained the seed from the Spirit Willow Tree. I knew that the tree was the lifeblood of the Jiangshen Domain, so I planted it there when I was stalking Tian Qiye." Zhang Fei [5] switched the image on the Qi screen. "The tree is back now, but it is still young and weak, and it will take a lot of time to restore the domain to its original state."
Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "So, you want to defeat the Ghost Emperor to help the Spirit Willow Tree, right?"

"That’s right," Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. "As long as the Ghost Emperor still exists, the Spirit Willow Tree will not be able to fully develop, and the Jiangshen Domain will not be able to return to its former glory. Therefore, I must defeat him, but my strength is still not enough to fight him."
"Then, who is the second person?"
"I am his final opponent in this realm." Zhang Fei [5] and the others turned to Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul. "You’ve grown, Kid."
Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, and Tang Zhiyao raised their vigilance as soon as they saw Hu Tianlang. ’This fox’s aura is too terrifying even though he has been dead for a long time!’

Zhang Fei [5] asked the three female demon gods to calm down and not attack Hu Tianlang. Although they were strong, he was far stronger than them, and he could kill them easily. "If I don’t improve myself, I won’t be able to defeat you, and the ten-tailed fox will never return to this universe. If that happens, the writings you left behind in the Sky Jade Realm will never come true, and your sacrifices in the past will end up being in vain."
"Hahaha," Hu Tianlang laughed. "I like looking at you now, Kid. Compared to when we first met in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, you are more mature, and you are not as arrogant as before."

Zhang Fei [5] stiffened when Hu Tianlang mentioned the incident. Back then, he almost died because of him, and his cursed demon heart went out of control. If Zhang Chen hadn’t come to save him at that time, he would have fallen under the control of his heart’s original owner.
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath. "I have one question for you, and I hope you’ll answer it."
"Ask me."
"Are Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian in your hands now?"

"That’s right," Hu Tianlang admitted. "They are in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain now, and you will meet them when you go there. Currently, their cultivation has already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, but they are still no match for you, so I will continue to help them improve their cultivation."

Zhang Fei [5] narrowed his eyes; he did not expect that Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian’s cultivation was already on par with his. "What method did you use to help them increase their cultivation so quickly?"

"Haha," Hu Tianlang laughed while shaking his head. "I won’t say anything about it, and you just need to know that they will be your last opponents before you face me. If you manage to defeat them, we will face each other in our final battle. If you manage to defeat me, you will evolve into the next ten-tailed fox."
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath; his gaze turned sharp. "You don’t have to worry about that; I will defeat the two of them in front of you, and I will defeat you after I defeat them."

"Hahaha," Hu Tianlang laughed loudly as his body slowly disappeared. "I will wait for you in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain, Kid. If you manage to defeat me, I will help you evolve into the ten-tailed fox, and you will be unrivaled in this universe."
Zhang Fei [5] clenched both his fists. "Just wait! I’ll defeat you at that time!"

"Calm down, husband." Tang Zhiyao hugged him from behind. "You’re no match for him right now, but I’m sure you can defeat him in the future. If you need my help improving your cultivation, I’ll be happy to help you with that."
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Wu Mian. "Old Wu, Mo Shentian will arrive in this domain in a few days, so you can tell me when he arrives."
Wu Mian nodded. "You don’t need to worry about that; I will immediately inform you once he arrives in this domain."
"Sigh." Zhang Fei [5] opened a portal to the Jiangshen Domain. "I’ll take the three of them away now."
After they left, Wu Mian glanced around the area before vanishing.
"Hmm?" The three female demon gods were startled by the situation in the Jiangshen Domain.
"Is this domain the ghost domain?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] enveloped them with his aura and led them away.
When they arrived there, they saw that the Spirit Willow Tree had grown somewhat, but it was still far from its original size.
Soon, the spirit of the Spirit Willow Tree appeared before them. "Long time no see, Zhang Fei."
"Six and a half years, to be precise."
"Yes." The tree spirit nodded at him. "Thanks to you, the Spirit Willow Tree is back now, but my strength hasn’t returned yet, so I can’t bring about any changes to this domain."
"Is that Ghost Emperor trying to attack you for the past few years?"

"He tried to attack me several times, but the barrier protecting this place stopped him. Without the barrier, he would have destroyed the Spirit Willow Tree long ago, and this domain would forever be the ghost domain."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] took out a seed and showed it to the spirit. "Do you know anything about the Ancient Divine Tree?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1867: Meet Mo Shentian Again I
paragraphs: The spirit of the Spirit Willow Tree shook its head at Zhang Fei. "I’ve never heard of the Ancient Divine Tree, so I can’t say anything about it. However, you have that woman by your side, and she should know something about that tree, so you should ask her."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei [5] kept the seed.
The spirit looked at the three female demon gods. "They’re not native to this realm, right?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] introduced the three women to the spirit. "They are demon gods from the Myriad Abyss Domain, and that domain is located in the Ancient Realm."
"The Ancient Realm is a higher realm than this Paradise Realm."

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "People from this Paradise Realm don’t know about the Ancient Realm, and I learned about it from Feng Yao. Actually, the two realms are not that different, but the quality and quantity of qi there are higher than here. Even though all of them are demon gods, all of the demon gods from this realm will not be able to defeat them."
"I see." The spirit nodded in understanding. "Can you take me to that realm in the future?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised by the spirit’s request. "What will happen to this domain if you leave?"

"Nothing will happen to this domain." The spirit was silent for a while and looked the other way. "When the Ghost Emperor and all the ghosts in this domain have disappeared, this domain will return to normal. Even if I leave this domain in the future, my departure will not change anything. However, that will not happen in the near future, and I will have to wait a long time to get rid of them from this domain."
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "By the time you manage to get rid of them from that domain, your tree roots should have merged with this domain, right?"
"Haha," The spirit laughed. "Did you forget about Arbeola?"
"No."
"Even though Arbeola is a demon tree, he is the same as the Spirit Willow Tree. Since he can go to other domains, I can do the same. I can’t say it now, and you can see for yourself in the future."

"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "If you’re confident in your abilities, I’ll take you to the Ancient Realm in the future. Currently, my people are rebuilding the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I’ll have them rebuild Sky Dragon Island after they’re done with that."
The spirit looked at Zhang Fei [5] in surprise, but he immediately created two qi screens that displayed both places.

"The left one is the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I will move many of my acquaintances in this realm there in the future. The right one is the Sky Dragon Island, and it will be my family’s private place." The spirit looked at the two Qi screens seriously, but he was more interested in the Sky Dragon Island. "If you are interested in living on that island, I will move you there in the future, and you will help me protect my family."
The spirit nodded to him. "You are my savior, and the Spirit Willow Tree would never have returned to this domain if not for you, so I have no problem protecting your family."

"Let’s talk about that in the future, and we should focus on our own affairs for now." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Myriad Abyss Domain. "That Ghost Emperor will notice our presence if we stay in this domain for too long, so we should leave now, and I’ll come back to check on you in the future."
"Okay."
After they disappeared, the spirit looked into the distance before entering the Spirit Willow Tree again.

Zhang Fei [5] had brought the three female demon gods back to the fourth underground floor of the Myriad Abyss Domain. The three women immediately went to the fourth underground floor and resumed their task of hunting down those mindless demons.
Zhang Fei [5] did not join them because they were sufficient to hunt the mindless demons on that floor; instead, he stayed on the fourth underground floor and joined Yuan Xiajie and the others.
"Where did you go before?" Yuan Xiajie asked him.

"The Endless Domain in the Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei [5] explained to her about his purpose in going there. "I think Mo Cangyue, Mo Luoxie, and Yuan Xuan are enough to help me here. Thus, I will send you to my training space, and you can continue your training with the others."
Yuan Xiajie refused with a shake of her head. "You still lack a lot of those demon materials, so I won’t enter your training space for now, and I will train again after you get all the materials."
"Why are you so stubborn?"
"Aren’t we both the same?" Yuan Xiajie pressed her index finger against his chest. "Are you impatient to eat me? What if we do it here?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "Unfortunately, I’ve promised them not to use my clones to dual cultivate with anyone anymore, and I’ll only use my real body for that."
"Huh?" Yuan Xiajie couldn’t believe what he heard. "Are you really going to do that?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "You’ve never dual-cultivated with me, so you still don’t know my strength in bed."

"Even though I’ve never dual-cultivated with you, I’ve watched you do it with Feng Yao and your other wives, remember?" Yuan Xiajie pouted. "More or less, I already know your strength in bed, and I’m a little afraid to dual cultivate with you because of that."
Zhang Fei [5] pulled her into his embrace. "You don’t need to be afraid, okay? I will treat you gently, and you will enjoy dual cultivation with me, just like them."
"Huft." Yuan Xiajie blushed, imagining herself dual cultivating with him. "In that case, I will prepare myself from now on, and I will dual cultivate with you when I’m mentally ready."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Mo Cangyue, who was looking at him with a gaze full of jealousy. "Your little lover is jealous, Xiajie."
Yuan Xiajie looked at Mo Cangyue. "Why don’t you take her as your woman too?"
"She’s not my type, so I won’t take her as my woman." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link. "Let’s continue our hunt."
"Okay."
Three days passed in the outside world, equivalent to several days in the training space.
Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian, who was fast asleep. He stroked her tired face with a smile.
Huo Ling had told him that Yue Xuelian would become wild after she transformed into the Yin Dragon, but he hadn’t expected her to be so wild, and they ended up having sex for days.
After he got dressed, Zhang Fei left the main bedroom and let Yue Xuelian rest there.

Luo Yunxiao suddenly approached him and hugged his arm. "I didn’t expect Sister Xuelian to be so wild, husband. Sister Shengjie and the others are even less wild than her, and her moans are much louder than before she transformed into the Yin Dragon."
"What are your plans now, husband?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.

"I will go to the Endless Domain again." Both women were a little surprised to hear that. "Mo Shentian should arrive there today, and I will fight him there. After I defeat him, I will take him to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and I will help Mo Tianshen inherit his power."
Tianshi Shengjie nodded in understanding. "If Mo Tianshen inherits Mo Shentian’s power, he will become the next Celestial Demon God, and the Celestial Demon Race will be under your control."

"You’re wrong about that, Shengjie." Zhang Fei briefly kissed both women. "Although I haven’t defeated Mo Shentian, the Celestial Demon Race is already under my control now. His three sons have long been under my control, and Mo Zhejun is helping Mo Zixiao take over his father’s position."
Tianshi Shengjie raised an eyebrow. "Can Mo Zixiao take care of the Celestial Demon Race without becoming their demon god?"

"Mo Zixiao can’t do it, but Mo Zhejun can help him with that." Zhang Fei told the two women about the old demon, who possessed power on par with several demon gods. "That old demon is stronger than Mo Shentian, and the people of the Celestial Demon Race respect him, so it is easy for him to take over his disciple’s authority."
By the way, I’m going out now, and I’m going to meet Mo Tianshen in the Myriad Abyss Domain first before going to the Endless Domain."
"Okay."
After Zhang Fei left, Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie joined the other women to cultivate, but some of them spent their time at the training ground with Puyang Yeyu and several others.
Zhang Fei arrived at Hua Qianmei’s secret place and immediately went to see Mo Tianshen, who was cultivating alongside Morgana and the other demons.
"Do you want to come with me?"
Mo Tianshen opened his eyes and looked at Zhang Fei. "Where are we going?"
"The Endless Domain." Mo Tianshen was slightly surprised. "Mo Shentian will arrive at that domain today, and I will defeat him for you so you can inherit the power of the Celestial Demon God."
Mo Tianshen turned to Morgana, who immediately spoke to him. "I know you’ve wanted to see your brother for a long time, so you should go there with Zhang Fei, Husband."
"Yeah." Mo Tianshen returned his gaze to Zhang Fei. "Won’t my presence interfere with your fight with my traitorous brother?"
"No," Zhang Fei shook his head. "I’ll have Huo Ling protect you so you can watch our fight in peace."
Mo Tianshen nodded to him. "Let’s go then! I’ll go with you to meet my traitorous brother, and he’ll definitely be shocked once he sees me."
"Let’s go."

sentences.text: The spirit of the Spirit Willow Tree shook its head at Zhang Fei.
"I’ve never heard of the Ancient Divine Tree, so I can’t say anything about it.
However, you have that woman by your side, and she should know something about that tree, so you should ask her."
"Yeah," Zhang Fei [5] kept the seed.
The spirit looked at the three female demon gods.
"They’re not native to this realm, right?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] introduced the three women to the spirit.
"They are demon gods from the Myriad Abyss Domain, and that domain is located in the Ancient Realm."
"The Ancient Realm is a higher realm than this Paradise Realm."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded.
"People from this Paradise Realm don’t know about the Ancient Realm, and I learned about it from Feng Yao.
Actually, the two realms are not that different, but the quality and quantity of qi there are higher than here.
Even though all of them are demon gods, all of the demon gods from this realm will not be able to defeat them."
"I see." The spirit nodded in understanding.
"Can you take me to that realm in the future?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised by the spirit’s request.
"What will happen to this domain if you leave?"
"Nothing will happen to this domain." The spirit was silent for a while and looked the other way.
"When the Ghost Emperor and all the ghosts in this domain have disappeared, this domain will return to normal.
Even if I leave this domain in the future, my departure will not change anything.
However, that will not happen in the near future, and I will have to wait a long time to get rid of them from this domain."
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment.
"By the time you manage to get rid of them from that domain, your tree roots should have merged with this domain, right?"
"Haha," The spirit laughed.
"Did you forget about Arbeola?"
"No."
"Even though Arbeola is a demon tree, he is the same as the Spirit Willow Tree.
Since he can go to other domains, I can do the same.
I can’t say it now, and you can see for yourself in the future."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] nodded.
"If you’re confident in your abilities, I’ll take you to the Ancient Realm in the future.
Currently, my people are rebuilding the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I’ll have them rebuild Sky Dragon Island after they’re done with that."
The spirit looked at Zhang Fei [5] in surprise, but he immediately created two qi screens that displayed both places.
"The left one is the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I will move many of my acquaintances in this realm there in the future.
The right one is the Sky Dragon Island, and it will be my family’s private place." The spirit looked at the two Qi screens seriously, but he was more interested in the Sky Dragon Island.
"If you are interested in living on that island, I will move you there in the future, and you will help me protect my family."
The spirit nodded to him.
"You are my savior, and the Spirit Willow Tree would never have returned to this domain if not for you, so I have no problem protecting your family."
"Let’s talk about that in the future, and we should focus on our own affairs for now." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Myriad Abyss Domain.
"That Ghost Emperor will notice our presence if we stay in this domain for too long, so we should leave now, and I’ll come back to check on you in the future."
"Okay."
After they disappeared, the spirit looked into the distance before entering the Spirit Willow Tree again.
Zhang Fei [5] had brought the three female demon gods back to the fourth underground floor of the Myriad Abyss Domain.
The three women immediately went to the fourth underground floor and resumed their task of hunting down those mindless demons.
Zhang Fei [5] did not join them because they were sufficient to hunt the mindless demons on that floor; instead, he stayed on the fourth underground floor and joined Yuan Xiajie and the others.
"Where did you go before?" Yuan Xiajie asked him.
"The Endless Domain in the Paradise Realm." Zhang Fei [5] explained to her about his purpose in going there.
"I think Mo Cangyue, Mo Luoxie, and Yuan Xuan are enough to help me here.
Thus, I will send you to my training space, and you can continue your training with the others."
Yuan Xiajie refused with a shake of her head.
"You still lack a lot of those demon materials, so I won’t enter your training space for now, and I will train again after you get all the materials."
"Why are you so stubborn?"
"Aren’t we both the same?" Yuan Xiajie pressed her index finger against his chest.
"Are you impatient to eat me?
What if we do it here?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly.
"Unfortunately, I’ve promised them not to use my clones to dual cultivate with anyone anymore, and I’ll only use my real body for that."
"Huh?" Yuan Xiajie couldn’t believe what he heard.
"Are you really going to do that?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded.
"You’ve never dual-cultivated with me, so you still don’t know my strength in bed."
"Even though I’ve never dual-cultivated with you, I’ve watched you do it with Feng Yao and your other wives, remember?" Yuan Xiajie pouted.
"More or less, I already know your strength in bed, and I’m a little afraid to dual cultivate with you because of that."
Zhang Fei [5] pulled her into his embrace.
"You don’t need to be afraid, okay?
I will treat you gently, and you will enjoy dual cultivation with me, just like them."
"Huft." Yuan Xiajie blushed, imagining herself dual cultivating with him.
"In that case, I will prepare myself from now on, and I will dual cultivate with you when I’m mentally ready."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Mo Cangyue, who was looking at him with a gaze full of jealousy.
"Your little lover is jealous, Xiajie."

"Why don’t you take her as your woman too?"

"Let’s continue our hunt."
"Okay."

Zhang Fei looked at Yue Xuelian, who was fast asleep.

"That old demon is stronger than Mo Shentian, and the people of the Celestial Demon Race respect him, so it is easy for him to take over his disciple’s authority."

chapters.title: Chapter 1868: Meet Mo Shentian Again II
paragraphs: As soon as Zhang Fei and Mo Tianshen arrived in the Endless Domain, Wu Mian appeared before them, inhabiting the body of a demon he had possessed.

In fact, Zhang Fei also mastered the Body Possession Method, which he acquired from Wu Mian after his first dual cultivation with Qi Qingxiu. However, he had never used it before because he felt uncomfortable possessing another person’s body.

Wu Mian looked at Mo Tianshen. "You two are indeed blood brothers, huh? You look younger than Mo Shentian, but your face and figure are almost identical to his. Fortunately, you did not make the same mistake as your brother, and you have made the right choice by supporting this kid.

"Haha," Mo Tianshen cupped his hands. "It is my honor to meet you, Demon God Wu Mian. I have heard your name many times before my brother sent me to the Three Mortal Realms, but this is our first meeting."

Wu Mian nodded slightly. "That Old Celestial Demon God was truly an idiot! He already knew Mo Shentian’s character, but he forced himself to pass on his power to him. If I were in his position at that time, I wouldn’t have rushed to pass on my power to Mo Shentian, and I would have searched for you all over the universe."

"Everything happened a long time ago, so we don’t need to bring it up again." Mo Tianshen looked at Zhang Fei. "Our meeting was truly a coincidence, Demon God Wu. If he hadn’t come to the Netherworld Realm back then, we would never have met, and I would never have been able to return to this realm."

Wu Mian nodded in agreement with Mo Tianshen. He would never have known about Zhang Fei if he hadn’t gone to the Netherworld Realm and met Arbeola there, and he wouldn’t have been able to execute his long-planned strategy.
Wu Mian looked outside the domain. "He will enter this domain soon."

Hearing that, Zhang Fei summoned Huo Ling out of his body; he tasked her with protecting Mo Tianshen. He had fought Mo Tianshen about four months ago, so he had some knowledge of the abilities of the Celestial Demon God.
"Are you sure you don’t need my help, husband?"

Zhang Fei answered Huo Ling by activating the soul link, but he only borrowed a little of Feng Hao’s power, making his strength comparable to that of a cultivator at the Celestial God Realm. He could borrow the power of the female phoenix and make his strength equal to that of a cultivator at the Supreme God Realm, but he didn’t feel the need for it just to fight Mo Shentian.
Since she was bound to him, Huo Ling understood Zhang Fei’s thoughts. She didn’t say anything to him, and she focused herself on protecting Mo Tianshen.

Wu Mian decided to follow Huo Ling and Mo Tianshen away from Zhang Fei. He was fully aware that he was no match for Mo Shentian, and he would only be a burden to him in his fight against the Celestial Demon God.
After waiting for some time, Mo Shentian finally entered the Endless Domain; he was slightly surprised when he saw Zhang Fei already waiting for him in the domain.
Mo Shentian floated before Zhang Fei with a disdainful smile, but his expression changed after he noticed the change in his cultivation.

The last time they fought in Qi Qingxiu’s domain, Zhang Fei’s cultivation was only at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but his cultivation skyrocketed to the Celestial God Realm in less than four months, which greatly shocked the Celestial Demon God.
Zhang Fei smirked. "Why are you looking at me in shock?"

"Heh," Mo Shentian snorted arrogantly. "I don’t know how you raised your cultivation to the Celestial God Realm, but I’m certain that it wasn’t your original cultivation. You must have used a strengthening technique to increase it, but you won’t be able to use that technique for too long, and you’ll become a cripple because of it."
"You’re right, I did use strengthening techniques to improve my cultivation, but—" Zhang Fei paused and looked at him. "But you don’t know about my technique, so your guess could be right or wrong."
"Whether it’s true or not, I’ll see for myself." Mo Shentian stretched out his hand and locked Zhang Fei’s area using his spatial element.
"Tsk... tsk... Are you sure you want to rely on your spatial element to confine me?" Zhang Fei asked with a faint smile.

During their first battle about four months ago, Mo Shentian managed to confine Zhang Fei using his space element—since he did not possess that element himself—and he had only managed to break free with Huo Ling’s help.
However, Mo Shentian had not yet realized that the situation was different, and he did not know that Zhang Fei had already obtained the void element, which was above his space element.
If the space element is like the space in a glass, the void element is the glass itself, and it controls the space within it.
"Haha," Mo Shentian laughed mockingly. "If you are that confident in your abilities, you should try to free yourself from my space lock."
"Let me show you something." After saying that, Zhang Fei activated his void domain and void elemental law, which instantly shattered Mo Shentian’s space lock.
"Fuck!" Mo Shentian cursed as he staggered backwards. "How is this possible? What did you use to break my space lock?"
"You are just ignorant fools." Zhang Fei expanded his void domain, enveloping Mo Shentian with it. "As long as you are in my domain, you will not be able to use your space element."

Mo Shentian didn’t believe it and tried to use his space element again, but to his disappointment, it was useless. If the space element were like the space inside a glass, then the void element was the glass itself, and it controlled the space within it.
Realizing his situation, Mo Shentian tried to leave the domain, but Zhang Fei couldn’t possibly let him go. He activated his element and utilized his speed to attack the Celestial Demon God.
Since Zhang Fei had already adapted to level eight gravity, Mo Shentian was no different from a snail, and all his attacks landed squarely on the Celestial Demon God’s body.

Moreover, Zhang Fei’s punch was no joke, as he had mastered nine body techniques. Normally, a cultivator would learn one or two techniques because it takes a long time to reach the maximum level in one, but he is different from most cultivators. His physique was different from other cultivators; he had five clones who constantly helped him learn new things, and he also had his training space, especially the comprehension feature.

Mo Shentian’s face turned grim; blood trickled from his mouth, and numerous bruises appeared on his body. For the first time in his life, he felt excruciating pain because every blow from Zhang Fei was extremely heavy; he felt all the bones in his body ache uncontrollably.
Not to mention Zhang Fei’s speed, Mo Shentian couldn’t detect his movements at all even when he had appeared before him, preventing him from dodging his attacks.

Zhang Fei didn’t use any special techniques to attack Mo Shentian; he relied solely on his raw physical strength to pummel him. If he had used his techniques, the Celestial Demon God would have been defeated the moment he first attacked.

"Fuck!" Mo Shentian tried to distance himself from Zhang Fei and used his abilities to bend reality, causing him to stand motionless in his spot. "Hahaha! You may be able to overcome my space element, but you won’t be able to overcome my abilities!"
Unfortunately, Mo Shentian forgot that Zhang Fei had once freed himself from the effects of his abilities; he was able to do so at that time thanks to Huo Ling’s help.
Zhang Fei shook his head at Mo Shentian and released the Primordial Flame within his body, which instantly shattered his abilities.
*Splurt*
"Cough..." Mo Shentian coughed hard, looking at Zhang Fei in disbelief. "How... How did you manage to destroy my abilities?"
"As I said before, you are ignorant fools."
After Zhang Fei said that, several figures of mythical beasts appeared around them.
The nine-tailed heavenly fox.
The calamity demon dragon.
The fire phoenix.
The dark phoenix.
The ice phoenix.
The golden crow.
The vermilion bird.
The golden fox.
The flame dragon.
The azure dragon.
The mythical deer.
The azure emperor roc.
The rainbow-shelled tortoise.
The white tiger.
Mo Shentian had not yet come out of shock, but Zhang Fei had already used all his elements, and countless elemental swords appeared behind him.
Flame swords.
Ice swords.
Light swords.
Wind swords.
Water swords.
Lightning swords
Wood swords
Metal swords
Void swords.
Darkness swords.

Mo Shentian was utterly shocked upon seeing all those elemental swords; he finally realized that Zhang Fei possessed not just one or two elements, but ten. In his entire life, he had never encountered a cultivator who possessed so many elements.
"Where has your arrogance gone?"
Zhang Fei raised his right hand and used his Heaven-Severing Sword Technique.

In that instant, a giant golden sword appeared above Zhang Fei; its size was far larger than any he had ever summoned before, as his current strength was equivalent to that of a cultivator at the Celestial God Realm.
"Are you ready to face your end?"
Mo Shentian wanted to escape from the domain, but Zhang Fei moved quickly by sealing the area using his void element, preventing the Celestial Demon God from escaping the fight.
Since he had no other choice, Mo Shentian unleashed all his power to the max. "Even if I have to die today, I’ll take you down with me!"
"Let’s see who will die between us."
Zhang Fei waved his hand down, and the golden sword quickly shot towards Mo Shentian, who tried to counter it with his own technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1869: Meet Mo Shentian Again III
paragraphs: Mo Shentian grimaced as his technique clashed with Zhang Fei’s golden sword. He had tried to use his abilities to bend reality, but his efforts were shattered once again.

Having lived for so long and reached the pinnacle of the demon race, Mo Shentian never expected to encounter a solid, tall wall blocking his path. Moreover, the wall was in the form of a young cultivator much younger than his own children, yet he could make him lose his mind and feel helpless.
Just as Mo Shentian was contemplating another solution to turn the tide of their battle, those mythical figures darted toward him one by one, followed by all those elemental swords.
"Damn it! Am I really going to die today?"
Mo Shentian gritted his teeth and released more strength to block all of Zhang Fei’s attacks, but flurries of petals suddenly appeared in the area around him and shot straight at him.
"No hope!"

Mo Shentian had never felt so helpless in his entire life, and Zhang Fei’s attacks—including those flurries of petals—rapidly struck his body one after another. His clothes quickly became tattered, and his body became soaked with blood that gushed from the wounds caused by all the attacks.
Mo Shentian resigned himself to the sight of the golden sword slashing towards him, but it suddenly stopped inches from his head and disappeared on its own.

However, Mo Shentian couldn’t feel relieved because Zhang Fei suddenly appeared before him and unleashed a powerful final strike against his chest, sending him hurtling to the ground and slamming him hard into the area beneath him.
Splurt
"Cough... Cough..." Mo Shentian coughed up blood; his vision slowly blurred, and his entire body felt as though it were falling apart.
"You’re lucky I can’t kill you, but that doesn’t mean I’m going to let you off the hook."

Zhang Fei dispelled all his techniques, landed beside Mo Shentian, and crouched there. He restricted his movement, touched his chest, and used several of his demon techniques, including his Life-Force Absorption Technique and Demon Absorbing Technique.
"Argh!" Mo Shentian screamed loudly, his face turning increasingly pale, and his body kept jerking in pain. "Argh!"
Huo Ling brought Wu Mian and Mo Tianshen beside them.
Mo Shentian was truly shocked to see Mo Tianshen. "Brother... Please save me..."
"I won’t save you, Brother." Mo Tianshen refused with a shake of his head. "Zhang Fei is my benefactor; he released your seal on my soul, and he brought me back to this realm.

"Brother... Please save me... I will do anything to make amends to you." Mo Shentian continued to beg while screaming in pain, but Mo Tianshen ignored his pleas because he knew that Zhang Fei would not kill his brother. "Brother... brother..."
"Shut up!" Huo Ling snapped at him. "You are a demon god, but you beg like a little brat! You have made many mistakes in the past, and you must face the consequences today!"
[You gained 500,000,000 demon essences from Mo Shentian.]
[You gained 500,000,000 Qi from Mo Shentian.]
After several hours, Mo Shentian’s screams of pain finally died down, and he lay helpless on the ground.
[Quest: Defeat the Celestial Demon God.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

After Mo Shentian weakened significantly, Zhang Fei replicated his soul and merged it with his. After implanting his demon slave mark into the Celestial Demon God’s soul, he forced him to swallow several pills to restore his condition.

Zhang Fei wanted to mimic Mo Shentian’s ability to bend reality, but unfortunately, he failed after several attempts, so he abandoned his plan. He snatched the treasure of the Celestial Demon Race from him.
[Quest: Steal Celestial Demon Race Treasure.]
[Quest rank: Special.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Special gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
"Get up." Mo Shentian gritted his teeth, but he could not refute Zhang Fei’s order, and he struggled to stand up. "Pass your strength to your brother."
"What—" Mo Shentian was shocked by that.

"Hmph!" Zhang Fei sneered condescendingly. "Do you think I’d just let you walk away after enslaving you? My purpose in enslaving you is to help Mo Tianshen inherit your strength, and he will become the next demon god of your Celestial Demon Race."

Mo Shentian was torn, for his status as a Demon God was everything to him. Moreover, he would gradually weaken once he passed his strength on to his brother, and ultimately, he would die just like the former Demon God. "But—"
"Do it now! Otherwise, you will experience torture that you never imagined in your life." Zhang Fei ordered him with a stern tone.

Mo Shentian had no other choice because he had already become Zhang Fei’s slave. He stood in front of Mo Tianshen, pressed his palms against his chest, and began the process of passing on his power to him.

The process was not much different from when the former Celestial Demon God bequeathed the rest of his power to Mo Tianshen several years ago, but unfortunately, it couldn’t help the latter to become a demon god, as the former had already passed on most of his power to Mo Shentian.

Standing beside them, Wu Mian watched the process while nodding in satisfaction. He had long wanted to stop Mo Shentian because he was a threat to the other demon races, but he couldn’t do so because he was weaker than him. However, the appearance of Zhang Fei changed everything, and he managed to defeat the Celestial Demon God without much effect.

After some time, the process finally concluded, and Mo Shentian withdrew his hand from his brother’s chest. He fell to the ground while breathing heavily. His face grew paler, his breathing became heavier, and his body began to weaken. Even though his cultivation was still at the Celestial God Realm, his strength had decreased a lot compared to before.

In contrast, Mo Tianshen felt a strong fluctuation within his body, and he was about to break through to the Celestial God Realm. He was excited by this, but he quickly suppressed his excitement and sat cross-legged on the ground to prepare for his breakthrough.
Zhang Fei released a sigh of relief as his plan went smoothly without a hitch. He looked at Mo Shentian before opening the portal to the training space, which confused the Celestial Demon God.

A few minutes later, Mo Shentian got the answer to his confusion, and his expression changed drastically, a mixture of disappointment, anger, and despair. He looked at Mo Zainan, Mo Anqi, and Mo Yousha, who were standing in front of him. "Why? Why did you three betray me?"

"Isn’t your question wrong?" Mo Zainan coldly asked. "Have you forgotten the time you locked me in prison? Have you forgotten that you intended to sacrifice our two daughters to fulfill your ambitions? Fortunately, Zhang Fei saw through your plan, and he saved the three of us; otherwise, we would have died because you used the Yin Sacrifice Art on us."
"How—"

"Are you surprised that our cultivation didn’t decrease after you used that technique on us?" Mo Zainan created a qi screed that displayed her time in prison. "As I said just now, Zhang Fei saw through your plan, and he replaced us with three puppets. Therefore, we weren’t affected by your technique, so you shouldn’t be surprised if our cultivation didn’t decrease."
Mo Shentian was once again shocked upon hearing all this; he had never imagined that Zhang Fei had replaced his wife and two daughters with puppets, and he had never even realized it.

Mo Anqi looked at her father with hatred. "I hate you so much, Father. In the past, I always respected you, but you intended to sacrifice me for your ambition. Fortunately, my stepfather saved us from you; otherwise, we would have died by your hands."
"Stepfather." Mo Shentian muttered softly; he finally realized that Mo Zainan was already Zhang Fei’s wife, and he couldn’t feel his mark in her soul.
"Zhang Fei is our stepfather, and we owe him our lives," Mo Yousha added. "Moreover, he has given us a better opportunity, and we managed to find happiness in our lives because of him."

"This is our last meeting, and we will never meet again in the future. Even though you were once my husband, I will never regret your fate, and I hope you will live a better life from now on." After saying that, Mo Zainan briefly kissed Zhang Fei, and she immediately led her two daughters back to the training space.

After they left, Mo Shentian collapsed onto the ground, feeling utterly defeated. He had always been confident that all his plans would succeed, but reality contradicted him. Not only had he lost miserably to Zhang Fei, but he had also lost his power and family, and his family had already sided with his enemy.
Zhang Fei closed the portal to his training ground and opened the gate to the Celestial Demon Domain. He lifted Mo Shentian, gave him a few orders, and threw him into the gate.
"Phew," Wu Mian sighed in relief. "Only Qian Yan remains, and all the demon races will live in peace if you manage to defeat him in the future."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Qian Yan is far stronger than Mo Shentian, and his eye abilities are extremely troublesome. I have decided to go into seclusion for the next ten years, and I will go looking for him once I finish."
"Are you sure you can beat Qian Yan at that time?"

"I can’t give you an answer right now, Old Wu." Zhang Fei looked at Wu Mian. "To be frank, I could easily defeat Qian Yan if I borrowed Feng Yao’s full power, and Huo Ling could help me beat him too. However, I don’t want to do that because he is my final test; I have to defeat him using my own strength. Whether I will succeed or not, we will know the result in ten years."
Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will patiently wait for that day to arrive, and I will witness your battle with Qian Yan firsthand."
