chapters.title: Chapter 1870: Visit The Four Perils I
paragraphs: In the Celestial Demon Domain, Mo Zhejun brought Mo Shentian to the palace, where his three sons were waiting for him.
Mo Shentian looked at his master with a frown. "Has he enslaved you too, Master?"
"Yes," Mo Zhejun confirmed with a nod. "Do you remember when Dong Xuanyin captured me?"
"So, Dong Xuanyin was already on Zhang Fei’s side at that time?"
"Not yet."
"Then?"
"Dong Xuanyin became Zhang Fei’s woman not long after that."
Mo Shentian didn’t know whether to believe his master.

"Dong Xuanyin sent me to Zhang Fei, and he imprisoned me for so long to destroy my spirit. He sent me back to the domain after you went into the tunnel, and he ordered me to help Mo Zainan organize our race."
"I see." Mo Shentian looked at his three sons, and he could guess that Zhang Fei had also enslaved them. "Since when?"
Mo Zixiao answered him. "After you left for the tunnel, our master came to me and enslaved me, and he took Shang Xueli away."
"He enslaved me when I was going to the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, Father," Mo Taizi said.
"How about you?" Mo Shentian asked his third son, Mo Tianqi.
Mo Tianqi shrugged. "Our master captured and enslaved me when you sent me to the Starfall Martial Domain together with Sister Yousha, and I helped him to get close to my mother."
Mo Tianqi’s answer shocked Mo Shentian; he never realized that his third son had long fallen under Zhang Fei’s control. He even helped him to approach his mother.
Unfortunately, it was too late since they had become Zhang Fei’s slaves, and Mo Shentian had also lost his power after passing it on to his brother, Mo Tianshen.

Mo Zhejun patted his disciple’s shoulder. "Your regret is too late; you will slowly weaken as your strength continues to decline. There is nothing we can do to free ourselves because our master is so powerful, and he has many powerful women by his side, such as Empress Huo and Dong Xuanyin."

Mo Shentian said nothing; he deeply regretted his foolishness in walking right into Zhang Fei’s trap of his own accord. Because of his stupidity, he had to lose his power and his status as a demon god, and he also became his slave.
Mo Zhejun looked at Mo Zixiao. "Our master has appointed you to be the next leader of our demon race, so you must prepare yourself for the coronation ceremony."
"Will our people accept me as their new leader?"

"Your father and I will accompany you, so I’m sure they won’t reject you." Mo Zhejun paused. "Besides, your mother has ordered her loyal followers to support you, and their number is not small, so everything will run smoothly."
Mo Zixiao nodded. "Alright, I will prepare myself from now on."
Mo Shentian looked at Mo Zixiao with displeasure, but he couldn’t do anything to stop him from ascending the throne, as Zhang Fei ordered him to support his first son.
Thereafter, Mo Shentian returned to his room, and Mo Zhejun took care of everything for Mo Zixiao’s coronation ceremony.
In the Endless Realm.
Xie Yao, Xie Yan, and several demon race leaders who had arrived appeared in the area.
Xie Yao walked beside Zhang Fei. "Is he Mo Shentian’s little brother?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded. "However, Mo Tianshen will not replace his brother as leader of the Celestial Demon Race, and he will stay in the Ancient Realm with me."
"Then, who will be the new leader of the Celestial Demon Race?" Xie Yan asked.

Zhang Fei looked at her. "Mo Zixiao will be their new leader, and he will be supported by Mo Shentian and Mo Zhejun. Although they no longer have a demon god, the latter’s strength is on par with demon gods, so you guys shouldn’t mess with them."

"Haha," Xie Yao laughed. "We are aware of our strength, and we only want to live peacefully in this domain, so we won’t possibly look for trouble by fighting them. Do you think this Paradise Realm is safe now?"

Zhang Fei shrugged. "Although nine out of ten demon races are now under me, there are still many evil cultivators out there. Many of them hate all demon races, so you guys should still be careful out there."
"Honestly, we are not afraid of them, but we are still afraid of one race."
"The winged race."

"That’s right." Xie Yao nodded. "Compared to the other races, the winged race hates the demon race much more. If Tian Qiye knew that nine out of ten demon races were already under your control, she would probably order her subordinates to chase after the other demon races."
Xie Yan also spoke. "Several years ago, we detected a member of the Winged Race entering this domain, but he immediately left again because he couldn’t get past all the natural formations here."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "Why didn’t you two tell me at that time? Do you recognize that person’s identity?"
"If I’m not mistaken, his name is Tian Liefeng, and he is Tian Qiye’s trusted grand elder."

Zhang Fei naturally remembered Tian Liefeng, and he was the person who killed Xiao Jingyi, or rather Ye Jingyi’s parents. He had seen the man when Tian Qiye brought him to the Jiangshen Domain over six years ago, and he knew that the man was stronger than his slaves, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu.
Zhang Fei looked at the two lust demons. "You two don’t need to worry about the winged race; I would definitely know if Tian Qiye ordered her close grand elders to attack this domain."
"Oh?" Xie Yao and Xie Yan were surprised by that.

"Tian Yizu, Tian You’an, Tian Wei, and Tian Xuanyin have been on my side for a long time. They have always been at odds with Tian Qiye, so they won’t be willing to help her." Xie Yao and Xie Yan didn’t know about the situation in the winged race, but they didn’t doubt Zhang Fei. "As for Tian Qiye’s close grand elders, three of them are already on my side, so only the other two are left."
"Who are those three people? And who are the other two?"

"Tian Yaoqin has long been my wife, and she helps me monitor Tian Qiye’s movements." Xie Yao and Xie Yan exchanged shocked glances. They hadn’t expected Zhang Fei to take one of Tian Qiye’s close confidants as his wife. "I enslaved Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu when they attacked the Nirvana Sky Domain several years ago, so only Tian Liefeng and Tian Hanyun are still loyal to her."
Xie Yao nodded in understanding. "Are you going to enslave them both later?"

"I haven’t thought about that yet." Zhang Fei paused. "However, an old friend of mine hates Tian Liefeng so much because he killed her parents in the past, and she has long wanted to kill him to avenge her parents’ deaths. Since she has a long-standing grudge against him, I will help her fulfill it, but it won’t happen anytime soon."
"Since we don’t have the strength to fight Tian Qiye and the winged race, we are forced to rely on you again in this matter."

"Whether I help you or not, I will fight Tian Qiye in the future." Zhang Fei thought of Xu Ling’er, who was the reincarnation of the first winged race, Tian Huangjin. He had long wanted to take her to the Radiance Domain, but he wasn’t ready to fight Tian Qiye, so he kept delaying his plans. "Sigh! One of my wives will take over the winged race in the future, and the enmity between the two races will end at that time."
"One of your wives?"

Zhang Fei nodded. "I won’t say anything for now, and you just have to wait for the time to come. At that time, she will become the leader of the winged race, and I will bring their members to the Ancient Realm."
"Why do you want to bring so many people into the Ancient Realm?"

"Because the population in the Ancient Realm is too small." Zhang Fei told them about some things but not in too much detail. "I still have other matters to attend to, so I’ll be going there now, and I’ll come back here to pick up Mo Tianshen later."
"Leave Mo Tianshen to me, Kid," Wu Mian said.
Huo Ling looked at Xie Yao and the others. "Husband, you can go there, and I’ll wait here until Mo Tianshen finishes his breakthrough."
"Alright."

Moments later, Zhang Fei had already entered the black castle to meet the four perils. He was actually reluctant to meet them since they were already useless after using the sacrificial technique Xu Yuanzhi had given them, but he had to meet them to find the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique.
Furthermore, Zhang Fei had discussed with Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao regarding the four perils, and they supported him in turning four of his wives into those evil beasts.
Taotie, Taowu, Qiongqi, and Hundun tensed up as soon as they saw Zhang Fei. They wanted to fight him, but they no longer had the strength.

"Hey! Why are you guys looking at me like that? I didn’t hurt you, and you ended up like this because of your stupidity in following Xu Yuanzhi’s orders." Zhang Fei looked at Qiongqi and opened a portal to the training space. "Hey! I have a surprise for you, and you’re going to be very surprised."

Qiongqi didn’t understand what Zhang Fei meant, but his expression changed as soon as Qi Qingxiu walked out of the portal. He had long wanted to take her as his wife, but she always refused him, and she didn’t even care about his threats.
Qi Qingxiu’s lips curled up as she hugged Zhang Fei’s arm. "Since you’ve met my husband, I don’t need to explain to you anymore, right?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded.
"However, Mo Tianshen will not replace his brother as leader of the Celestial Demon Race, and he will stay in the Ancient Realm with me."
"Then, who will be the new leader of the Celestial Demon Race?" Xie Yan asked.
Zhang Fei looked at her.
"Mo Zixiao will be their new leader, and he will be supported by Mo Shentian and Mo Zhejun.
Although they no longer have a demon god, the latter’s strength is on par with demon gods, so you guys shouldn’t mess with them."
"Haha," Xie Yao laughed.
"We are aware of our strength, and we only want to live peacefully in this domain, so we won’t possibly look for trouble by fighting them.
Do you think this Paradise Realm is safe now?"
Zhang Fei shrugged.
"Although nine out of ten demon races are now under me, there are still many evil cultivators out there.
Many of them hate all demon races, so you guys should still be careful out there."
"Honestly, we are not afraid of them, but we are still afraid of one race."
"The winged race."
"That’s right." Xie Yao nodded.
"Compared to the other races, the winged race hates the demon race much more.
If Tian Qiye knew that nine out of ten demon races were already under your control, she would probably order her subordinates to chase after the other demon races."
Xie Yan also spoke.
"Several years ago, we detected a member of the Winged Race entering this domain, but he immediately left again because he couldn’t get past all the natural formations here."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow.
"Why didn’t you two tell me at that time?
Do you recognize that person’s identity?"
"If I’m not mistaken, his name is Tian Liefeng, and he is Tian Qiye’s trusted grand elder."
Zhang Fei naturally remembered Tian Liefeng, and he was the person who killed Xiao Jingyi, or rather Ye Jingyi’s parents.
He had seen the man when Tian Qiye brought him to the Jiangshen Domain over six years ago, and he knew that the man was stronger than his slaves, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu.
Zhang Fei looked at the two lust demons.
"You two don’t need to worry about the winged race; I would definitely know if Tian Qiye ordered her close grand elders to attack this domain."
"Oh?" Xie Yao and Xie Yan were surprised by that.
"Tian Yizu, Tian You’an, Tian Wei, and Tian Xuanyin have been on my side for a long time.
They have always been at odds with Tian Qiye, so they won’t be willing to help her." Xie Yao and Xie Yan didn’t know about the situation in the winged race, but they didn’t doubt Zhang Fei.
"As for Tian Qiye’s close grand elders, three of them are already on my side, so only the other two are left."
"Who are those three people?
And who are the other two?"
"Tian Yaoqin has long been my wife, and she helps me monitor Tian Qiye’s movements." Xie Yao and Xie Yan exchanged shocked glances.
They hadn’t expected Zhang Fei to take one of Tian Qiye’s close confidants as his wife.
"I enslaved Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu when they attacked the Nirvana Sky Domain several years ago, so only Tian Liefeng and Tian Hanyun are still loyal to her."
Xie Yao nodded in understanding.
"Are you going to enslave them both later?"
"I haven’t thought about that yet." Zhang Fei paused.
"However, an old friend of mine hates Tian Liefeng so much because he killed her parents in the past, and she has long wanted to kill him to avenge her parents’ deaths.
Since she has a long-standing grudge against him, I will help her fulfill it, but it won’t happen anytime soon."
"Since we don’t have the strength to fight Tian Qiye and the winged race, we are forced to rely on you again in this matter."
"Whether I help you or not, I will fight Tian Qiye in the future." Zhang Fei thought of Xu Ling’er, who was the reincarnation of the first winged race, Tian Huangjin.
He had long wanted to take her to the Radiance Domain, but he wasn’t ready to fight Tian Qiye, so he kept delaying his plans.
"Sigh!
One of my wives will take over the winged race in the future, and the enmity between the two races will end at that time."
"One of your wives?"
Zhang Fei nodded.
"I won’t say anything for now, and you just have to wait for the time to come.
At that time, she will become the leader of the winged race, and I will bring their members to the Ancient Realm."
"Why do you want to bring so many people into the Ancient Realm?"
"Because the population in the Ancient Realm is too small." Zhang Fei told them about some things but not in too much detail.
"I still have other matters to attend to, so I’ll be going there now, and I’ll come back here to pick up Mo Tianshen later."
"Leave Mo Tianshen to me, Kid," Wu Mian said.
Huo Ling looked at Xie Yao and the others.
"Husband, you can go there, and I’ll wait here until Mo Tianshen finishes his breakthrough."
"Alright."
Moments later, Zhang Fei had already entered the black castle to meet the four perils.

He was actually reluctant to meet them since they were already useless after using the sacrificial technique Xu Yuanzhi had given them, but he had to meet them to find the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique.
Furthermore, Zhang Fei had discussed with Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao regarding the four perils, and they supported him in turning four of his wives into those evil beasts.
Taotie, Taowu, Qiongqi, and Hundun tensed up as soon as they saw Zhang Fei.
They wanted to fight him, but they no longer had the strength.
"Hey!
Why are you guys looking at me like that?
I didn’t hurt you, and you ended up like this because of your stupidity in following Xu Yuanzhi’s orders." Zhang Fei looked at Qiongqi and opened a portal to the training space.
"Hey!
I have a surprise for you, and you’re going to be very surprised."
Qiongqi didn’t understand what Zhang Fei meant, but his expression changed as soon as Qi Qingxiu walked out of the portal.
He had long wanted to take her as his wife, but she always refused him, and she didn’t even care about his threats.
Qi Qingxiu’s lips curled up as she hugged Zhang Fei’s arm.
"Since you’ve met my husband, I don’t need to explain to you anymore, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1871: Visit The Four Perils II
paragraphs: Qiongqi’s rage boiled over upon hearing this; he lunged forward, but Zhang Fei moved far faster.

Zhang Fei waved his right hand and slapped Qiongqi, causing him to vomit blood and roll on the floor. "Even if your strength hasn’t decreased, you’re no match for me, let alone now, with your strength having decreased significantly."
"Bastard!" Qiongqi roared and tried to attack them again.

Zhang Fei moved quickly to suppress Qiongqi and the other three, forcing them to lay prone on the ground. He wasted no time and forcibly pulled their souls out of their bodies. He replicated them and merged them with his soul.

Zhang Fei didn’t say anything and digested the memories, searching for the whereabouts of the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique. He frowned deeply after finding the answer, and Xu Yuanzhi had already taken the person away after teaching them the sacrificial technique.
"What happened, Husband?" Qi Qingxiu asked worriedly after seeing his expression.
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "Xu Yuanzhi took the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique away long ago."
"Does that mean that person is in the Ancient Realm?"

"I don’t know," Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "Xu Yuanzhi might have hidden that person in the Ancient Realm, but the situation there became too dangerous after the appearance of those shadow creatures, so it is highly likely he hid him in the Primordial Realm."
"So, what are you going to do now?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei had no solution to find the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique, so he decided to forget that person for now. "I want to focus on my cultivation first after this, and I will think of another way to find that person after I defeat Qian Yan in the future."

Qi Qingxiu actually hoped Zhang Fei would rely on Huo Ling to defeat Qian Yan, but she knew he was stubborn and wanted to defeat him with his own strength. "What are you going to do to the four of them? They are immortal-ranked beasts, so we will lose if you let them die."

"I was originally going to let them die, but I changed my mind about them," Zhang Fei looked at her and asked. "Do you want to become evil beasts? My other wives have already said they don’t want to become evil beasts, so I won’t force them. If you, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin want to become evil beasts, I will help you guys become ones."
"Dong Xuanyin is a female beast, right?"
"Oh, that’s right." Zhang Fei nodded. "If that’s the case, I’ll have to choose another demon wife."
"Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Yushu are the best choices, so you can choose one of them or even both."
"Why both?"
Qi Qingxiu looked at him with a smile. "They are Nalan Shizhe’s daughters, remember? She loves both of them very much, so I’m sure she’ll give her chance to one of them."
"That’s true," Zhang Fei agreed with her. "Moreover, she’s not yet willing to be my wife, so she’ll refuse and give up her chance for one of them."
"Let’s take the four of them to the Myriad Abyss Domain first, husband."
"Alright."
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei and Qi Qingxiu had arrived at Hua Qianmei’s secret place. They slammed the four evil beasts to the ground, shocking the people there.
"What are you doing, Husband? Why did you bring them here?" Ye Mingran asked.
Nalan Shizhe, Dong Xuanyin, Mo Zainan, and the other female demons were also confused, looking at the four evil beasts.
Zhang Fei explained his plans for the four evil beasts to them. "Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu are my first choices, but there are still two left, so I’ll choose two others from among you guys."
"I don’t need it." Nalan Shizhe immediately refused. "You can choose any of them."
"Me too." Dong Xuanyin also refused. "As you know, I am a demon beast, and my beast identity is quite special, so I don’t need them."

Mo Zainan was interested in becoming one of the four perils, but she wasn’t a selfish woman, and she hadn’t been Zhang Fei’s wife for very long. "Husband, I think you should choose two of your wives who have been your wives for much longer, like Nalan Yuzhu, Orith, Ilsath, Nalan Wangzi, or others."
"Husband, we don’t want to turn into demon beasts, and we will become lust demons forever." Ilshat and Orith immediately refused.
Zhang Fei looked at Eve, Fyr, and Ashreth. "What about you guys?"
"No," Eve was the first to refuse. "I’m satisfied with myself as a blood-sucking demon, Husband."
"Me too." Fyr nodded. "I don’t want to change races, and I want to be a dark elf for the rest of my life."
"Hehe," Ashreth laughed loudly, her massive breasts jiggling around. "Just like Fyr, I will remain a dark elf for the rest of my life, Husband."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and did not force them to become demon beasts. As for Nadea, White Amaris, and Black Amaris, they have long been transformed into demon beasts.
"What about you two?" Zhang Fei asked Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi.
Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi exchanged glances before nodding to him.
"Our physiques aren’t as strong as demon beasts, so we’re happy to transform into ones."
"But how are we going to choose between the four of them?"
"Isn’t that easy? We’ll draw lots, and I’ll transform you guys into demon beasts based on the results."
The four women smiled bitterly; none of them wanted to turn into the ugly Hundun. Compared to Taotie, Qiongqi, and Taowu, Hundun was the ugliest evil beast.

Zhang Fei smiled in amusement at their expressions. "Even though Hundun is the ugliest among them, his demon abilities are quite terrifying. Moreover, you don’t need to use your beast form every day, so I don’t think it’s a big problem."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Yushu, and Nalan Wangzi looked at one another before nodding in agreement. "You have to make the four draws, Husband."
"Good." Zhang Fei took four pieces of paper and wrote the names of the four beasts on them. He folded them all, shuffled them, and let them choose. "You guys have to choose now."
Qi Qingxiu was the first to choose, and she sighed with relief after picking up the slip of paper bearing the name "Taotie".
Ye Mingran also felt relieved after she chose the slip of paper bearing the name "Qiongxi."
"I’ll choose first, Big Sis." Nalan Yushu swiftly grabbed one of the two remaining slips of paper, but she didn’t open it right away. "Your turn, Big Sis."
Nalan Wangzi could only shake his head, and he took the last piece of paper before opening it. "Hahaha! I got Taowu!"

"Argh!" Nalan Yushu shouted in frustration upon hearing this, then hurriedly unfolded the paper in her hand. Her expression slumped the moment she saw the name "Hundun" written there. "Damn it! Why did I end up with that ugly pig? Big Sis—"
"No way!" Nalan Wangzi refused. "We made our choice fairly, so you have to accept the result."
"Ugh!" Nalan Yushu grumbled. "Husband, I don’t want to turn into that ugly pig, so you have to give it to someone else."
"Are you sure about that?"
"I’m sure!" Nalan Yushu nodded a few times. "There are still many demon beasts out there, so I won’t rush into becoming one."
"It’s up to you then." Zhang Fei looked at Mo Zainan. "Do you want to transform into Hundun?"
Mo Zainan nodded. "Since Nalan Yushu doesn’t want it, I’m willing to change to Hundun."
"Huh?" Nalan Yushu turned to her. "Won’t you regret your choice, Auntie?"

"No," Mo Zainan shook her head with a smile. "Hundun is one of the immortal-rank evil beasts, and our husband said that his abilities are quite terrifying. Besides, it won’t reduce his affection for me, so I don’t have a problem with that."
Nalan Yushu pointed her finger at the helpless Hundun. "But that pig is really ugly, Aunt!"
"Hehe," Mo Zainan giggled. "Hundun’s evil beast form is indeed ugly, but it won’t affect my human form. Besides, I don’t need to use my beast form every day, so it’s not a big deal."
Nalan Yushu shook her head helplessly. "Although his beast form won’t affect my human appearance, I still don’t want to become an ugly evil pig beast."
"It’s fine," Mo Zainan nodded. "Our husband has given us the opportunity to improve ourselves, so I won’t let that chance go to waste."

Since they had made their decision, Zhang Fei brought his four wives and the four evil beasts into the training room. However, he didn’t kill the four evil beasts, and he used the science capsule to duplicate their demon cores, just as he had transformed several of his other wives into beasts in the past.
Since the process would take a long time, Zhang Fei decided to leave the training space and return to the Endless Dungeon to check on Mo Tianshen.

By the time he arrived, Mo Tianshen had already completed his breakthrough, but he asked Zhang Fei not to send him back to the Myriad Abyss Domain. He asked him to bring Morgana to the Endless Domain first, and they proceeded directly to the Celestial Demon Domain.
Once everything was finished, Huo Ling immediately returned to Zhang Fei’s body, and he re-entered the training space.

After waiting a day, Mei finally finished duplicating the beast cores from the four perils. In addition to taking some of their body parts, Zhang Fei also took their origin bloodlines, as his four wives needed them to transform into evil beasts.
After Zhang Fei sent the four perils back to their domain, he began the process of turning Ye Mingran into an evil beast, and Mei operated the capsule after she lay inside it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1872: Liu Qingyu’s Mind And Wish
paragraphs: Zhang Fei stood beside the Celestial Spring Pool with his hands crossed behind his hips, thinking about his future.
It had been seven and a half months since the system had been inactive due to the upgrade process, and he still had to wait about four and a half months for it to end.

He couldn’t wait for the process to end, and he wanted to know the new features after the system upgraded to level ten. However, there was one thing that was bothering him, especially the beast races.
"What are you thinking, Husband?" Liu Qingyu asked, standing beside Zhang Fei.

"I’m thinking about our future, Qingyu." Zhang Fei hugged her waist and briefly kissed her. "In the past, I was more inclined towards my demon side than my human or beast side, so I thought of turning all of you into demons. However, not all of you were interested in becoming demons, and some of you ended up turning into beasts."
Liu Qingyu leaned her head on his shoulder. "Are you thinking of turning us into beasts now, Husband?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "After all, beasts have stronger physiques than humans, right? If you guys transform into beasts, your physiques will become stronger."

"Besides having stronger physiques, beasts also have longer lifespans than humans." Liu Qingyu nodded in agreement. "With our current cultivation level, we can live for over ten million years. Our lifespans will continue to increase as our cultivation improves, but we feel that it’s not enough. After all, we’re different from you, and we don’t have all your advantages. We don’t have the confidence to reach the Three God Realms, let alone the Exalt Supreme Realm."

Zhang Fei hummed softly. "All of you are my wives, so I want you guys to stay by my side forever. That’s why I’m thinking of turning the rest of you into beasts, but I won’t use random beasts for you, and you must transform into beasts that can evolve into immortal-rank beasts."
"Even if we transform into beasts with the ability to evolve to immortal rank, we will never become immortal, right?"

"Unfortunately, there’s nothing we can do about it." Zhang Fei sighed regretfully. "Even if I become the ten-tailed fox in the future, I still won’t be immortal because immortality doesn’t exist. Even if immortality doesn’t exist, we can still live for hundreds of millions or even billions of years, and I think that’s enough for us."
"Haha," Liu Qingyu softly laughed. "If we can live that long, we might be able to see our descendants for hundreds of generations to come."
Zhang Fei turned to her with a smile. "Isn’t that great?"
"That’s certainly good, but it will get boring, and I don’t want that."
"Why?"
"Honestly, I feel that longevity and immortality are a curse, husband."
"A curse?"

Liu Qingyu nodded. "Before I met you, I never knew about cultivation above the Ten Mortal Realms, but everything changed after your sudden appearance in the Chu Clan. After that day, I slowly got to know the existence of other realms, the Seven Divine Realms, the Five Celestial Realms, the Three God Realms, and the Exalt Supreme Realm."

"I would have never known about all that either if it wasn’t for Feng Yao." Zhang Fei’s expression turned mellow. "After all, I used to be an Earthling, and people on Earth had no knowledge about cultivation and the like. Many of them wrote stories about immortality, but those stories were just fictional stories based on their fantasies. However, my life changed after that young girl accidentally killed me and brought me back to life, which became the starting point in my new life. After that, I went to the Sky Jade, and I met you and your two daughters there."

"Back then, you were a naughty little fox, you know? You did that kind of thing to Ying’er, and you also seduced me even though you knew that I already had a husband." Zhang Fei showed off his white teeth at Liu Qingyu. "After we had sex for the first time, I felt guilty towards the late Chu Hong, but I couldn’t stop myself. In the end, he disappeared without a trace, and he suddenly died without clarity. I couldn’t even find his corpse, and I couldn’t give him a proper burial back then."
Zhang Fei embraced her. "Let’s not talk about the past anymore because it’s all in the past."

"Mhmm," Liu Qingyue nodded. "I never thought about longevity and immortality, and I was ready to accept death when my lifespan was up. I thought that kind of life was the best, but circumstances have changed, and I will live for tens of millions of years with my current cultivation."
Zhang Fei stared into her eyes. "Do you prefer that kind of life to longevity?"

"Yes," Liu Qingyu nodded earnestly. "As I said before, longevity is a curse. My cultivation is quite high, but I was able to reach this stage not because of my own efforts, and you continue to help me improve it. However—"
"Why are you hesitating? You can continue your words, and I will listen to you."

"Do you remember the beginning of our relationship, Ying’er?"
"How could I forget that?" Chu Ying asked back with a strange smile, recalling the events of their first meeting.

chapters.title: Chapter 1879: Qing Yi, Zhong Yan, Tang Ziyu, And Shen Family
paragraphs: "Back then, I thought you were just a little fox, and I didn’t know you could already transform into a human. I took you to my room, and you committed an independent act on me." Chu Ying paused and looked at Zhang Fei with a beaming smile.

Zhang Fei caressed her face. "From the moment I first saw you, I was immediately drawn to you; otherwise, I wouldn’t have done that to you, Ying’er. Even though I knew it was wrong, I did it anyway to make you mine."

"I’m grateful that you did that to me; otherwise, we would never have been together, and I would definitely have married another man." Chu Ying pressed his palm to her cheek. "The only thing missing from our relationship now is children, and I want to have two of them with you when you’re ready."
"We will have two children when the time comes, Ying’er." Zhang Fei looked at Chu Xing on his left.
Compared to his relationships with Chu Qing and Chu Ying, Zhang Fei’s relationship with Chu Xing developed more normally and followed a more gradual progression.

Although Chu Xing had long been by his side, Zhang Fei took her as his wife when he went to the Xianjin Realm for the first time. She was the one who caused the harem feature to upgrade to level three. (Chapter 827)
Chu Xing’s lips curled up. "Why are you looking at me like this, husband?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei shook his head. "I was just reminiscing about our relationship from the beginning until you became my wife, Xing’er."
"Hehe," Chu Xing giggled. "If I remember correctly, I had to wait over a year to become your wife from the moment we first met."
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "I knew you had fallen in love with me, but Chu Hong’s death weighed heavily on your heart. After Shang Huaqiang died, you finally let go of that burden and became my wife."

Chu Xing naturally still remembered all those events. "Back then, I brought Wei Luan to see you, and I thought of serving you together with her. Unfortunately, she couldn’t accept her feelings and ran away, and your relationship with her has never progressed to this day."

"I’ve known for a long time that Wei Luan likes me, and her feelings for me remain unchanged to this day, but my relationship with Yi Na has always been a burden to her." Zhang Fei paused. "If she can get that burden off her heart, I will take her as my wife in the future."

After discussing a few other matters, Zhang Fei began dual cultivation with the three women, and they spent a few days inside the bedroom. He could have continued dual cultivation with them for longer, but they gave up and begged him to let them go.
After they finished, Chu Ying and Chu Qing cultivated in their bedroom. Chu Xing went to another bedroom to speak with her best friend, Wei Luan.

Even though he had been dual cultivating with some of his wives for several days, Zhang Fei did not intend to rest just yet because his physique was much stronger. He asked Qing Yi, Zhong Yan, and Tang Ziyu to enter the main bedroom.
Zhang Fei looked at Zhong Yan first. "Yan’er, you already have the thunder dragon bloodline in your body, right?"
"Hmm?" Zhong Yan immediately guessed what he meant. "Are you thinking of transforming me into a true thunder dragon, husband?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "After all, beasts have a longer lifespan, and their physique is stronger than humans. Since you already have the thunder dragon bloodline in your body, I only need to take some parts of Long Jishan’s body and clone his dragon core. Thereafter, I can transform you into a true thunder dragon, and you will be stronger than before."

"I have no problem with that, husband." In fact, Zhong Yan had been waiting for this ever since Zhang Fei transformed his other wives into beasts without killing those evil beasts, yet he had never said anything to him about it. "When are you going to do it?"
"After we finish dual cultivation."
"Alright."

Zhang Fei looked at Tang Ziyu. "Although you have the Tusked War Elephant Tiger Bloodline in your body, I feel that beast isn’t suitable for you. When I find a more suitable beast for you, I will transform you into one."
"Does that mean you’re going to turn all your wives into beasts, Husband?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "Many of them have become demons, and many others have become beasts, but the rest are still ordinary humans. As I said before, beasts have a longer lifespan and are physically stronger than humans, so I will transform the rest into beasts as well."
Tang Ziyu nodded in understanding. "In that case, you don’t need to look for a new beast for me, husband."
"Do you want to transform into the Tusked War Elephant Tiger?"

"Yes," Tang Ziyu nodded. "The Tusked War Elephant Tiger is different from dragons and phoenixes, but it is also a rare beast, and Xiang Zhan is the only one left in this universe. Besides, I am already used to his bloodline in my body, so I think you can turn me into his beast race."
Zhang Fei could see the determination on her face. "Alright, I’ll transform you into the Tusked War Elephant Tiger after we finish dual cultivation."
"Thank you, husband."

Then, Zhang Fei looked at his mother, Qing Yi. "Yi’er, you always said that you didn’t want to transform into a demon or a beast, right? However, I have made up my mind, and I will turn the rest of my human wives into beasts, including you."

"Since you’ve decided that, I’ll follow your plan, Fei’er." At first, Qing Yi had no thoughts of turning into a beast, and she wanted to remain a human for the rest of her life. However, she knew she could not refuse Zhang Fei, and she chose to agree with him. "When are you going to do it, Fei’er?"

Zhang Fei pulled her to sit on his lap. "I haven’t found a suitable beast for you, Yi’er. When I find the most suitable one, I will transform you into that beast. By the way, do you want to have children with me?"
"Huh?" Qing Yi was taken aback. "Do you really want to have children with me, Fei’er?"
"Of course." Zhang Fei planted a soft kiss on her lips. "You are one of my wives, remember? Since you’re my wife, naturally I want to have children with you."
Qing Yi fell silent and pondered the matter seriously. Although she had grown accustomed to their relationship and her status as Zhang Fei’s wife, she had never considered having children with him.
Zhang Fei caressed her face. "You don’t need to decide that matter now; I won’t be having children anytime soon, so you still have plenty of time to prepare yourself."
"Alright." Qing Yi felt relieved by that.
Like with his other wives, Zhang Fei dual cultivated with Zhong Yan, Qing Yi, and Tang Ziyu for several days in the pavilion.
After they finished dual cultivating, Zhang Fei summoned Long Jishan and Xiang Zhan out of his beast space. He asked for some of their body parts, and he also cloned their beast cores.
After everything was done, Zhang Fei began to transform Zhong Yan into the true thunder dragon, followed by transforming Tian Ziyu into the true Tusked War Elephant Tiger.
Once everything was finished, Zhang Fei took Shen Huang, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Yu to the main bedroom. He looked at the three women from three different generations with a smile.
Shen Huang was Shen Xueyi’s grandmother, and Shen Xueyi was Shen Yu’s mother.
In their family, there was one other woman, Shen Xinya, who was Shen Xueyi’s mother and Shen Yu’s grandmother.

Zhang Fei admitted that Shen Xinya was no less beautiful than the three women, but he never liked her character. Although she had changed a lot compared to when they lived in the Sky Jade Realm, he never considered taking her as his woman.

Even after the three women persuaded him several times, Zhang Fei remained unmoved by his decision. "Since the three of you are sea serpents, and Yu’er already has the rain dragon bloodline in her body, I will find stronger bloodlines for the two of you. Or do you two want to change into other beasts?"
"No," Shen Huang and Shen Xueyi immediately refused.
"We will always be sea serpents for the rest of our lives, Husband."
"We don’t mind if you want to find stronger bloodlines for us, but we will never transform into other beasts, Husband."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Alright, I’ve always respected your choices. Since you guys don’t want to transform into other beasts, I won’t force you, and you guys will remain sea serpents forever."
Shen Huang, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Yu sighed with relief upon hearing that. They immediately removed their dresses to begin dual cultivation with Zhang Fei.
Just like before, Zhang Fei spent several days engaging in dual cultivation with the three female sea serpents. Shen Huang, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Yu returned to their room after they finished.

Zhang Fei didn’t immediately continue dual cultivation with his other wives; instead, he left the training room to check on something. He didn’t spend long outside and returned to the training room after he finished checking, and he took Zhao Ziqin and Ye Lian with him to the main bedroom.
"Husband." Ye Lian sat on Zhang Fei’s lap, acting coquettishly. "Will you turn me into a beast like Ziqin too, Husband?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei nodded. "I will turn all my human wives into beasts, but I won’t do it in a hurry, and I will find the best beasts for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1880: Meet Long Wuzhao And Feng Yao
paragraphs: Ye Lian nodded in satisfaction. "You don’t need to look for a mythical or immortal-ranked beast for me, husband. Even if I transform into a sea serpent like Sister Shen Yu, I’ll be satisfied with that."

"No," Zhang Fei rejected that. "Honestly, I am satisfied with Shen Yu, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Huang. Unfortunately, their beast forms are limited to the divine rank, and they will never rise to the mythical rank, let alone the immortal rank. However, I have another way for them to reach the mythical rank, and I need other beast bloodlines for that."
"Doesn’t Sister Shen Yu have the rain dragon bloodline in her body, husband?"

Zhang Fei nodded to Zhao Ziqin. "Yu’er has the rain dragon bloodline, and it can help her reach the mythical rank, but it’s not enough to help her reach the immortal rank. Meanwhile, I haven’t found two suitable bloodlines for Shen Xueyi and Shen Huang, but I can look for them in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."
"I see." Zhao Ziqin nodded in understanding. "What if I give them my sky dragon bloodline? The sky dragon race has long been extinct, and I am the only sky dragon in this universe."

"I think that’s a good idea." Zhang Fei immediately agreed. "However, you can’t give away too much of your sky dragon origin bloodline, or you will be weakened by it. At most, you can give them ten drops each, and it won’t affect you much."
Zhao Ziqin nodded to him. "If that’s the case, I’ll give each of them ten drops of my bloodline."
"Alright." Zhang Fei laid both women on the bed and began their dual cultivation.
Unlike Zhao Ziqin, Ye Lian’s physique was weak because she was an ordinary human, and she couldn’t last long under Zhang Fei’s onslaught.
Meanwhile, Zhao Ziqin possessed a strong physique after transforming into a dragon, and her lust also increased drastically, allowing her to endure his onslaught for a long time.

They spent several days in seclusion, equivalent to two days in the outside world. Most of the time, Zhang Fei was dual-cultivating with Zhao Ziqin because her lust was insatiable, with Ye Lian watching them from the side while resting.
After they finished, Ye Lian returned to her bedroom to rest and cultivate. Zhao Ziqin, on the other hand, went to Shen Xueyi’s and Shen Huang’s bedrooms to give them her bloodline.
Janette and Lillea walked side by side into the master bedroom, and Zhang Fei was already waiting for them there.

Janette’s eyes lit up when she saw that Zhang Fei was naked; she hurriedly took off her green dress before approaching him, sitting on his lap. "Hehe! Are you still not satisfied after dual cultivating with my sisters for several days, husband?"

"Do you think I would be satisfied just dual cultivating with them?" Zhang Fei hugged her waist and kissed her. "Even though I’ve been dual cultivating for several days, my lust is still very high. Since my lust is still unsatisfied, I’ll eat you and your mother after this."
Janette turned to Lillea, who immediately took off her dark green dress. "Who do you like best among us, husband?"

"I like you both equally, no less, no more." Janette pursed her lips in response to Zhang Fei. "By the way, I was thinking of finding evil beasts for you two, so your physiques will be stronger after transforming into evil beasts."
"Huh?" Janette and Lillea were surprised by that.
"Do you really want to transform us into evil beasts, husband?"
"If you transform us into evil beasts, we’re no longer Dryads, right?"
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered Angela, and he summoned her to join them.
A few minutes later, Angela entered the bedroom and immediately took off her dress. "Do you want me to join you, husband?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei looked at Janette and Lillea. "When Angela transforms into a Rainbow-Shelled Tortoise, she retains all of her abilities as a rainbow fish demon, so you two don’t have to worry about losing your abilities as Dryads."
Janette and Lillea were relieved upon hearing that, as Zhang Fei needed their abilities as Dryads to take care of all the herbs in the Sealed World Pearl.
"Let’s start now."
"Okay."
In the end, Zhang Fei spent several days with the three women, equivalent to a day in the outside world. The three women did not rest, and they cultivated in their bedrooms.

After dual cultivating for several days in a row, Zhang Fei decided to leave the training space and go to Qian Yan’s domain. He used his invisibility to meet Qian Yu and asked him about his father’s situation.

"My father contacted me about three weeks ago, and he suspected that you took those four people away." Zhang Fei wasn’t surprised to hear the news because Qian Yan could monitor his palace using his eye abilities. "He wasn’t too concerned about the disappearances of Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian, but he was furious about Qian Hua’s disappearance. Honestly, I don’t know the reason behind my father’s decision to prioritize Hua’er so much, but she seems very important to him."

Zhang Fei naturally knew why Qian Yan prioritized Qian Hua; she was the owner of the Sovereign Demon Physique. Although the Sovereign Demon Physique wasn’t as special as those ten special physiques, it was still far superior to ordinary physiques. "When will your father arrive in this domain?"
"The Jiangshen Domain is too far from this domain, and my father departed from there about three weeks ago. If my calculations are correct, he should arrive in a little over two months."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "If that’s the case, I’ll go back now, and I’ll come to see your father in ten years."
"Huh? Ten years?"

"I will challenge your father to a fight at that time, and I will subdue him." Qian Yu’s jaw dropped after Zhang Fei said that. "Honestly, I can defeat and subdue him whenever I want, but I want to try to do it using my own strength, so I won’t rush into fighting him. Alright, I’ll go now, and you can tell Wu Mian when your father is back."

"Alright." Qian Yu let out a soft sigh after Zhang Fei disappeared. "Can he really defeat and subdue my father? If he can really do that, he can free Qin’er from his control, and she will live a happy life in the future."
After returning to the training space, Zhang Fei did not immediately dual cultivate with his other wives; instead, he entered the beast space to meet Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao.

Zhang Fei looked at Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan, who were seriously cultivating in one area. He could feel that the two female beasts had reached the Divine Transformation Realm, which was quite impressive. After all, they cultivated without using his yang qi and dual cultivation technique, so their cultivation was not as fast as his wives’.

Zhang Fei also observed all the contract beasts living inside. Sha Huoyan, Shou Yunzhi, and Xiang Zhan were still the strongest among them. When he found them in the second area of the Sealed World Pearl, their cultivation had already reached the Five Celestial Realms. Instead of making a contract with them, he gave them to Wu Lianzhi, Xian Xianqin, and Tang Ziyu.
Among the other contract beasts, Long Jishan, Tianguo, Lei Que, Hu Yi, and Hu Er were the slowest to develop. After all, they were male beasts, and Zhang Fei only gave them random female yin qi.
On the other hand, Jie Yuan, You Bai, Hai Ma, and Lan Zhen were female beasts. They developed faster because they were cultivating using Zhang Fei’s yang qi and dual cultivation technique.

Zhang Fei considered giving one female yin demon to Xiang Zhan, Long Jishan, Tianguo, Lei Que, Hu Yi, and Hu Er. That way, they could cultivate much faster and could reach the Five Celestial Realms sooner than he originally expected.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei couldn’t send the female yin demon into the beast space because she was not a beast, and the male beasts had to absorb her yin qi in the training space.
After thinking about it seriously, Zhang Fei sent the six male beasts to the training space, and one of his clones went to the Frozen Yin Domain to capture a female yin demon.
After Zhang Fei’s clone returned to the training space with the female yin demon, he taught the six male beasts the method to absorb her yin qi, and they used it to absorb her yin qi together.

As usual, Zhang Fei gave his yang qi to Sha Huoyan, Shou Yunzhi, You Bai, Hai Ma, and Lan Zhen. Among them, he had only ever dual-cultivated with Lan Zhen, and he had never touched the other four, even though they could transform into humans.
Zhang Fei wanted to give his yang qi to Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan, but they always rejected his good intentions because they had no desire to be his wives, so he didn’t force them.
Zhang Fei then went to the area where Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao were cultivating. "What brings you here today, kid? Do you miss your wife?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed and sat down in front of them. "Yao’er is my wife, so I’ll always miss her. However, I didn’t come here to spend time with her, but I wanted to ask you something."
Long Wuzhao was taken aback. "What do you want to ask me?"
"Are there any beast races that are small in number in your domain?"

"The void dragon is one of them." Zhang Fei just remembered that there were only a few void dragons in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. "Are you thinking about turning all your human wives into female beasts?"

"I like you both equally, no less, no more." Janette pursed her lips in response to Zhang Fei.
"By the way, I was thinking of finding evil beasts for you two, so your physiques will be stronger after transforming into evil beasts."
"Huh?" Janette and Lillea were surprised by that.
"Do you really want to transform us into evil beasts, husband?"
"If you transform us into evil beasts, we’re no longer Dryads, right?"
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered Angela, and he summoned her to join them.
A few minutes later, Angela entered the bedroom and immediately took off her dress.
"Do you want me to join you, husband?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei looked at Janette and Lillea.
"When Angela transforms into a Rainbow-Shelled Tortoise, she retains all of her abilities as a rainbow fish demon, so you two don’t have to worry about losing your abilities as Dryads."
Janette and Lillea were relieved upon hearing that, as Zhang Fei needed their abilities as Dryads to take care of all the herbs in the Sealed World Pearl.
"Let’s start now."
"Okay."
In the end, Zhang Fei spent several days with the three women, equivalent to a day in the outside world.
The three women did not rest, and they cultivated in their bedrooms.
After dual cultivating for several days in a row, Zhang Fei decided to leave the training space and go to Qian Yan’s domain.
He used his invisibility to meet Qian Yu and asked him about his father’s situation.

"My father contacted me about three weeks ago, and he suspected that you took those four people away." Zhang Fei wasn’t surprised to hear the news because Qian Yan could monitor his palace using his eye abilities.
"He wasn’t too concerned about the disappearances of Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian, but he was furious about Qian Hua’s disappearance.
Honestly, I don’t know the reason behind my father’s decision to prioritize Hua’er so much, but she seems very important to him."
Zhang Fei naturally knew why Qian Yan prioritized Qian Hua; she was the owner of the Sovereign Demon Physique.
Although the Sovereign Demon Physique wasn’t as special as those ten special physiques, it was still far superior to ordinary physiques.
"When will your father arrive in this domain?"
"The Jiangshen Domain is too far from this domain, and my father departed from there about three weeks ago.
If my calculations are correct, he should arrive in a little over two months."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"If that’s the case, I’ll go back now, and I’ll come to see your father in ten years."
"Huh?
Ten years?"
"I will challenge your father to a fight at that time, and I will subdue him." Qian Yu’s jaw dropped after Zhang Fei said that.
"Honestly, I can defeat and subdue him whenever I want, but I want to try to do it using my own strength, so I won’t rush into fighting him.
Alright, I’ll go now, and you can tell Wu Mian when your father is back."
"Alright." Qian Yu let out a soft sigh after Zhang Fei disappeared.
"Can he really defeat and subdue my father?
If he can really do that, he can free Qin’er from his control, and she will live a happy life in the future."
After returning to the training space, Zhang Fei did not immediately dual cultivate with his other wives; instead, he entered the beast space to meet Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao.
Zhang Fei looked at Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan, who were seriously cultivating in one area.
He could feel that the two female beasts had reached the Divine Transformation Realm, which was quite impressive.
After all, they cultivated without using his yang qi and dual cultivation technique, so their cultivation was not as fast as his wives’.
Zhang Fei also observed all the contract beasts living inside.
Sha Huoyan, Shou Yunzhi, and Xiang Zhan were still the strongest among them.
When he found them in the second area of the Sealed World Pearl, their cultivation had already reached the Five Celestial Realms.
Instead of making a contract with them, he gave them to Wu Lianzhi, Xian Xianqin, and Tang Ziyu.
Among the other contract beasts, Long Jishan, Tianguo, Lei Que, Hu Yi, and Hu Er were the slowest to develop.
After all, they were male beasts, and Zhang Fei only gave them random female yin qi.
On the other hand, Jie Yuan, You Bai, Hai Ma, and Lan Zhen were female beasts.
They developed faster because they were cultivating using Zhang Fei’s yang qi and dual cultivation technique.
Zhang Fei considered giving one female yin demon to Xiang Zhan, Long Jishan, Tianguo, Lei Que, Hu Yi, and Hu Er.
That way, they could cultivate much faster and could reach the Five Celestial Realms sooner than he originally expected.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei couldn’t send the female yin demon into the beast space because she was not a beast, and the male beasts had to absorb her yin qi in the training space.
After thinking about it seriously, Zhang Fei sent the six male beasts to the training space, and one of his clones went to the Frozen Yin Domain to capture a female yin demon.
After Zhang Fei’s clone returned to the training space with the female yin demon, he taught the six male beasts the method to absorb her yin qi, and they used it to absorb her yin qi together.
As usual, Zhang Fei gave his yang qi to Sha Huoyan, Shou Yunzhi, You Bai, Hai Ma, and Lan Zhen.
Among them, he had only ever dual-cultivated with Lan Zhen, and he had never touched the other four, even though they could transform into humans.
Zhang Fei wanted to give his yang qi to Lei Huoting and Yuwen Xingyuan, but they always rejected his good intentions because they had no desire to be his wives, so he didn’t force them.
Zhang Fei then went to the area where Feng Yao and Long Wuzhao were cultivating.
"What brings you here today, kid?
Do you miss your wife?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed and sat down in front of them.
"Yao’er is my wife, so I’ll always miss her.
However, I didn’t come here to spend time with her, but I wanted to ask you something."
Long Wuzhao was taken aback.
"What do you want to ask me?"
"Are there any beast races that are small in number in your domain?"
"The void dragon is one of them." Zhang Fei just remembered that there were only a few void dragons in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
"Are you thinking about turning all your human wives into female beasts?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1881: Thee Female Beasts
paragraphs: Zhang Fei nodded. "I feel that the best option is to turn them into beasts, but I don’t want to use random beasts for them. Unfortunately, I can’t use my Calamity Demon Dragon and your Five-Clawed Golden Dragon on them."

"That’s true." Long Wuzhao nodded in agreement. "The Calamity Demon Dragon and the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon are special existences, and only one can exist in each era. My descendants cannot inherit my bloodline, so I’ve never thought about getting married."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed out loud. "You are a strange dragon, you know? A dragon’s lust is extremely high, but you don’t have a woman to channel your lust."
"Who said I don’t have a woman to satisfy my lust?"
"Oh? Do you really have a woman by your side? Why have I never seen one?"
"Ask her." Long Wuzhao pointed his finger at Feng Yao.

"Hahaha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "Even though the number of his women is not as many as yours, he has several of them by his side, but they never appear in public. In fact, one of them is my old friend, and she is a vermilion bird, like Zhu Shanniang."
"Oh? I didn’t expect that!" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that. "Why do they never appear in public?"

"They are not interested in the situation outside, and they are fully focused on their cultivation in my secret chamber." Long Wuzhao waved his hand, created five qi screens, and showed images of five women. "They are my women, but we never married. Zhu Niao is a vermilion bird, Wu Ying is the three-legged golden crow, Chi Wuyao is a hornless dragon, Jin is the golden-haired hou, and Chang’e is the moon rabbit."
Zhang Fei blinked repeatedly. "Chang’e? Moon rabbit?"
"Yes." Long Wuzhao pointed at one of the screens. "She is Chang’e."
Zhang Fei saw the woman’s appearance on the screen. "She resembles the moon goddess Chang’e from the legends on Earth."
"If you want to transform one of your wives into a moon rabbit, I can ask her to help you."
Zhang Fei nodded to him. "I’m interested in turning three of my wives into a hornless dragon, a golden-haired hou, and a moon rabbit."
"Alright." Long Wuzhao rose to his feet. "If that’s the case, you have to take me back to my domain, and I will take you to meet them."
"Yao’er, I’ll see you later."
"Okay."
After that, Zhang Fei took Long Wuzhao out of the beast space and took him back to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

Long Wuzhao led Zhang Fei to the lowest floor of the golden palace, where there was only a golden door. He took out a golden plaque and placed it in the golden door, causing it to disappear by itself. "Let’s go in."

Inside the room, Zhang Fei saw five beautiful, mature women who were seriously cultivating. He had to admit that they were beautiful, but their beauty was inferior to that of his wives. After all, all his wives had swallowed the Youthful Retaining Pill and the Beauty Restoring Pill, which made their beauty unmatched.
"Their cultivation has already reached the Celestial God Realm." Zhang Fei was truly shocked after reading their status.

"Haha," Long Wuzhao laughed at his shocked expression. "Actually, the Celestial God Realm is attainable, but we have to cultivate non-stop for a long time. They never care about outside world affairs, and they rarely stop cultivating."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "They only stop cultivating when they serve you, right?"
"Yes." Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "They feel our presence, but they don’t care about us, and they will stop if I wake them."

Zhang Fei took a deep breath after hearing that; he felt that the five women were too extreme in their cultivation. He himself could cultivate for a long time, but he wasn’t as zealous as they were, and he spent most of his time dual cultivating with his wives.
"Wait." Long Wang approached Chi Wuyao, Jin, and Chang’e before waking them from their cultivation.
Chi Wuyao was the first to open her eyes; she looked at Long Wang in confusion. "Is it time to serve you, Husband?"
"Not yet." Long Wang turned to Jin and Chang’e, who had also opened their eyes. "I deliberately woke the three of you for something important, and I hope you won’t refuse."
"What do you need from us, Husband?" Jin asked.
Chang’e looked at Zhang Fei. "Who is that young man, Husband? Why did you bring him here?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox." The three women gasped in shock as soon as Long Wuzhao mentioned that. "Besides being the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, he is also the one and only Calamity Demon Dragon."
"What?" The three women screamed in shock.
"Are you serious about that, husband?"
"How could he be the successor of Hu Tianlang and Long Zhaihuo, husband?"
"Does that mean he has two beast forms, husband?"
"Haha," Long Wuzhao laughed. "Zhang Fei is the most special living being in this universe. Not only does he have two beast forms, but he is also a human and a demon."
The three women looked at Zhang Fei in shock; they remembered the writing left by Hu Tianlang, and their husbands had long awaited his appearance.
Zhang Fei walked towards them as he transformed into his half-fox, half-dragon, and lust demon forms in sequence. "It is a pleasure to meet the three of you, seniors."
"I didn’t expect that the writing Hu Tianlang left behind would come true." Chi Wuyao stood up, observing Zhang Fei.
Jin also rose to her feet, nodding in satisfaction. "The heir of the ten-tailed fox, huh? Your cultivation has already reached the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm at such a young age."
"What do you want from us, the heir of the ten-tailed fox?" Chang asked expressionlessly; she did not rise to her feet.

"I need the help of the three of you to transform three of my wives into your beast races." The three women looked at Zhang Fei in confusion. "You may not believe me, but I can transform my human wives into female beasts. I have already transformed some of them into female beasts in the past, but I still have a few human wives, and I want to transform them into your beast races."

Long Wuzhao nodded at them. "Zhang Fei didn’t lie to you three, and he’s already proven it by transforming himself into the Calamity Demon Dragon. He only needs some of your body parts and beast cores, but he won’t take your beast cores."
"How is he going to do it?"
"Let me show you three."
Zhang Fei created a Qi screen that showed the process of Yue Xuelian becoming a Yin Dragon. He sped up his memories; otherwise, he would have wasted too much time.
After everything was done, Zhang Fei asked them, "Do you three believe me now?"
"We believe you, but what about our beast cores?"

Zhang Fei took out the science capsule, surprising Long Wuzhao and the three women. "I got this device from someone, but I can’t explain the details to you. If you guys lie inside this capsule, I can clone your beast cores, and I will use them to turn my three wives into your beast race."
"Let me try it first," Chi Wuyao volunteered.
"Alright." Zhang Fei opened the capsule lid; he didn’t take them to the training room for several reasons. "I’ll start the process once you lie down inside."
Chi Wuyao nodded to Zhang Fei, jumped onto the capsule, and lay down inside. Although she volunteered to try it first, she was worried about her safety.
Zhang Fei immediately closed the capsule and asked Mei to start the process, but it would take quite a long time since there was no time formation there, like the one inside the training space.
Jin and Chang’e stood at the side, watching Chi Wuyao through the glass lid. They saw their sister quickly fall asleep inside, but they didn’t see her beast core coming out of her body.
Zhang Fei spoke to them. "Wait for the process to complete, and you two will see the results at that time."

About three hours later, Jin and Chang’e saw Chi Wuyao’s beast core floating above her body. They immediately checked her insides and found her beast core still there, which convinced them that the beast core before their eyes was the clone.

"Do you two believe me now?" Jin and Chang’e nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately opened the glass cover and stored the beast core in the system inventory. Then, he woke Chi Wuyao and helped her get out of the capsule. "Thank you."
"Did it work?" Chi Wuyao asked.
"Yes." Zhang Fei showed the beast core to her. "Next, I need some of your body parts and origin bloodline."

Chi Wuyao nodded and gave Zhang Fei some of her body parts, such as her hair, nails, and a few others. She took out a bottle, filled it with a few drops of her origin bloodline, and gave it to him. "My hornless dragon race is already few in number in this universe, so I’d be happy if one of your wives became one."
"Don’t worry, the number of the hornless dragon race will increase in the future." Zhang Fei stored everything into the system inventory. "Who’s next?"
"Me." Jin hurriedly lay down inside the capsule. "You can start now."
Six hours later, the process was complete. Jin and Chang’e gave some of their body parts and origin bloodlines to Zhang Fei.
"If you’ve transformed your three wives into our three beast races, you must bring them here to meet us," Chang’e said.
Zhang Fei had no problem with that. "Alright, I’ll definitely bring them to meet you three, and you guys can see the results firsthand."

chapters.title: Chapter 1882: Turning Six Wives Into Female Beasts
paragraphs: Since the four perils had been defeated, the two primordial beasts were far away in the Ancient Realm, and Qian Yan was still far from his domain, Zhang Fei decided to leave Long Wuzhao in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain for the time being.

Long Wuzhao himself took refuge in Zhang Fei’s beast space more than three months ago, which was accelerated several times by the difference in time flow between the two places. He did not leave the secret place; instead, he woke up his other two women to accompany them.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at the pavilion; he immediately asked Tang Ziyu, Wu Lianzhi, and Xian Xianqin to gather in the garden.
After bringing out the science capsule, Zhang Fei summoned Xiang Zhan, Shou Yunzhi, and Sha Huoyan to meet them.
After the three beasts gathered, Zhang Fei explained his plan to turn Tang Ziyu, Wu Lianzhi, and Xian Xianqin into female beasts according to their beast races.
Xiang Zhan, Shou Yunzhi, and Sha Huoyan were overjoyed. After all, the Tusked War Elephant Tiger, the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, and the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant have long been extinct.

The three of them were the only ones left from their three beast races. They were delighted to hear that Zhang Fei wanted to transform Tang Ziyu, Wu Lianzhi, and Xian Xianqin into female beasts according to their beast races.
This way, the number of members of their three beast races would increase even more in the future, especially when they gave birth to Zhang Fei’s children.

Zhang Fei didn’t waste any more time and asked the three beasts to take turns lying inside the science capsule, allowing Mei to clone their beast cores, which was the most important part to turn his three wives into female beasts.
Since she inherited Xiang Zhan’s origin bloodline and discussed it with Zhang Fei a few days ago, Tang Ziyu had already decided to transform into the Tusked War Elephant Tiger.
At first, Wu Lianzhi was not interested in becoming a female beast, but she changed her mind after Zhang Fei explained the beast’s long lifespan and stronger physique to her.

Wu Lianzhi was always exhausted when dual cultivating with him, and she felt that turning into a female beast could boost her physique. Since she had inherited Sha Huoyan’s origin bloodline, she decided to transform into the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant.
On the other hand, Xian Xianqin didn’t think about whether she would remain a human or a female beast. She only wanted the best for herself and Zhang Fei.

Since Zhang Fei had decided that, and she had long inherited Shou Yunzhi’s origin bloodline, Xian Xianqin decided to transform into the Sunfire Emperor Behemoth, which would strengthen her physique several times over.

The process of cloning the three beasts’ beast cores ended a few hours later, and Zhang Fei asked them to give him some of their body parts, allowing Mei to begin the process of turning his three wives into female beasts.

The first to start the process was Tian Ziyu, the second was Wu Lianzhi, and the third was Xian Xianqin. The three women took several hours to transform into female beasts, and they stood before Zhang Fei several hours later.
Name: Tang Ziyu
Gender: Female
Race: Tusked War Elephant Tiger
Rank: Mythical Rank
Cultivation: 1-Sun Celestial King Realm
Element: Earth [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Earth [Perfection Stage]
Core: Middle-Rank Earth Core
Physique: Elephant Tiger Physique
Name: Wu Lianzhi
Gender: Female
Race: Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant
Rank: Mythical Rank
Cultivation: 2-Sun Celestial King Realm
Element: Wind [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Wind [Perfection Stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Wind Core
Physique: Sky Tyrant Physique
Name: Xian Xianqin
Gender: Female
Race: Sunfire Emperor Behemoth
Rank: Mythical Rank
Cultivation: 2-Sun Celestial King Realm
Elements:
- Light [Peak Stage]
- Fire [Peak Stage]
Elemental Laws:
- Light [Perfection Stage]
- Fire [Perfection Stage]
Cores:
- Upper-Rank Light Core
- Upper-Rank Fire Core
Physique: Behemoth Physique
Zhang Fei nodded in satisfaction after reading the status of his three wives; he asked them to transform into their beast forms.
Wu Lianzhi’s and Xian Xianqin’s beast forms were no different from Sha Huoyan’s and Shou Yunzhi’s beast forms because they were both women.

However, Tang Ziyu’s beast form looked much different from Xiang Zhan’s beast form because the latter was a male beast, and her beast form was much slimmer and prettier compared to his muscular beast form.

After everything was done, Zhang Fei sent Sha Huoyan and Shou Yunzhi back into his beast space, and Xiang Zhan rejoined the other male beasts to absorb the yin qi from the female yen demon. He also asked Tang Ziyu, Wu Lianzi, and Xian Xianqin to go to the training ground to adjust to their beast forms.

Since he had beast cores and some body parts from the hornless dragon, the golden-haired hou, and the moon rabbit, Zhang Fei had to choose three of his wives to transform into the three beasts. However, he felt a dilemma in making the decision, and he seriously considered which three women were suitable to become the three beasts.
Zhang Fei had several suitable candidates to be transformed into the golden-haired hou beast, such as Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and several others.
As for the hornless dragon, only a few women were suitable to be transformed into the beast, such as Lian Xing, Shang Xinyu, and several others.

Since the four of them were together, Zhang Fei spent about ten days dual cultivating with them. Naturally, they weren’t just dual-cultivating, but they also dual-soul-cultivating together during those few days.

paragraphs: "Where are you going?"

Zhang Fei [5] looked at Gongsun Zhilan. "It has been exactly two months since my swordsmith friends upgraded my sword, so I’m going there to pick it up. Besides, I recall that Mo Shentian has several sets of demon materials for upgrading to the demon rank, so I’ll head to his domain to get them."
"If that’s the case, I’ll come with you."
"Me too." Hua Qianmei herself was bored of hunting mindless demons in the Myriad Abyss Dungeon.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded and opened the gate leading to the Celestial Demon Domain. "Let’s go there."
Once they arrived at the domain, Zhang Fei [5] brought the two women to the Celestial Demon Palace to meet Mo Shentian.

Zhang Fei [5] saw Mo Tianshen and Morgana in the throne room, but they were sitting on the right side, and Mo Zixiao was sitting on the throne. Meanwhile, Mo Zhejun and Mo Shentian sat on the left side, along with the Celestial Demon Guardians.
Mo Zhejun and Mo Shentian looked at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan; both men knew the two women were far stronger than them, even though their demon ranks were at the same level.
"Why are you here, Zhang Fei?" Mo Tianshen asked.
"Him." Zhang Fei [5] walked to the front of Mo Shentian and asked. "Do you still have the demon material set for upgrading demon rank?"
Mo Shentian’s lips twitched, but he couldn’t refute Zhang Fei [5], and he immediately took out two sets of demon items. "I used to have three sets, but I already gave one set to Wu Mian."
Zhang Fei [5] naturally remembered it because Wu Mian handed the demon item set to him when he first took Qi Qingxiu as his wife, and he used those materials to upgrade Zhang Lin’s demon rank.

Without further ado, Zhang Fei [5] took and stored Mo Shentian’s demon items into the system inventory, so his real body could use them to upgrade Jannette and Lillea’s demon ranks. After all, the two dryads were two of his first few wives, so he chose to upgrade their demon ranks before his other wives.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Mo Tianshen and Morgana. "Do you two want to return to the Myriad Abyss Domain now?"
"Yes." Mo Tianshen and Morgana nodded at him. "We’ve both spent over two weeks in this domain, so we’ll return there to continue our cultivation."
"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate, sent them to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and brought Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei to the Twin Flames Domain.

After they left, Mo Shentian put on a vicious look and gritted his teeth. He had been thinking of ways to free himself from Zhang Fei [5]’s control, but all his efforts were in vain as he had already cloned his soul. He wanted to ask Mo Zhejun for help with that, but his master was too loyal to his enemy.

Since everything was over, Mo Shentian decided to return to his private chambers and summon several female demons, whom he would use to practice the Yin Sacrifice Art. Although he was already under Zhang Fei [5]’s control, and he had lost much of his demon power after passing it on to Mo Tianshen, he refused to give up and worked hard to rebuild his strength.
"What is that floating island?"
Zhang Fei [5] looked at the floating island. "My sect is on that floating island, but I will move them to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley once the construction there is finished."
"Zhang Fei, you should go get your sword, and I will wait for you in your sect with Gongsun Zhilan."
"Alright." After lifting the flying restrictions in the domain, Zhang Fei [5] went to the You Clan, and the two female demon gods went straight to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Since Zhang Fei [5] had already informed Serpentera and Tian Kui about the two female demon gods, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan were able to enter the sect easily.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan were truly shocked to see people of all races living in the sect. They could see that most of the sect members were human, but they were quite impressed by the harmony of all the races living there, something they had never seen before.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan also went to the Celestial Yin Lake. They soaked there to try the lake’s benefits, which was quite surprising to them. Even though the Moonlit Passion Temple was located in the Paradise Realm, the Yin Qi within the lake was quite strong even for demon gods like them.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] had arrived at the You Clan, and he immediately went to meet You Feng and You Jian to retrieve the Demon Extermination Sword.
You Jian handed the sword to him. "As we promised, your sword is complete, and we successfully upgraded it to the Immortal Grade."
"Apart from your sword body, the two sword spirits also underwent significant changes," You Feng said.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] accepted the sword and rubbed the blade. "Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an."
Swoosh... Swoosh...
Jian Hei’an and Jian Guang’an immediately came out of the sword. "Master, we missed you."

"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "I missed the two of you too! Once we get back, I’m going to dual-soul cultivate with both of you! How do you two feel after the Demon Extermination Sword was upgraded?"
Jian Hei’an stretched out her slender arm. "As the sword’s power increases, my strength also increases, Master."
"Master, I have let you down," Jian Guang’an said dejectedly. "My strength has indeed increased, but my improvement is not as great as my sister’s."

Zhang Fei [5] pulled them into his arms and kissed them. "Guang’an, I understand your desire to help me, but you don’t need to feel disappointed, okay? In my eyes, you two are the same, and I don’t care who is stronger between you guys. If Hei’an is stronger than you now, I will help you catch up with him, so you don’t need to be disappointed."
"Mhmm." Jian Guang’an nodded and hugged him. "I’m glad to have you, Master."

"I should be the one glad to have you both." Zhang Fei [5] hugged them. "You two and the sword have accompanied me since I was very weak, and I can become who I am now thanks to your help, so I will always treasure you."
"Hehe." Jian Hei’an and Jiang Guang’an giggle. "Master, let’s go back to the dungeon, and you can test the new power of the Demon Extermination Sword."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] looked at You Jian and You Feng. "Thank you for your help, Seniors."

"No need." You Feng waved his hands. "You’ve helped us a great deal since we moved to this domain, and you’ll be taking us to the Ancient Realm in the future, so we’re happy to help you upgrade your sword."

You Jian spoke. "Unfortunately, this is the last bit of help we can offer for your sword, Zhang Fei. We don’t have any information on the materials for crafting supreme-grade artifacts, nor do we have the method, so we won’t be able to help you upgrade your sword to the final rank."

"No problem." Zhang Fei [5] looked at his sword. "The Ancient Realm is vast; I’m sure there is a blacksmith who has the ability to upgrade my sword in one of the domains there. However, I won’t look for that person now, and I will focus on my cultivation for the next ten years."
"So, when are you going to move us to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley?"

"All construction of the domain will be completed in about a year, and I’ll take everyone there when everything is done." Jian Guang’an and Jian Hei’an entered the sword before Zhang Fei [5] stored it in his body. "Even though there’s still a long time, you guys should start preparing now, and we’ll move to the domain once everything is finished. However, I won’t stay there, and I will live in another domain."
"Are you going to stay in the Myriad Abyss Domain forever?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "After Jiu Jushen and the others are done with all the construction in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, they will start rebuilding the Sky Dragon Island, and I will bring all my family and all my wives’ families to live there."
"I see." You Feng nodded in understanding. "In that case, I’ll have everyone prepare now, so we’ll be ready once construction on the domain is complete."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I’ll return to my sect to pick up some people there."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, You Feng turned to his brother. "Meeting that kid is the greatest luck in our lives, Brother."

"Yes." You Jian nodded in agreement. "If it weren’t for him, we would never have known about the Ancient Realm, let alone moved to one of the domains there. By the way, it’s time for you to meet your son, Brother."
You Feng sighed, remembering that his son was still not willing to return to their clan. "I will try talking to my son again, and I will ask him to bring Fei Yinglin here."

"Speaking of the Fei Clan, the situation in their clan seems to have gotten worse after Zhang Fei injured Fei Juechen six and a half years ago. " You Feng didn’t want to comment on that clan. "The Zhi Clan also seems to regret not being able to establish good relations with him."
You Feng couldn’t help but shake his head. "Zhi Shengyan is stupid, but Lan Yuerong is even more stupid, and the Zhi Clan suffered losses because of them."
"Let’s not talk about them and go see our parents and grandfather."
"Let’s go."
