chapters.title: Chapter 1893: Demon Extermination Sword Upgrade II
paragraphs: After leaving the You Clan, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

He visited every hall to speak with the individuals in charge—such as Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Yan Leibao, Hong Quan, Tian Shuixiang, Lin Jingxia, Yao Shen, Xi Hongyan, Lin Moxian, Elmyra, Zhe Wuming, and others.

Previously, he hadn’t brought them to the training room because they still had to take care of the sect with Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling gone. Naturally, the original elders of the sect also helped them, but their abilities were no match for Jian Kuang and the others.
Among those people, only Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng had never trained in the training ground because they were natives of the Paradise Realm.
As for the others, he brought them from the Three Mortal Realms, and they had already trained in the training space before he joined the Moonlit Passion Temple.
He also sent Tian Kui, Serpentera, Huo Mingyi, and Huo Mengyi to his training space.
Since he only had one enemy left in the Paradise Realm, he decided to send them all into the training space to train.
After all, he would bring them all to the Ancient Realm in the future, and they were his main force, so they had to develop themselves as soon as possible.

As for responsibilities within the sect, he entrusted everything to the sect’s original elders. He also informed them that he would bring them into his training space to train, though he would take them in turns.

Additionally, he contacted Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei. He asked for their help to assist the elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple in managing the sect. They did not hesitate to help him because he had helped them a lot, and he built a new sect for them.

After that, he went to the Celestial Moon Sect to meet Yue Mingyi and the others. Since Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were his wives, and they had a strong attachment to their sect, he wanted to help them improve themselves.

After discussing with Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, he did not bring all the sect members to the training space, and he only brought a few women. From the elders, he brought Yue Mingyi, Yue Yuling, Yue Wanxian, and Yue Qingyi. From the disciples, he only brought Yue Bingxuan, Yue Liangyu, and Yue Liuxian.

Then, he went to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and he sent all of Feng Yao’s subordinates to the training space. They were completely loyal to him, and she was also one of his wives, so he had no problem bringing them there.

Naturally, he did not forget his parents-in-law, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu. Since they had never trained in his training space, he also took the two of them to train there according to Feng Yao’s request.
Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, Huo Hao’er, Huo Xiaoyu, and Huo Fengyin were excited by the opportunity. After all, they had witnessed his abilities, and they knew that he had far surpassed them.
He also visited the Peach Garden Domain, but Lan Yueru and Li Tianyu rejected his offer, so he did not take them to the training space. He only brought Sima Yun, Hua Mei’er, and Hua Xiang’er.
His impression of Sima Yun was so-so, but he felt indebted to Jia Xianzu, so he brought him to his training space.
He did not have a close relationship with Hua Xiang’er, but she was Beiming Youhuang’s disciple, and her master helped him a lot in developing his soul world.

As for Hua Mei’er, he had mixed impressions of her, and he once kissed her when they first met at the Star Tower years ago. Even so, he never approached her directly, and she always avoided him ever since he kissed her.

He also went to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, but Tianshi Bailong, Lingyue, Long Xukong, and Long Lixuan rejected his offer to train at his training ground. Moreover, they still had to monitor the movements of Qian Yan and the two primordial beasts, so they chose to pass up the opportunity.
After that, he went to the Ice Phoenix domain, where he discussed the matter with Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu.

Back then, he sent them to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain; they trained there for many years, but their improvement was not significant. Among them, only Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu experienced significant improvement.

Furthermore, the two women had long decided to hand over leadership of their race to Zhang Yue in the future, so he thought of helping them more. That way, they would be completely loyal to his big sister, and they could help her in the future.
He sent members of the natural races who came from the Three Mortal Realms to his training space. All of them decided to follow him, and they have shown their loyalty to them over the past years.
Besides, some of their members, such as Zefyr, Xi Xianzi, Jia Yuyan, and Qian Shuang, were his wives.
As for the natural races from the Paradise Realm, he did not send any of them to his training space because their relationship was not that close.
Jia Yuyan’s grandparents had an important role in the Fairy Race, and they couldn’t be away for too long, so he didn’t force them.
As for the demon races, he didn’t plan to bring them there. In his opinion, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Qian Qin, Sha Qingge, Mo Zainan, Nalan Wangzhi, and Nalan Yushu were enough.
Even though he was close to many other cultivators, his impression of them was only average, so he had no plans to bring them to his training space.
Dugu Yuanshen and Long Huoyan were quite capable, but he was rather wary of them, so he decided not to bring them into his training space.
After everything was finished, he decided to go to the Divine Samsara Sect. It had been a month since he enslaved Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening, but he had never visited the sect.
Before he went to the sect, he picked up Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, who were enjoying their time at the Celestial Yin Lake belonging to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Upon arrival at the sect, he didn’t immediately meet the two ancestors; instead, he went to the alchemy shop, where he met Jin Nanqing, Xuan Yun, and Luo Lianjin. He had a good impression of them, and their relationship was quite good.

He told the three old men about the Ancient Realm and his plans to move those closest to him to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. At first, they were shocked and found it hard to believe in the existence of that realm, so he created several qi screens that showed several domains in that realm.
The three old men eventually agreed to accept his offer, but he asked them to wait until the construction at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley was complete.
After speaking with them, he went to meet Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening, and he asked them to meet him at Yue Ningxue’s former cultivation cave.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening were shocked by his sudden arrival; they rushed to meet him. They glanced at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, who were standing behind him. They swallowed hard after realizing that the two female demons were stronger than all the demon gods in the Paradise Realm.
He looked at them while thinking. "What about the Huang and Ouyang Clans?"

’Shit.’ Their bodies stiffened for a moment, but then Huang Tianzhun answered him. "Master, the Huang Clan is under my complete control, and they always follow my orders, so they will never cause trouble for you or your sect."

"Master, I have no control over the Ouyang Clan; my father and grandfather controlled our clan, so I am helpless." He glared at Ouyang Xuening. "Old Huang has already helped me talk to them, but they won’t listen to him."
He nodded in understanding and thought of other ways to suppress the Ouyang Clan.
"Do you need my help?" Hua Qianmei asked.
Gongsun Zhilan also spoke. "If they dare to oppose you, I will use my poison on them, and their cultivation will slowly fade."
’Damn it! This woman is truly vile!’ Ouyang Xuening broke out in a cold sweat at the thought.
"No need." He rejected Gongsun Zhilan’s idea. "Let these two handle them first, and the two of you can help me if the people from the Ouyang Clan still refuse to submit to me."
"Alright."
He opened the gate to the Myriad Abyss Domain. "Let’s go back; I want to test my sword against those mindless demons."

Ouyang Xuening let out a sigh of relief after Zhang Fei [5] and the two women had left. "Who exactly are those two female demons? Their cultivation is at the Celestial God Realm, yet I feel their power and aura far surpass ours."

"I’ve never met them before," Huang Tianzhun thought for a moment. "For tens of thousands of years, I have only known of the ten demon gods, and there are no demons stronger than them. They may come from other realms, but I don’t know which realm."
"Is it possible that there is a realm higher than this Paradise Realm?"

"That’s possible," Huang Tianzhun sighed. "We have to think of a way to convince your father and grandfather, Xuening. If we can’t successfully convince them, they will probably die at the hands of those two female demons."

"But how should we convince them?" Ouyang Xuening felt conflicted about it because her father and grandfather were not willing to listen to them. "If Zhang Fei sends another person, like Empress Huo, to my domain, she might be able to convince them."
Huang Tianzhun shook his head. "Let’s try to convince them again."

sentences.text: After leaving the You Clan, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

He visited every hall to speak with the individuals in charge—such as Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Yan Leibao, Hong Quan, Tian Shuixiang, Lin Jingxia, Yao Shen, Xi Hongyan, Lin Moxian, Elmyra, Zhe Wuming, and others.
Previously, he hadn’t brought them to the training room because they still had to take care of the sect with Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling gone.
Naturally, the original elders of the sect also helped them, but their abilities were no match for Jian Kuang and the others.
Among those people, only Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng had never trained in the training ground because they were natives of the Paradise Realm.
As for the others, he brought them from the Three Mortal Realms, and they had already trained in the training space before he joined the Moonlit Passion Temple.
He also sent Tian Kui, Serpentera, Huo Mingyi, and Huo Mengyi to his training space.
Since he only had one enemy left in the Paradise Realm, he decided to send them all into the training space to train.
After all, he would bring them all to the Ancient Realm in the future, and they were his main force, so they had to develop themselves as soon as possible.
As for responsibilities within the sect, he entrusted everything to the sect’s original elders.
He also informed them that he would bring them into his training space to train, though he would take them in turns.
Additionally, he contacted Lu Shaqing and Gong Wei.
He asked for their help to assist the elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple in managing the sect.
They did not hesitate to help him because he had helped them a lot, and he built a new sect for them.
After that, he went to the Celestial Moon Sect to meet Yue Mingyi and the others.
Since Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou were his wives, and they had a strong attachment to their sect, he wanted to help them improve themselves.
After discussing with Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou, he did not bring all the sect members to the training space, and he only brought a few women.
From the elders, he brought Yue Mingyi, Yue Yuling, Yue Wanxian, and Yue Qingyi.
From the disciples, he only brought Yue Bingxuan, Yue Liangyu, and Yue Liuxian.
Then, he went to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and he sent all of Feng Yao’s subordinates to the training space.
They were completely loyal to him, and she was also one of his wives, so he had no problem bringing them there.
Naturally, he did not forget his parents-in-law, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu.
Since they had never trained in his training space, he also took the two of them to train there according to Feng Yao’s request.
Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, Huo Hao’er, Huo Xiaoyu, and Huo Fengyin were excited by the opportunity.
After all, they had witnessed his abilities, and they knew that he had far surpassed them.
He also visited the Peach Garden Domain, but Lan Yueru and Li Tianyu rejected his offer, so he did not take them to the training space.
He only brought Sima Yun, Hua Mei’er, and Hua Xiang’er.
His impression of Sima Yun was so-so, but he felt indebted to Jia Xianzu, so he brought him to his training space.
He did not have a close relationship with Hua Xiang’er, but she was Beiming Youhuang’s disciple, and her master helped him a lot in developing his soul world.
As for Hua Mei’er, he had mixed impressions of her, and he once kissed her when they first met at the Star Tower years ago.
Even so, he never approached her directly, and she always avoided him ever since he kissed her.
He also went to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, but Tianshi Bailong, Lingyue, Long Xukong, and Long Lixuan rejected his offer to train at his training ground.
Moreover, they still had to monitor the movements of Qian Yan and the two primordial beasts, so they chose to pass up the opportunity.
After that, he went to the Ice Phoenix domain, where he discussed the matter with Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu.
Back then, he sent them to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain; they trained there for many years, but their improvement was not significant.
Among them, only Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu experienced significant improvement.
Furthermore, the two women had long decided to hand over leadership of their race to Zhang Yue in the future, so he thought of helping them more.
That way, they would be completely loyal to his big sister, and they could help her in the future.
He sent members of the natural races who came from the Three Mortal Realms to his training space.
All of them decided to follow him, and they have shown their loyalty to them over the past years.
Besides, some of their members, such as Zefyr, Xi Xianzi, Jia Yuyan, and Qian Shuang, were his wives.
As for the natural races from the Paradise Realm, he did not send any of them to his training space because their relationship was not that close.
Jia Yuyan’s grandparents had an important role in the Fairy Race, and they couldn’t be away for too long, so he didn’t force them.
As for the demon races, he didn’t plan to bring them there.
In his opinion, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, Qian Qin, Sha Qingge, Mo Zainan, Nalan Wangzhi, and Nalan Yushu were enough.
Even though he was close to many other cultivators, his impression of them was only average, so he had no plans to bring them to his training space.
Dugu Yuanshen and Long Huoyan were quite capable, but he was rather wary of them, so he decided not to bring them into his training space.

It had been a month since he enslaved Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening, but he had never visited the sect.
Before he went to the sect, he picked up Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, who were enjoying their time at the Celestial Yin Lake belonging to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

He had a good impression of them, and their relationship was quite good.
He told the three old men about the Ancient Realm and his plans to move those closest to him to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley.
At first, they were shocked and found it hard to believe in the existence of that realm, so he created several qi screens that showed several domains in that realm.

He looked at them while thinking.

’Shit.’ Their bodies stiffened for a moment, but then Huang Tianzhun answered him.

’Damn it!

chapters.title: Chapter 1894: Demon Extermination Sword Upgrade III
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] had returned to the fifth underground floor; he immediately moved to the central area and summoned the Demon Extermination Sword from within his body.

Meanwhile, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan did not approach him and watched from the sidelines. They already knew what he would do next, and they didn’t want to be hit by his sword technique by getting too close to his area.
"Guang’an and Hei’an."
The two female sword spirits immediately emerged from the Demon Extermination Sword.
"Do you want to see our new abilities, Master?"
"But these demons are too weak, and they might die with one attack, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] looked at the two female sword spirits. "If they die, then so be it. Besides, I still need a lot of demon materials, so you two can kill them to your heart’s content."
"Hehe." The two female sword spirits giggled.
Jian Guang’an moved behind him, hugged him from behind, and held the sword’s hilt. "Let me show you our transformation first, Master."
"Sure."
*Swoosh*
Zhang Fei [5] was flabbergasted as soon as the sword turned bright white, and Jian Guang’an spoke into his ear. "Channel your light element into the sword, Master."
"Alright." The Demon Extermination Sword glowed even brighter as Zhang Fei [5] channeled his light element into it. "Hmm? I feel the light element in the sword has increased severalfold."
"Threefold, to be exact, Master." Jiang Guang’an raised Zhang Fei [5]’s hands and the sword. "I will use the first technique, Master."
As soon as Jian Guang’an said that, tens of thousands of white swords appeared above them, and the place was brightly lit.
Zhang Fei [5] felt familiar with the sword technique. In fact, he could do the same thing, but he felt Jian Guang’an’s technique was different from his.

In the distance, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan covered their eyes with their hands, looking at those white swords in awe. They had seen Zhang Fei [5] use a sword technique almost similar to that, but his sword technique seemed inferior compared to Jian Guang’an’s.
Even the mindless demons on the floor looked at Jian Guang’an’s sword technique with trembling bodies, as if those swords oppressed them.
"Are you ready, Master?"
"Let’s do it."

Jian Guang’an swung the sword down, and the white sword immediately plunged into the ground, killing all the mindless demons on the floor in one fell swoop. Those swords caused a series of explosive sounds, and the ground on the floor shook violently from the impact, which was also experienced by the four floors above them.
Just like Zhang Fei [5], Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan were also shocked to see the floor cleared of those mindless demons.

After accompanying Zhang Fei [5] as he hunted mindless demons for over two months, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan realized that his swordsmanship was extraordinary, and he could slay them with great speed.

Zhang Fei [5] could kill many mindless demons in such a short time, but he couldn’t kill them with a single technique. He needed two or three strikes to kill them; now he could do it with just one strike.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan looked at Jian Guang’an behind Zhang Fei and took a deep breath. They didn’t expect that the light sword spirit would become so powerful after the Demon Extermination Sword became an immortal-grade artifact.
"You’re awesome, Guang’an!"
"Hehe," Jian Guang’an giggled. "Let me show you the next one, Master."
"Go."
The Demon Extermination Sword suddenly extended, and its tip almost touched one of the walls of the area. Jian Guang’an looked at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, who understood her intentions.
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan immediately flew into the air, waiting for Jian Guang’an’s next action.

Jian Guang’an didn’t act immediately because the mindless demons needed time to respawn, so he had to wait a while before using his second technique. After they respawned, she led Zhang Fei [5] spinning on the spot, and the Demon Extermination Sword instantly cut them in half.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan broke out in a cold sweat as they watched the sword slice through the mindless demons as easily as cutting tofu, and all of them instantly died again. Even though they were only low-level demons, no weapon could cleave through them that easily.

A second later, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan were snapped back to reality; they immediately moved to collect the demon materials that were scattered on the floor. Since Jian Guang’an killed all the mindless demons twice in a row, the materials on the ground were countless, and many of them were materials that Zhang Fei [5] needed.
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath, turning to Jian Guang’an with a look of shock and awe. "Your changes are truly amazing, Guang’an."
"Hehehe." Jian Guang’an kissed his lips and took the sword from him. "There is still one new ability I have acquired, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] was overjoyed to hear that. "Show me."
"Alright." Jian Guang’an nodded. "Have you ever heard of a human and a sword becoming one, Master?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "Although I can’t do that myself, I’ve heard of it before. So, you mean you and the sword will merge into one?"
"I’ll show you, Master." Jian Guang’an closed his eyes, and he disappeared from Zhang Fei [5]’s sight a few seconds later.
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow as he looked at the Demon Extermination Sword. He saw many golden symbols appear on the blade, and two white wings appeared on either side of the hilt.

Zhang Fei [5] wanted to grab the sword, but the Demon Extermination Sword flew away. He was used to seeing his sword do that when the two female sword spirits controlled it, but he felt that it was different from usual.
Soon, the Demon Extermination Sword transformed, and Jian Guang’an appeared in front of Zhang Fei [5] again. "Master, in this state, I am the sword, and the sword is me."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] reached out his hand and stroked her cheek. "You are my sword, and my sword is you."
Jian Guang’an smiled and looked around; she saw those mindless demons had respawned. "I’ll show you the third one, Master."

After saying that, Jian Guang’an waved her right hand, and many mindless demons around them were instantly torn apart. She didn’t stop there; she flew slowly towards the crowd of other demons, and all the demons in her path were also split in half.
Zhang Fei [5], Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhiyan saw no significant movement from Jian Guang’an, and all those demons died just like that.
Jian Hei’an’s lips curled up; she embraced her master from behind. "Are you satisfied with my sister’s changes, Master?"
"Satisfied! I’m satisfied." Zhang Fei [5] nodded strongly. "So, how about your changes?"
"I also have three new techniques, and I’ll show them to you after this. But—" Zhang Fei [5] turned to her. "But I want to dual-soul cultivate with you after this, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] smiled and nodded at her. "Don’t worry, okay? I’ll dual-soul cultivate with you two after this, and I’ll satisfy both of you."
"Hehehe." Jian Hei’an kissed him. "I missed you so much, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] gently flicked her nose. "I missed you both too."

Before long, all the mindless demons on the floor were dead, and Jian Guang’an effortlessly killed them. After she finished, she returned to Zhang Fei [5] and separated from the Demon Extermination Sword. "Are you satisfied with my performance, Master?"
"I’m completely satisfied." Zhang Fei [5] kissed her. "With your development, I don’t need to fear those demon gods anymore, and we will kill them if they dare to look for trouble with us."
As before, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan picked up all the demon materials on the floor, and they handed over the important materials to Zhang Fei [5].
"If I remember correctly, you should have two complete sets now, right?"
"Plus the two sets you got from Mo Shentian earlier, your four wives can upgrade their demon ranks."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "You two are right about that. My real body will help my four demon wives raise their demon ranks, but I’m still unsure about the other two."
"Who are the first two?"
"Lillea and Janette are my first two demon wives, so I will help them first." Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "Perhaps I will choose Zhang Lingxue and Ursula for the other two."
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan had already met all of Zhang Fei [5]’s wives; they knew that Ursula was a Devourer Demon and Zhang Lingxue was a Phoenix-Devourer Demon Beast.

"A devourer demon is actually strong; Ursula will become even stronger after her demon rank rises to the Seven Supreme Demon Rank. However, Zhang Lingxue should become stronger than her because she has the phoenix bloodline in her body, and she will probably evolve after her demon rank rises."

"Besides, they are my earliest women, and they have been following me for a long time, so I want to help them first. After I get the other demon material sets, I will help my other wives." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Jian Hei’an. "Show me your three new techniques, Hei’an."
"Okay." Jian Hei’an grabbed the hilt of the Demon Extermination Sword, and Zhang Fei [5] channeled his darkness element into the sword.
Unlike when Jian Guang’an used it, the Demon Extermination Sword turned even blacker in Jian Hei’an’s hands, and it released a baleful aura that made Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan tremble.
"What kind of baleful aura is this? I’ve never felt such an aura before," Gongsun Zhilan said, her voice trembling.
Hua Qianmei nodded in agreement. "This aura is more terrifying than our ancestors’ aura."

chapters.title: Chapter 1895: Demon Extermination Sword Upgrade IV
paragraphs: *Crack... Crack...*
Zhang Fei [5], Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan were shocked as the ground beneath them cracked open. Within seconds, tens of thousands of demonic skulls with huge bodies crawled out from the ground.

Jian Hei’an’s black eyes turned even blacker, including her white cornea and sclera. A black, baleful aura also enveloped her entire body. She looked at those demonic skulls, her lips curled into an evil smile. "My minions, attack those mindless demons and kill them for my master."
*Clack... Clack...*
After getting orders from Jian Hei’an, the demonic skulls immediately moved and attacked the mindless demons.
Zhang Fei [5], Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan took a deep breath, watching those demonic skulls devour those mindless demons.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Jiang Guang’an, but she could only shake her head helplessly.
*Swoosh*
Huo Ling suddenly emerged from Zhang Fei [5]’s body, put on a serious expression, and stared at those demonic skulls.
"Do you know anything about these demonic skulls, Ling’er?"
Huo Ling shook her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "I don’t know where these demonic skulls came from, but I sense a familiar aura from them."
"Familiar aura?"

"The aura of the Lotus Limbo World." Huo Ling looked at Jian Hei’an. "I don’t know how this female sword spirit was able to summon creatures with the same aura from that place, but I’m certain that their aura is the same as the one I sensed there in the past."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "If Hei’an can summon a creature with the same aura from that place, maybe she can open a portal to that place?"

"She might be able to do that." Huo Ling’s gaze never left Jian Hei’an’s figure. "However, it’s dangerous if she can open a portal to that place, and all the angry souls will come out to this place. Worst of all, this domain will become hell if that damned woman gets out of there."
"What is Lotus Limbo World? Who is the woman you are referring to?" Gongsun Zhilan asked.

"The Lotus Limbo World is a stagnant pocket dimension, and it serves as a prison for the souls of cultivators who tried to defy the Wheel of Reincarnation." Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei had never heard of that place. "There is no land inside, and a boundless black lake stretches without boundaries. Countless souls wander above it, and they will devour the soul power of any living creature that enters it. Once we enter that place, we can’t leave again, and you will eventually join them."
"Who are the people imprisoned in that place?"
"Why would anyone think of entering such a place?"

"One of the portals is in the Floral Mirage Domain, and it is guarded by the Ancient Treant Spirit, Shu Yuangu." Huo Ling looked at the two female demon gods. "They are people who tried to defy the Wheel of Reincarnation to achieve immortality, and their souls will be sent to that place."

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan fell into deep thought after hearing that. They themselves were no different from those people, and they always thought that immortality could be achieved by reaching the peak of cultivation. Since birth, they were taught that the principle of cultivation is to defy everything, including death.

Seeing their expressions, Huo Ling couldn’t help shaking her head. "True immortality does not exist, and all living beings can live extremely long lives by cultivating and reaching the highest possible level, which grants them an extremely long lifespan. Even so, their lifespans will still be exhausted, and they will die in the end."
"Does true immortality really not exist?"

"No," Huo Ling shook his head again. "As you both already know, I am the Primordial Flame, and my master is one of the primordials. We have lived through several eras, and we have never seen any living being who has succeeded in becoming immortal. In fact, the two primordial beasts, Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi, are not immortals either. They can live so long because their cultivation is already so high, precisely at the Exalt Supreme Realm."
"How long is their lifespan?"

"All cultivators who have reached the Celestial God Realm can live more than five hundred million years, right?" Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan nodded to Huo Ling. "When their cultivation breaks through to the God King Realm, they can live for one billion years, and their lifespan will increase ten times every time their cultivation breaks through to the next stage."
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan gasped in shock; their eyes went wide and trembled.
Huo Ling chuckled, seeing their shocked expressions. "Therefore, you two should be able to imagine Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi’s lifespan, right?"
"So, cultivators who have reached the God Supreme Realm can live for a hundred billion years, huh?"
"That’s right." Huo Ling nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi should have a lifespan of trillions of years."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "Besides them, there are still some other primordial beings, and they have long been in a deep slumber. Is it possible that they will wake up one day?"

"I can’t say for sure, Husband." Huo Ling looked at Jian Hei’an again. "This universe is already fragile, and it can’t contain their power. If they hadn’t entered the deep slumber and sealed their power, this universe would have long since been destroyed. Even Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi didn’t dare to awaken their bodies, and they always used their avatars."
"Even their avatars have such terrifying strength, let alone their real bodies." Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei muttered to themselves.
"Haha," Huo Ling laughed. "The strength of the primordials is far more terrifying than you can imagine, and they can destroy the current universe with a snap of their fingers."
Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei sighed softly, feeling that they had been too naive and arrogant. With their current strength, they were simply no match for those primordials.
While they were conversing, those demonic skulls had already killed all the mindless demons on the floor and disappeared into the ground.
Jian Hei’an turned to her master. "I will use my second technique now, Master."
"Alright, show me."
Jian Hei’an positioned the Demon Extermination Sword in front of his face with the blade pointing upwards. She closed her eyes and muttered something.
Zhang Fei [5], Huo Ling, Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan looked up at the ceiling, where black clouds were beginning to appear and gather.
"What kind of technique is this again?" Hua Qianmei asked.
Gongsun Zhilan squinted her eyes. "This aura is much more terrifying than the first one."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] stared at it with a frown, but then he looked at Huo Ling. "Is this second technique still related to the Lotus Limbo World?"
"Yes." Huo Ling returned his gaze to Jian Hei’an. "Her second technique seems almost similar to the first, but I don’t know what will come out of those black clouds."

"Let’s wait then." Zhang Fei [5] stretched out his hand and sucked in all the demon materials that had appeared after Jian Hei’an killed all the previous mindless demons. "Sigh! We obtained a lot of demon materials, but those four materials are truly rare. We’ve been hunting in this dungeon for over two months, but we’ve only obtained two sets of materials."
Huo Ling laughed. "If those four materials were so easy to obtain, this universe would have countless demon gods, Husband."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when he felt the familiar aura from those black clouds. "Heavenly lightning tribulations?"
"Huh?" Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei turned to him. "Is that really heavenly lightning tribulations?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I’ve faced heavenly lightning tribulations too many times in the past, so I’m familiar with their aura. However, I also sense something different from those black clouds, so I’m not sure if my guess is correct."

"You’re not wrong about that, Husband. That aura is indeed the aura of heavenly lightning tribulations, but it’s different from the ones you’ve encountered in the past." Huo Ling paused and squinted her eyes. "This aura belongs to those heavenly lightning tribulations in the Lotus Limbo World, and it is much stronger than normal."

Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei were increasingly confused by everything; they looked at Jian Hei’an thoughtfully, as they couldn’t understand how all her techniques could have a connection to such a place.
Within a few minutes, black clouds had covered the entire area of the fifth underground floor, with countless black lightning flashes there.

Huo Ling acted quickly by protecting Zhang Fei [5], Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan with her aura. As a spirit, she could sense that those black heavenly lightnings were far more powerful than she had anticipated, and they could kill them.

Zhang Fei [5] himself had faced countless lightning tribulations since his cultivation broke through to the Earth Realm, but his body trembled when he saw those black heavenly lightnings. Even though Huo Ling was protecting them, he activated his lightning domain and several of his other domains to reduce the risk.
However, their worries were overblown, and the black lightning bolts did not hit them as they descended from those black clouds. They only hit those mindless demons and wiped them all out at once.
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan were truly shocked to witness the power of those black lightning bolts; they felt that Jian Hei’an was much more overpowered than Jian Guang’an.
"Phew." Jian Hei’an exhaled softly and withdrew his technique after those mindless demons disappeared. "What do you think of my technique, Master?"
"Overpowered!" Zhang Fei [5] asked her. "How many times can you use that technique?"
"Three times," Jian Hei’an replied with a bitter smile. "After I use it three times, I can’t use it for a month, or my soul will weaken significantly."
"Try using your third technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 1896: Demon Extermination Sword Upgrade V
paragraphs: The Demon Extermination Sword in Jian Hei’an’s hand suddenly emitted a pitch-black light, carrying the same baleful aura as her two previous techniques.
Jian Hei’an opened her eyes, but they were even darker than before. She took a deep breath and carefully slashed the sword forward, causing a small crack to open in midair.
Huo Ling gasped in shock as she sensed the terrifying aura emanating from the crack, and she immediately moved as Jian Hei’an was about to swing the sword once more.
"Stop it, Little Spirit!"
Jian Hei’an looked at her in confusion, but Huo Ling didn’t say anything more to her.

Huo Ling stretched her hand forward and shot her primordial flame into the crack to repel the terrifying aura emanating from within. Within a few seconds, the crack disappeared by itself, making her breathe a sigh of relief.
"Was that crack just now what I think it was, Ling’er?" Zhang Fei [5] asked with a solemn expression.

"Yes," Huo Ling nodded. "I didn’t expect your sword spirit to be able to open a gap leading to the Lotus Limbo World, Husband. If I don’t stop her, those wandering evil souls will come out from that place, and they will wreak havoc in this domain. The situation will get out of control, and no cultivator in the domain will be able to fight her."
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had an idea. "Since Jian Hei’an can open a portal connecting us to that place, I don’t need to worry about being trapped there."

"Her ability is indeed an advantage for you, Husband." Then, Huo Ling warned him. "However, you cannot enter that place with your current cultivation, and you have to wait until your cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm first. That woman is as strong as my master, so you won’t be able to defeat her for now. Even Hu Tianlang was forced to flee in the past, so you must not force yourself to enter that place."

Zhang Fei [5] naturally understood the situation, and he would not act recklessly by entering that place with his current cultivation and strength. Although he could borrow Feng Yao’s power, he had no clear information about the woman’s abilities.
"Master." Jian Hei’an tugged at his sleeves. "I’m sorry."

Zhang Fei [5] looked at her, smiled at her, and patted her head. "You don’t need to apologize to me, okay? You’re still unfamiliar with your new techniques, and Ling’er stopped you as soon as she realized it, so there’s no problem with that."
"Thank you, Master." Jian Hei’an was really afraid of bringing trouble to her master.
"Alright, you and Guang’an can enter the sword again." The two sword spirits did not argue with Zhang Fei [5] and entered the Demon Extermination Sword.
Then, Huo Qianmei asked Huo Ling. "Who exactly is that woman, Senior?"
"That woman is much older than all the ancient demons that ever lived in this Ancient Realm." Huo Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan froze, their eyes widening as they stared at Huo Ling.
"So, that woman is also an ancient demon, right?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in a mumbling tone.
"You could say that, Husband." Huo Ling nodded at him. "She’s not older than the primordials, but she’s much older than those ancient demons, including Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin."
"Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin?" Gongsun Zhilan turned to Hua Qianmei. "Why are those two names so familiar?"
Hua Qianmei also found the two names familiar. "If I’m not mistaken, they were the first and strongest ancient demons, but the ancestors of the other races defeated and killed them."
"Ahh!" Gongsun Zhilan clasped her hands. "No wonder their names are so familiar!"
"Dead?" Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan looked at Huo Ling in confusion. "What if I say that Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin are still alive?"
"That’s impossible, right?"
"How can they still be alive?"
Huo Ling chuckled. "Do you want to take these two women to see them, Husband?"
"The last time I saw them was over two months ago, so I thought I’d visit them again." Zhang Fei [5] walked toward the south-left corner, with Huo Ling sitting on his shoulder. "Follow me."
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan exchanged confused glances for a moment. They hurriedly followed behind Zhang Fei [5].
Once they arrived at the south-left corner, Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling led the two female demon gods across the wall, which shocked them.

They were two of the few demon gods of the Myriad Abyss Domain, but Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan never knew that there was a secret passage in the Myriad Abyss Dungeon. If it weren’t for Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling, they would never know that the hidden passage existed.
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan could see many symbols on the walls on both sides, but they did not recognize them.
Huo Ling told them those symbols were written using an ancient language. Those symbols were used to suppress the power of the two ancient demons.
Hui Ling also told them that the dungeon was a prison, and the mindless demons were the minions of the ancient demons.
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan felt their heads spinning as they listened to Huo Ling’s explanation; they felt that they didn’t know about many things, particularly regarding the events of the past.

When they arrived at the entrance to the sixth ground floor, Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan had difficulty breathing due to the fierce aura of the two ancient demons. They were demon gods and had fought too many enemies in the past, but they felt oppressed by that terrifying aura.
"The two ancient demons are truly frightening; even my body can’t stop trembling."
Gongsun Zhilan agreed with Hua Qianmei; her body couldn’t stop shaking when faced with the aura of the two ancient demons.

Unlike Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei, Zhang Fei [5] was much more relaxed because he had met Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin before, and they were not like he had previously imagined, so he no longer felt afraid of them.
As they approached the gate, two powerful demon auras swept towards them, causing Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan to tremble even more violently than before.
Hua Qianmei’s and Gongsun Zhilan’s pupils shrank as soon as they saw Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin. They looked at Zhang Fei [5], who looked so calm in front of the two ancient demons.
"Haha," Zhen Mo laughed. "Why are you here again, Kid? Are those two female demons your wives?"

"Their cultivation has already reached the Celestial Demon God, but their demon aura is too weak." Zhen Yi spoke, looking at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan. "Are they demon gods from this domain, Kid?"

"They are Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, two of the several demon gods of this domain." Zhang Fei [5] took out two jugs of wine and threw them at the two ancient demons, who immediately caught them. "Since you two have been imprisoned here for too long, I deliberately brought the wine for you."
Without further ado, Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin opened the lid of the jug and drank the wine inside. "Haha! This wine is really delicious, Kid."
"It’s been a long time since I’ve had wine, so I must thank you for bringing it for us," Zhen Yin said. "So, what brings you here today? Have you found a solution to free us?"

"I can free you two whenever I want, but I don’t want to risk luring that creature into this domain." Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin understood Zhang Fei [5]’s worries because that creature was too powerful, and none of them could defeat it. "They are curious about you two, so I brought them here to meet you. Moreover, you two have been imprisoned in this place for too long, and I’m taking a break from my hunting, so I’ll accompany you to chat."
"Haha," Zhen Mo laughed. "I appreciate your good intentions, kid."
Zhen Yin looked at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, who looked terrified of her and her husband. "One of you is a charm demon, and the other one is a poison demon, right?"
"Yes, Ancestor." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan answered respectfully.
"I see." Zhen Yin nodded in understanding. "You two are fortunate to befriend this kid, and your futures will be bright if you follow him."

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan glanced at Zhang Fei [5]. They already knew more or less about his strength and connections, especially his connections with Feng Yao and Huo Ling. However, they did not expect that the oldest two ancient demons also spoke highly of him.
"Were you two truly imprisoned in this place before this domain was inhabited, Senior?"

"Yes," Zhen Mo nodded at them. "Those despicable other races entrapped us in the past, and they have imprisoned us in this place ever since. Even so, we managed to injure them, and this kid said that they were long dead."
Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin recounted their past experiences to Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan. They also told the two female gods about their plans if Zhang Fei [5] freed them in the future.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei has finished dual cultivating with Guo Lan, Wang Zhuxian, and Ming Yanyu. After that, he asked Lillea, Janette, Zhang Lingxue, and Ursula to meet him in the garden.
Lillea, Janette, Zhang Lingxue, and Ursula were overjoyed when Zhang Fei gave them the demon materials to upgrade their demon ranks.
Since they were already dual cultivating with Zhang Fei, Lillea and Janette hurriedly used those materials to begin the process of upgrading their demon ranks, which would take a year or two.
On the other hand, Zhang Lingxue and Ursula did not directly use those demon materials; instead, they pulled Zhang Fei into the main bedroom because they hadn’t dual-cultivated with him yet.

"Okay."

chapters.title: Chapter 1900: The Ancient Divine Tree Seed
paragraphs: After they exited the portal, Jiu Shui saw ten members of the Nine-Headed Serpent Race cultivating seriously. Some of them already had seven heads, and the weakest of them had six.
Jiu Tou Sen woke them up and introduced Jiu Shui to them, but their reception was not positive, making him feel daunted by their presence.

After all, they were much older than Jiu Shui, and they didn’t like his origin from the Three Mortal Realms. Even though they had never heard of or gone there, they knew that it was worse than the Paradise Realm, so they underestimated him.
However, they didn’t dare say anything bad about Jiu Shui in front of Jiu Tou Sen because he was the leader of their race and the one who had brought him to them.

Jiu Tou Sen had guessed from the start that they would not welcome Jiu Shui with open arms, so he decided to tell them about Zhang Fei. "He is the sole heir of the Ten-Tailed Fox, and he is the husband of Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation. If you guys think you can defeat them with your current strength, you can try fighting them. Even I myself can’t defeat them, let alone all of you."

The ten beasts fell silent, and their gazes toward Jiu Shui changed completely. Although they had never met Zhang Fei and Feng Yao, they never doubted what Jiu Tou Sen said. Since their leader had said they were the sole heirs of the Ten-Tailed Fox and Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, they didn’t dare underestimate their junior, and some of them thought about establishing a relationship with him.
Although he still felt uncomfortable with their presence, Jiu Shui felt quite relieved by their changes.
Jiu Tou Sen patted Jiu Shui’s shoulder and led him elsewhere.

When they arrived at a black lake, Jiu Tou Sen asked Jiu Shui to change into his beast form and soak in it. "The water inside this lake is different from the outside, and it will give you many benefits, especially for your physique. For the next three months, you should soak in it, and we will start your training after that."
"Thank you, Senior." Jiu Shui immediately transformed into his beast form, entered the lake, closed his eyes, and cultivated there.

Jiu Tou Sen nodded slightly, left Jiu Shui at the lake, and went to meet his race members. Although they didn’t say anything, they knew exactly what was on their minds. "If all of you want to develop and become stronger, you guys have to treat him well. After he finishes his training, I will take you all to see his master, and Zhang Fei won’t mind helping you. With his help, our race will become much stronger, and our future is guaranteed."
The ten beasts did not argue with Jiu Tou Sen and thought of ways to build a better relationship with Jiu Shui, especially the three female beasts.
Jiu Tou Sen looked at them, shook his head slightly, and went to his private quarters.
In the beast space, Zhang Fei lay his head on Feng Yao’s lap. "Do you know about the Ancient Divine Tree?"

"One of the causes of the Ancient Realm’s destruction was the death of the Ancient Divine Tree due to the past disaster, and I couldn’t find its seed to revive it." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "If I can find the seed and revive it, this realm will be completely transformed, and it will return to its former prosperity."
Zhang Fei took out the Ancient Divine Tree Seed and showed it to Feng Yao. "This is the seed, right?"
"Where did you get it?"
Since Feng Yao already knew about the system, Mei, and Xuanyuan Yue, Zhang Fei did not hide it and explained everything to her.
"Which domain should we plant this seed in?"

"That domain was destroyed along with the past disaster, Husband." Feng Yao took the seed from his hand. "In fact, it doesn’t matter if we plant this seed elsewhere, like on the Sky Dragon Island. If we plant it there, we can protect it. When the Ancient Divine Tree grows to maturity, it will affect the Ancient Realms."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "In that case, I’ll plant this seed there after construction is complete, Yao’er. How long will it take for the Ancient Divine Tree to mature? Will it take longer than the Spirit Willow Tree?"
"Much longer." Feng Yao returned the seed to him. "The Ancient Divine Seed is much older and stronger than the Spirit Willow Tree, and it takes millions of years to fully mature."

"Millions of years, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered in a daze. "Phew! Since the seed take so long to mature, I don’t need to rush to plant them, and I will wait for all the construction on the Sky Dragon Island to be completed."

Feng Yao nodded to him. "There are no barriers on the Sky Dragon Island, and the core creature will probably detect the presence of the Ancient Divine Tree Seed, so you have to be patient to plant it there."
"Yeah."
"Aren’t you going to continue your seclusion?"

"I’ve been dual cultivating with many of them for several months, so I wanted to rest for a few days." Zhang Fei looked off into the distance. "What do you think about them? Should I dual cultivate with them?"

Feng Yao looked in that direction. "Jie Yuan is Chu Qing’s contracted beast, Hai Ma is Zhang Lin’s contracted beast, and You Bai is Tang Zhiyu’s contracted beast, right? Since the three women are your wives, I think you should dual-cultivate with the three female beasts. Since they rarely come out to fight, you can wait for their cultivation to improve first. Why don’t you use your lust demon ability on Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting? You don’t have Kunpeng and Qilin Beasts in your harem yet, and they’ve been cultivating here for a long time, so I think they’re suitable additions to your harem."

"I’ve wanted them for a long time, but I won’t use my lust demon ability on them." Zhang Fei gazed at the two female beasts. "Sooner or later, they will definitely be my women, and I just need to wait for the right time."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Your cultivation still has quite a way to go before breaking through to the 2-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, Husband."
Zhang Fei felt helpless about his cultivation.
Unlike the Ten Mortal Realms and the Seven Divine Realms, his cultivation took a long time to break through to the Five Celestial Realms, mainly because each stage required too much qi.
Even with so many women and those female yin demons, he couldn’t break through too quickly.
"Let’s dual cultivate, husband."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "What if we use our beast forms? A fox and a phoenix."
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "Your thoughts are really wild; do you know that?"
Zhang Fei shrugged. "I just want to try new things with you."
"Alright, let’s try it."

After that, Zhang Fei and Feng Yao reverted to their beast forms—a heavenly fox and a phoenix. He used his lust demon abilities on her, and he also activated his lust demon before dual cultivating with her.
Moments later, the cry of a phoenix echoed within the beast space, causing the female beasts inside to become agitated.

Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting, who were cultivating in one area, immediately opened their eyes. They were stunned to see a heavenly fox and a phoenix doing such a thing. They were not surprised that Zhang Fei had such a wild idea, but they did not expect that Feng Yao would follow him.
"Zhang Fei is getting crazier, Xingyuan." Lei Huoting took a deep breath.

Yuwen Xingyuan nodded in agreement with a blush on her cheeks. "He hasn’t given up on getting us, Huoting. Unfortunately, Feng Yao can’t get out of this place, so we’re forced to listen to their activities."
"Yeah," Lei Huoting sighed. "Let’s close our sense of hearing so we don’t have to listen to them."
"Alright."
Unlike Yuwen Xingyuan and Lei Huoting, the actions of Zhang Fei and Feng Yao made You Bai, Hai Ma, and Jie Yuan increasingly impatient to engage in dual cultivation with him.
A day passed quickly in the outside world; Zhang Fei returned to the training space after he dual-cultivated with Feng Yao for several days in the beast space.
Zhang Fei immediately asked some of his partners from the Sky Jade Realm to enter the main bedroom.

They were Ning Xiang, Du Yuan, Luo Yu, Gu Yan, Tang Rou, Cheng Yu, Shi Yue, Xia Qianqian, Yun Kexin, Yan Luan’er, Xi Zihua, Yi Na, Han Xuenai, Yue Qingya, Yan Zhixiu, Chu Youqian, Xing Mei, Xie Jingxian, and Ba Shuxiang.

Even though they were his women, Zhang Fei treated them slightly differently from Zhang Yue and the others. He did treat them well, but Zhang Lin still held a higher status than all of them in his heart.
Given their large numbers, Zhang Fei set aside several days to engage in dual cultivation and dual-soul cultivation with them.
Meanwhile, Qian Yan was resting in a domain after flying for so long through the darkness of outer space. Even though he was a powerful demon beast, he still needed time to rest.

Qian Yan activated his middle eye, but he still couldn’t find the location of Qian Hua, Qian Qin, and the others, which made him even more frustrated. "Where exactly did that bastard hide them? Did he really take them to the Ancient Realm? With my current strength, I shouldn’t have any problems if I go to the realm myself, but I can’t open the barrier protecting the portal."
After resting for some time, Qian Yan continued his journey to return to his domain.
